title: "EMEP QAQC Report"

date: "`r format(Sys.time(), '%Y-%m-%d %H:%M')`"
params:
  qaqc_user: "Tomas Liska"
output:
  rmdformats::readthedown:
    toc_depth: 3
fig_width: 10 
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
required_packages = c(
  "knitr", "ncmeta", "tidync", "tidyverse", "fs", "sf", "lubridate",
  "furrr", "stars", "ncdf4", "openair", "ggpubr", "gridExtra", "ggh4x",
  "rnaturalearth", "rnaturalearthdata", "textclean", "gt", "leaflet",
  "logger", "htmltools", "checkmate", "grid", "patchwork", "khroma", "scico",
  "ggrastr"
)

missing_packages = required_packages[
  !vapply(required_packages, requireNamespace, logical(1), quietly = TRUE)
]

if (length(missing_packages) > 0) {
  stop(
    "Missing packages: ",
    paste(missing_packages, collapse = ", ")
  )
}

#load all required packages
invisible(
  lapply(required_packages, library, character.only = TRUE)
)

USER_INPUT_FILE = Sys.getenv("EMEP_QAQC_USER_INPUT")

if (USER_INPUT_FILE == "") {
  # For local/laptop runs, set the user input file manually here.
  USER_INPUT_FILE = "/Users/tomasliska/Desktop/Work/EMEP_QAQC/emep_qaqc_user_input2.R"
}

if (!fs::file_exists(USER_INPUT_FILE)) {
  stop(
    glue::glue("User input file not found: {USER_INPUT_FILE}")
  )
}

USER_INPUT_FILE = fs::path_abs(USER_INPUT_FILE)

source(USER_INPUT_FILE)

# BASIC VALIDATION ---------------------------------------------------------

check_input_dir = function(dir, input_name) {
  if (!is.null(dir) && !fs::dir_exists(dir)) {
    stop(
      glue::glue("{input_name} does not exist: {dir}"),
      call. = FALSE
    )
  }
}

# Test and reference dates must be supplied as complete pairs.

if (xor(is.null(TEST_START_DATE), is.null(TEST_END_DATE))) {
  stop(
    'TEST_START_DATE and TEST_END_DATE must either both be NULL or both be supplied.',
    call. = FALSE
  )
}

if (xor(is.null(REF_START_DATE), is.null(REF_END_DATE))) {
  stop(
    'REF_START_DATE and REF_END_DATE must either both be NULL or both be supplied.',
    call. = FALSE
  )
}

# TEST_DIR must be a named list with at least one submitted domain.

if (!is.list(TEST_DIR) || is.null(names(TEST_DIR)) || any(names(TEST_DIR) == '')) {
  stop("TEST_DIR must be a named list of model domains.", call. = FALSE)
}

submitted_test_domains = names(TEST_DIR)[!purrr::map_lgl(TEST_DIR, is.null)]

if (length(submitted_test_domains) == 0) {
  stop("At least one test domain must be specified in TEST_DIR.", call. = FALSE)
}

purrr::iwalk(
  TEST_DIR,
  ~ check_input_dir(.x, paste0('TEST_DIR$', .y))
)

# REF_DIR may be NULL, otherwise it must be a named list.

if (
  !is.null(REF_DIR) &&
  (!is.list(REF_DIR) || is.null(names(REF_DIR)) || any(names(REF_DIR) == ''))
) {
  stop("REF_DIR must be NULL or a named list of model domains.", call. = FALSE)
}

submitted_ref_domains = if (is.null(REF_DIR)) {
  character()
} else {
  names(REF_DIR)[!purrr::map_lgl(REF_DIR, is.null)]
}

ref_submitted = length(submitted_ref_domains) > 0

if (ref_submitted) {
  purrr::iwalk(
    REF_DIR,
    ~ check_input_dir(.x, paste0('REF_DIR$', .y))
  )
}

# Test and reference runs must contain corresponding domains.

if (ref_submitted && !setequal(submitted_test_domains, submitted_ref_domains)) {
  stop(
    paste0(
      "Test and reference domain submissions do not correspond.\n",
      "For each submitted test domain, the equivalent reference domain ",
      "must also be supplied, and vice versa."
    ),
    call. = FALSE
  )
}

# Check submitted observation directories.

if (!is.null(TEST_OBS_DIR)) {
  purrr::walk(TEST_OBS_DIR, ~ check_input_dir(.x, 'TEST_OBS_DIR'))
}

if (!is.null(REF_MOBS_DIR)) {
  check_input_dir(REF_MOBS_DIR, 'REF_MOBS_DIR')
}

# Check CRS definitions.

if (!exists('TEST_CRS') || is.null(TEST_CRS)) {
  stop("TEST_CRS must be specified.", call. = FALSE)
}

if (ref_submitted && (!exists('REF_CRS') || is.null(REF_CRS))) {
  stop("REF_CRS must be specified when a reference run is submitted.", call. = FALSE)
}

# load qaqc input files

source(fs::path('../utils/myquicktext.R'))
source(fs::path('../utils/utils.R'))
source(fs::path('../utils/emep_qaqc_funcs.R'))

platform = runtime_platform() # in utils.R

worker_cap = dplyr::case_when(
  platform == 'slurm-compute' ~ parallelly::availableCores(),
  platform == 'slurm-login' ~ min(2, parallelly::availableCores()),
  platform %in% c('mac', 'windows') ~ min(4, parallelly::availableCores()),
  TRUE ~ NA_integer_
)

# report formatting setup
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE, fig.align = 'center')
knit_engines$set(asis = function(options) {
  if (options$echo && options$eval) knit_child(text = options$code)
})

MODSTATS_STATS_LOOKUP = c(
  n = 'Count',
  FAC2 = 'Factor of Two',
  MB = 'Mean Bias',
  NMB = 'Normalised Mean Bias',
  RMSE = 'Root Mean Squared Error',
  r_pearson = 'Pearson r',
  r_spearman = 'Spearman r'
  )

inventory_pollutant_lookup = c(
  sox = 'SOx',
  nox = 'NOx',
  co = 'CO',
  voc = 'NMVOC',
  nh3 = 'NH3',
  pm25 = 'PM2.5',
  pmco = 'PMcoarse'
)

emission_var_groups = list(
  anthropogenic = c(
    'Emis_mgm2_sox',
    'Emis_mgm2_nox',
    'Emis_mgm2_co',
    'Emis_mgm2_voc',
    'Emis_mgm2_nh3',
    'Emis_mgm2_pm25',
    'Emis_mgm2_pmco'
  ),
  natural = c(
    'Emis_mgm2_BioNatNO',
    'Emis_mgm2_BioNatC5H8',
    'Emis_mgm2_BioNatTERP',
    'Emis_mgm2_BioNatDust_WB_f',
    'Emis_mgm2_BioNatDust_WB_c',
    'Emis_mgm2_DMS'
  )
)

# currently not needed but useful to reference
gnfr_sector_lookup = c(
  '1' = 'A_PublicPower',
  '2' = 'B_Industry',
  '3' = 'C_OtherStationaryComb',
  '4' = 'D_Fugitive',
  '5' = 'E_Solvents',
  '6' = 'F_RoadTransport',
  '7' = 'G_Shipping',
  '8' = 'H_Aviation',
  '9' = 'I_Offroad',
  '10' = 'J_Waste',
  '11' = 'K_AgriLivestock',
  '12' = 'L_AgriOther',
  '13' = 'M_Other'
)

#clean report_out_pth for new log and initiate new log file
archive_log(logger_pth)
logger::log_appender(logger::appender_file(logger_pth))

test_label = RUN_LABELS[1]
ref_label = RUN_LABELS[2]

domain_setup = tibble::tibble(
  domain = submitted_test_domains,
  test_dir = unname(
    TEST_DIR[submitted_test_domains]
  ),
  ref_dir = purrr::map(
    submitted_test_domains,
    function(domain) {

      if (!ref_submitted) {
        return(NULL)
      }

      REF_DIR[[domain]]
    }
  )
) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    domain_name = purrr::map_chr(
      test_dir,
      fs::path_file
    )
  )

# time qaqc

qaqc_run_start = Sys.time()

qaqc_task_timings = list()
qaqc_parallel_info = list()

```

```{r run info}

logger::log_with_separator('Run Info Summary', separator = '-')
logger::log_layout(logger::layout_glue)

# Non-standard EMEP filenames are not yet supported
if (!is.null(TEST_EMEP_FILE_TAG) ||
    !is.null(REF_EMEP_FILE_TAG)) {

  stop(
    paste0(
      "Support for non-standard EMEP output filenames is currently under ",
      "development. Please use the standard EMEP filename convention for ",
      "QAQC runs at present."
    ),
    call. = FALSE
  )
}

test_run_info = do.call(
  get_common_dir,
  TEST_DIR[submitted_test_domains]
)

ref_run_info = if (ref_submitted) {

  do.call(
    get_common_dir,
    REF_DIR[submitted_ref_domains]
  )

} else {

  NULL
}


# Extract domain directory names
EMEP_domains = purrr::set_names(
  domain_setup$domain_name,
  domain_setup$domain
)

# Use the most nested submitted domain for date-range extraction.

test_date_dir = domain_setup %>%
  dplyr::slice_tail(n = 1) %>%
  dplyr::pull(test_dir) %>%
  purrr::pluck(1)

test_date_file = select_emep_file_from_dir(
  EMEP_dir = test_date_dir,
  most_resolved = TRUE
)

# Determine Test modelled period.

if (
  !is.null(TEST_START_DATE) &&
    !is.null(TEST_END_DATE)
) {

  test_time_range = override_emep_time_range(
    time_range = NULL,
    start_date = TEST_START_DATE,
    end_date = TEST_END_DATE
  )

  test_time_range = validate_emep_time_range_override(
    time_range = test_time_range,
    emep_file = test_date_file,
    run_label = 'Test'
  )

} else {

  test_time_range = get_emep_time_range(
    test_date_file
  )
}


# Use the most nested submitted Reference domain for date-range extraction.

ref_date_dir = if (ref_submitted) {

  domain_setup %>%
    dplyr::filter(
      !purrr::map_lgl(ref_dir, is.null)
    ) %>%
    dplyr::slice_tail(n = 1) %>%
    dplyr::pull(ref_dir) %>%
    purrr::pluck(1)

} else {

  NULL
}

ref_date_file = if (!is.null(ref_date_dir)) {

  select_emep_file_from_dir(
    EMEP_dir = ref_date_dir,
    most_resolved = TRUE
  )

} else {

  NULL
}


# Determine Reference modelled period.

if (!ref_submitted) {

  ref_time_range = NULL

} else if (
  !is.null(REF_START_DATE) &&
    !is.null(REF_END_DATE)
) {

  ref_time_range = override_emep_time_range(
    time_range = NULL,
    start_date = REF_START_DATE,
    end_date = REF_END_DATE
  )

  ref_time_range = validate_emep_time_range_override(
    time_range = ref_time_range,
    emep_file = ref_date_file,
    run_label = 'Reference'
  )

} else {

  ref_time_range = get_emep_time_range(
    ref_date_file
  )
}

# Determine the temporal overlap between Test and Reference runs.

testref_start_date = NULL
testref_end_date = NULL
testref_period_overlap = FALSE

if (ref_submitted) {

  testref_start_date = max(
    test_time_range$first_time,
    ref_time_range$first_time
  )

  testref_end_date = min(
    test_time_range$last_time,
    ref_time_range$last_time
  )

  testref_period_overlap =
    testref_start_date < testref_end_date

  if (!testref_period_overlap) {
    testref_start_date = NULL
    testref_end_date = NULL
  }
}

# Resolve emissions years
test_emiss_year = if (!is.null(TEST_EMISSION_YEAR)) {

  TEST_EMISSION_YEAR

} else {

  get_emep_emissions_year(
    test_date_file
  )
}


ref_emiss_year = if (is.null(ref_date_file)) {

  NULL

} else if (!is.null(REF_EMISSION_YEAR)) {

  REF_EMISSION_YEAR

} else {

  get_emep_emissions_year(
    ref_date_file
  )
}
```

```{r task-parameter validation}

# Common derived flags -----------------------------------------------------

EMISSION_TASKS =
  isTRUE(CHECK_EMISSIONS) ||
  isTRUE(CHECK_EMISSION_TEMPORAL)

SUMMARY_MAP_TASKS =
  isTRUE(PLOT_STATIC_SUMMARY_MAPS) ||
  isTRUE(PLOT_INTERACTIVE_SUMMARY_MAPS)

EMISSION_REGION_GEODATA_REQUIRED =
  (
    CHECK_EMISSIONS &&
    region_list_requires_geodata(
      EMISSION_CHECK_REGIONS
    )
  ) ||
  (
    CHECK_EMISSION_TEMPORAL &&
    region_list_requires_geodata(
      EMISSION_TEMPORAL_REGIONS,
      allow_full_domain = TRUE
    )
  )

MOBS_EVALUATION_OUTPUTS =
  isTRUE(PRINT_MODSTATS_TABLES) ||
  isTRUE(PLOT_MOBS_SCATTER_PLOTS) ||
  isTRUE(PLOT_MOBS_MODSTAT_MAPS)

NEED_MOBS =
  isTRUE(MOBS_EVALUATION_OUTPUTS) ||
  isTRUE(PLOT_MOBS_TSERIES)

# Load variable parameters ------------------------------------------------

checkmate::assert_string(
  EMEP_VAR_PARAMS_FILE,
  min.chars = 1
)

checkmate::assert_file_exists(
  EMEP_VAR_PARAMS_FILE
)

 source(EMEP_VAR_PARAMS_FILE)

if (!exists('EMEP_VAR_PARAMS_LIST')) {
  stop(
    paste0(
      "The EMEP variable parameter file did not create ",
      "EMEP_VAR_PARAMS_LIST:\n  ",
      EMEP_VAR_PARAMS_FILE
    ),
    call. = FALSE
  )
}

checkmate::assert_choice(
  REPORT_STYLE,
  choices = c(
    'static',
    'interactive'
  )
)

# check RUNSCRIPT and CONFIG files exist if included in the report

if (isTRUE(INCLUDE_CONFIG_RUNSCRIPT_FILES)) {
  
  if (
    is.null(CONFIG_FILE_PTH) ||
    !fs::file_exists(CONFIG_FILE_PTH)
  ) {
    stop(
      paste0(
        'INCLUDE_CONFIG_RUNSCRIPT_FILES is TRUE, but CONFIG_FILE_PTH ',
        'is NULL or the file does not exist.'
      ),
      call. = FALSE
    )
  }
  
  if (
    is.null(RUN_SCRIPT_PTH) ||
    !fs::file_exists(RUN_SCRIPT_PTH)
  ) {
    stop(
      paste0(
        'INCLUDE_CONFIG_RUNSCRIPT_FILES is TRUE, but RUN_SCRIPT_PTH ',
        'is NULL or the file does not exist.'
      ),
      call. = FALSE
    )
  }
}

# Check submitted CRS ------------------------------------------------------

check_emep_crs(
  emep_file = test_date_file,
  submitted_crs = TEST_CRS,
  input_name = 'TEST_CRS'
)

if (ref_submitted) {
  check_emep_crs(
    emep_file = ref_date_file,
    submitted_crs = REF_CRS,
    input_name = 'REF_CRS'
  )
}

# Check emission year can be determined -----------------------------------

if (
  EMISSION_TASKS &&
  (is.null(test_emiss_year) || is.na(test_emiss_year))
) {
  stop(
    paste0(
      "An emission QAQC task has been requested, but the test emissions year ",
      "could not be determined from the EMEP filename and TEST_EMISSION_YEAR ",
      "has not been specified in the user input file."
    ),
    call. = FALSE
  )
}

if (
  EMISSION_TASKS &&
  ref_submitted &&
  (is.null(ref_emiss_year) || is.na(ref_emiss_year))
) {
  stop(
    paste0(
      "An emission QAQC task has been requested, but the reference emissions ",
      "year could not be determined from the EMEP filename and ",
      "REF_EMISSION_YEAR has not been specified in the user input file."
    ),
    call. = FALSE
  )
}

# Validate domain-specific region inputs ----------------------------------

if (CHECK_EMISSIONS) {
  validate_domain_region_input(
    region_list = EMISSION_CHECK_REGIONS,
    input_name = 'EMISSION_CHECK_REGIONS',
    submitted_domains = submitted_test_domains,
    allow_null = TRUE,
    allow_full_domain = FALSE
  )
}

if (CHECK_EMISSION_TEMPORAL) {
  validate_domain_region_input(
    region_list = EMISSION_TEMPORAL_REGIONS,
    input_name = 'EMISSION_TEMPORAL_REGIONS',
    submitted_domains = submitted_test_domains,
    allow_null = TRUE,
    allow_full_domain = TRUE
  )
}

if (COMPARE_SUMMARIES) {
  validate_domain_region_input(
    region_list = SUMMARY_REGIONS,
    input_name = 'SUMMARY_REGIONS',
    submitted_domains = submitted_test_domains,
    allow_full_domain = TRUE
  )
}

# Check requested region geodata ------------------------------------------

if (EMISSION_REGION_GEODATA_REQUIRED) {
  
  checkmate::assert_directory_exists(
    SUMMARY_REGION_GEODATA_DIR,
    .var.name = 'SUMMARY_REGION_GEODATA_DIR'
  )

  available_regions = get_region_geofiles(
    geodata_dir = REGION_GEODATA_DIR,
    regions = 'all'
  )$region_id

  if (CHECK_EMISSIONS) {
    purrr::iwalk(
      EMISSION_CHECK_REGIONS,
      function(regions, domain) {
        if (!is.null(regions)) {
          resolve_selection(
            selection = regions,
            available = available_regions,
            input_name = paste0('EMISSION_CHECK_REGIONS$', domain)
          )
        }
      }
    )
  }

  if (CHECK_EMISSION_TEMPORAL) {
    purrr::iwalk(
      EMISSION_TEMPORAL_REGIONS,
      function(regions, domain) {

        region_selection = setdiff(regions, 'full_domain')

        if (length(region_selection) > 0) {
          resolve_selection(
            selection = region_selection,
            available = available_regions,
            input_name = paste0('EMISSION_TEMPORAL_REGIONS$', domain)
          )
        }
      }
    )
  }
}

if (
  COMPARE_SUMMARIES &&
  region_list_requires_geodata(
    SUMMARY_REGIONS,
    allow_full_domain = TRUE
  )
) {

  available_regions = get_region_geofiles(
    geodata_dir = SUMMARY_REGION_GEODATA_DIR,
    regions = 'all'
  )$region_id

  purrr::iwalk(
    SUMMARY_REGIONS,
    function(regions, domain) {

      region_selection = setdiff(regions, 'full_domain')

      if (length(region_selection) > 0) {
        resolve_selection(
          selection = region_selection,
          available = available_regions,
          input_name = paste0('SUMMARY_REGIONS$', domain)
        )
      }
    }
  )
}

# check emission inventory inputs

if (isTRUE(CHECK_EMISSIONS)) {

  invalid_polls = setdiff(
    EMISSION_CHECK_POLLS,
    names(inventory_pollutant_lookup)
  )

  if (length(invalid_polls) > 0) {
    stop(
      paste0(
        "EMISSION_CHECK_POLLS contains unsupported pollutants:\n  ",
        paste(invalid_polls, collapse = '\n  ')
      ),
      call. = FALSE
    )
  }

  inventory_emission_vars = paste0(
    'Emis_mgm2_',
    EMISSION_CHECK_POLLS
  )

  inventory_polls = unname(
    inventory_pollutant_lookup[
      EMISSION_CHECK_POLLS
    ]
  )

  inventory_domain_setup = domain_setup %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      inventory_file = purrr::map(
        domain,
        ~ EMISSION_INVENTORY_PTH[[.x]]
      ),
      inventory_type = purrr::map(
        domain,
        ~ EMISSION_INVENTORY_TYPE[[.x]]
      )
    ) %>%
    dplyr::filter(
      !purrr::map_lgl(inventory_file, is.null)
    )
    
  if (nrow(inventory_domain_setup) == 0) {
    stop(
      paste0(
        "CHECK_EMISSIONS is TRUE, but no emission inventory ",
        "has been specified for any submitted test domain."
      ),
      call. = FALSE
    )
  }
  
  purrr::walk2(
    inventory_domain_setup$inventory_file,
    inventory_domain_setup$domain,
    function(inventory_file, domain) {
  
      checkmate::assert_file_exists(
        inventory_file,
        .var.name = glue::glue(
          "EMISSION_INVENTORY_PTH[['{domain}']]"
        )
      )
    }
  )
  
  invalid_inventory_types = inventory_domain_setup %>%
    dplyr::filter(
      purrr::map_lgl(inventory_type, is.null) |
        !purrr::map_lgl(inventory_type, ~ .x %in% c('emep', 'naei'))
    ) %>%
    dplyr::pull(domain)
  
  if (length(invalid_inventory_types) > 0) {
    stop(
      paste0(
        "A valid EMISSION_INVENTORY_TYPE must be specified for:\n  ",
        paste(invalid_inventory_types, collapse = '\n  '),
        "\n\nSupported types are 'emep' and 'naei'."
      ),
      call. = FALSE
    )
  }

  for (i in seq_len(nrow(inventory_domain_setup))) {

    domain = inventory_domain_setup$domain[[i]]
    domain_name = inventory_domain_setup$domain_name[[i]]
    test_dir = inventory_domain_setup$test_dir[[i]]
    inventory_file = inventory_domain_setup$inventory_file[[i]]

    # Check requested variables in EMEP fullrun file
    emep_file = select_emep_file_from_dir(
      EMEP_dir = test_dir,
      file_tag = 'fullrun'
    )

    available_emep_vars = get_emep_vars(
      nc_file = emep_file,
      var_keywords = NULL
    )

    validate_vars_available(
      requested_vars = inventory_emission_vars,
      available_vars = available_emep_vars,
      task = 'Emission inventory check',
      run_label = paste0('test ', domain, ' domain'),
      file = emep_file
    )

    emission_inventory = inventory_domain_setup$inventory_type[[i]]   

    if (emission_inventory == 'emep') {

      inventory_data = read_emep_country_inventory_file(
        inventory_file
      )

      available_inventory_polls = inventory_data %>%
        dplyr::filter(
          sector == 'NATIONAL TOTAL',
          year == test_emiss_year
        ) %>%
        dplyr::distinct(pollutant) %>%
        dplyr::pull(pollutant)

    } else if (emission_inventory == 'naei') {

      inventory_data = read_processed_naei_inventory_file(
        fpath = inventory_file,
        inventory_year = test_emiss_year
      )

      available_inventory_polls = inventory_data %>%
        dplyr::filter(
          year == test_emiss_year
        ) %>%
        dplyr::distinct(pollutant) %>%
        dplyr::pull(pollutant)

    } else {

      stop(
        glue::glue(
          "Emission inventory check is not implemented for inventory ",
          "type '{emission_inventory}' in domain '{domain_name}'."
        ),
        call. = FALSE
      )
    }

    missing_inventory_polls = setdiff(
      inventory_polls,
      available_inventory_polls
    )

    if (length(missing_inventory_polls) > 0) {
      stop(
        paste0(
          "Emission inventory check validation failed.\n\n",
          "The following requested pollutants are not available in the ",
          domain,
          " emission inventory for ",
          test_emiss_year,
          ":\n  ",
          paste(missing_inventory_polls, collapse = '\n  '),
          "\n\nPollutants were checked in:\n  ",
          inventory_file
        ),
        call. = FALSE
      )
    }
  }
  
  if (!is.null(EMISSION_NETCDF_FILES)) {

    if (!is.character(EMISSION_NETCDF_FILES)) {
      stop(
        "EMISSION_NETCDF_FILES must be NULL or a character vector of file paths.",
        call. = FALSE
      )
    }
  
    missing_emission_files = EMISSION_NETCDF_FILES[
      !fs::file_exists(EMISSION_NETCDF_FILES)
    ]
  
    if (length(missing_emission_files) > 0) {
  
      stop(
        paste0(
          "The following files supplied in EMISSION_NETCDF_FILES do not exist:\n",
          paste(
            missing_emission_files,
            collapse = '\n'
          )
        ),
        call. = FALSE
      )
    }
  }
}

# -------------------------------------------------------------------------

# check temporal emission inputs

# -------------------------------------------------------------------------

if (isTRUE(CHECK_EMISSION_TEMPORAL)) {
  
  validate_palette(
    palette = EMISSION_PALETTE,
    input_name = 'EMISSION_PALETTE'
  )

  # Check temporal file tag

  checkmate::assert_string(
    EMISSION_TEMPORAL_FILE_TAG,
    min.chars = 1,
    .var.name = 'EMISSION_TEMPORAL_FILE_TAG'
  )

  # Check requested pollutants

  checkmate::assert_character(
    EMISSION_TEMPORAL_POLLS,
    min.len = 1,
    any.missing = FALSE,
    min.chars = 1,
    .var.name = 'EMISSION_TEMPORAL_POLLS'
  )

  temporal_emission_vars = paste0(
    'Emis_mgm2_',
    EMISSION_TEMPORAL_POLLS
  )

  temporal_domain_setup = domain_setup

  for (i in seq_len(nrow(temporal_domain_setup))) {

    domain = temporal_domain_setup$domain[[i]]
    test_dir = temporal_domain_setup$test_dir[[i]]
    ref_dir = temporal_domain_setup$ref_dir[[i]]

    # Check test temporal file and requested emission variables

    test_file = select_emep_file_from_dir(
      EMEP_dir = test_dir,
      file_tag = EMISSION_TEMPORAL_FILE_TAG
    )

    if (is.null(test_file)) {
      stop(
        paste0(
          "Temporal emission check validation failed.\n\n",
          "No EMEP file matching EMISSION_TEMPORAL_FILE_TAG = '",
          EMISSION_TEMPORAL_FILE_TAG,
          "' was found for the test ",
          domain,
          " domain:\n  ",
          test_dir
        ),
        call. = FALSE
      )
    }

    if (!emep_file_has_temporal_dim(test_file)) {
      stop(
        paste0(
          "Temporal emission check validation failed.\n\n",
          "The EMEP file selected using EMISSION_TEMPORAL_FILE_TAG = '",
          EMISSION_TEMPORAL_FILE_TAG,
          "' does not contain a time dimension.\n\n",
          "Temporal emission checks require a time-resolved EMEP output file.\n\n",
          "File checked:\n  ",
          test_file
        ),
        call. = FALSE
      )
    }

    test_vars = get_emep_vars(
      nc_file = test_file,
      var_keywords = NULL
    )

    validate_vars_available(
      requested_vars = temporal_emission_vars,
      available_vars = test_vars,
      task = 'Temporal emission check',
      run_label = paste0('test ', domain, ' domain'),
      file = test_file
    )

    # Check corresponding reference file and variables where available

    if (!is.null(ref_dir)) {

      ref_file = select_emep_file_from_dir(
        EMEP_dir = ref_dir,
        file_tag = EMISSION_TEMPORAL_FILE_TAG
      )

      if (is.null(ref_file)) {
        stop(
          paste0(
            "Temporal emission check validation failed.\n\n",
            "No EMEP file matching EMISSION_TEMPORAL_FILE_TAG = '",
            EMISSION_TEMPORAL_FILE_TAG,
            "' was found for the reference ",
            domain,
            " domain:\n  ",
            ref_dir
          ),
          call. = FALSE
        )
      }

      if (!emep_file_has_temporal_dim(ref_file)) {
        stop(
          paste0(
            "Temporal emission check validation failed.\n\n",
            "The EMEP file selected using EMISSION_TEMPORAL_FILE_TAG = '",
            EMISSION_TEMPORAL_FILE_TAG,
            "' does not contain a time dimension.\n\n",
            "Temporal emission checks require a time-resolved EMEP output file.\n\n",
            "File checked:\n  ",
            ref_file
          ),
          call. = FALSE
        )
      }

      ref_vars = get_emep_vars(
        nc_file = ref_file,
        var_keywords = NULL
      )

      validate_vars_available(
        requested_vars = temporal_emission_vars,
        available_vars = ref_vars,
        task = 'Temporal emission check',
        run_label = paste0('reference ', domain, ' domain'),
        file = ref_file
      )
    }
  }
}

# -------------------------------------------------------------------------
# check temporal variation inputs
# -------------------------------------------------------------------------

if (isTRUE(PLOT_TEMPORAL_PROFILES)) {

  checkmate::assert_character(
    TEMPORAL_VARIATION_VARS,
    min.len = 1,
    any.missing = FALSE,
    min.chars = 1,
    .var.name = 'TEMPORAL_VARIATION_VARS'
  )
  
  checkmate::assert_choice(
    TEMPORAL_VARIATION_VALUE_MODE,
    choices = c(
      'value',
      'fraction'
    ),
    .var.name = 'TEMPORAL_VARIATION_VALUE_MODE'
  )
  
  checkmate::assert_choice(
    TEMPORAL_VARIATION_MASS_QUANTITY,
    choices = c(
      'area_normalised',
      'total'
    )
  )

  checkmate::assert_string(
    TEMPORAL_VARIATION_FILE_TAG,
    min.chars = 1,
    .var.name = 'TEMPORAL_VARIATION_FILE_TAG'
  )

  checkmate::assert_choice(
    TEMPORAL_VARIATION_GROUP_BY,
    choices = c('location', 'variable'),
    .var.name = 'TEMPORAL_VARIATION_GROUP_BY'
  )

  checkmate::assert_number(
    TEMPORAL_VARIATION_REGION_MIN_COVERAGE,
    lower = 0,
    upper = 1,
    .var.name = 'TEMPORAL_VARIATION_REGION_MIN_COVERAGE'
  )

  validate_palette(
    palette = TEMPORAL_PALETTE,
    input_name = 'TEMPORAL_PALETTE'
  )

  # Check that at least one spatial selection has been supplied

  checkmate::assert_true(
    !all(purrr::map_lgl(TEMPORAL_VARIATION_REGIONS, is.null)) ||
      !is.null(TEMPORAL_VARIATION_POINTS) ||
      !is.null(TEMPORAL_VARIATION_POINT_FILE),
    .var.name = paste0(
      'TEMPORAL_VARIATION_REGIONS / TEMPORAL_VARIATION_POINTS / ',
      'TEMPORAL_VARIATION_POINT_FILE'
    )
  )

  # Direct points and point file are mutually exclusive

  checkmate::assert_true(
    is.null(TEMPORAL_VARIATION_POINTS) ||
      is.null(TEMPORAL_VARIATION_POINT_FILE),
    .var.name = paste0(
      'TEMPORAL_VARIATION_POINTS / TEMPORAL_VARIATION_POINT_FILE'
    )
  )

  if (!is.null(TEMPORAL_VARIATION_POINT_FILE)) {
    checkmate::assert_file_exists(
      TEMPORAL_VARIATION_POINT_FILE,
      .var.name = 'TEMPORAL_VARIATION_POINT_FILE'
    )
  }

  # Check region configuration

  if (!is.null(TEMPORAL_VARIATION_REGIONS)) {

    checkmate::assert_list(
      TEMPORAL_VARIATION_REGIONS,
      names = 'unique',
      .var.name = 'TEMPORAL_VARIATION_REGIONS'
    )

    specified_domains = TEMPORAL_VARIATION_REGIONS %>%
      purrr::keep(~ !is.null(.x)) %>%
      names()
    
    invalid_domains = setdiff(
      specified_domains,
      submitted_test_domains
    )

    checkmate::assert_true(
      length(invalid_domains) == 0,
      .var.name = 'TEMPORAL_VARIATION_REGIONS'
    )

    purrr::iwalk(
      TEMPORAL_VARIATION_REGIONS,
      function(regions, domain) {

        if (is.null(regions)) {
          return(invisible(NULL))
        }

        checkmate::assert_character(
          regions,
          min.len = 1,
          any.missing = FALSE,
          min.chars = 1,
          .var.name = glue::glue(
            "TEMPORAL_VARIATION_REGIONS[['{domain}']]"
          )
        )

        region_files = setdiff(
          regions,
          'full_domain'
        )

        purrr::walk(
          region_files,
          function(region_file) {

            checkmate::assert_file_exists(
              region_file,
              .var.name = glue::glue(
                "TEMPORAL_VARIATION_REGIONS[['{domain}']]"
              )
            )
          }
        )
      }
    )
  }

  # Check selected EMEP files and variables

  for (i in seq_len(nrow(domain_setup))) {

    domain = domain_setup$domain[[i]]
    test_dir = domain_setup$test_dir[[i]]
    ref_dir = domain_setup$ref_dir[[i]]

    test_file = select_emep_file_from_dir(
      EMEP_dir = test_dir,
      file_tag = TEMPORAL_VARIATION_FILE_TAG
    )

    if (is.null(test_file)) {
      stop(
        paste0(
          "Temporal variation check validation failed.\n\n",
          "No EMEP file matching TEMPORAL_VARIATION_FILE_TAG = '",
          TEMPORAL_VARIATION_FILE_TAG,
          "' was found for the test ",
          domain,
          " domain:\n  ",
          test_dir
        ),
        call. = FALSE
      )
    }

    if (!emep_file_has_temporal_dim(test_file)) {
      stop(
        paste0(
          "Temporal variation check validation failed.\n\n",
          "The selected test file does not contain a time dimension:\n  ",
          test_file
        ),
        call. = FALSE
      )
    }

    test_vars = get_emep_vars(
      nc_file = test_file,
      var_keywords = NULL
    )

    validate_vars_available(
      requested_vars = TEMPORAL_VARIATION_VARS,
      available_vars = test_vars,
      task = 'Temporal variation check',
      run_label = paste0('test ', domain, ' domain'),
      file = test_file
    )

    if (!is.null(ref_dir)) {

      ref_file = select_emep_file_from_dir(
        EMEP_dir = ref_dir,
        file_tag = TEMPORAL_VARIATION_FILE_TAG
      )

      if (is.null(ref_file)) {
        stop(
          paste0(
            "Temporal variation check validation failed.\n\n",
            "No EMEP file matching TEMPORAL_VARIATION_FILE_TAG = '",
            TEMPORAL_VARIATION_FILE_TAG,
            "' was found for the reference ",
            domain,
            " domain:\n  ",
            ref_dir
          ),
          call. = FALSE
        )
      }

      if (!emep_file_has_temporal_dim(ref_file)) {
        stop(
          paste0(
            "Temporal variation check validation failed.\n\n",
            "The selected reference file does not contain a time dimension:\n  ",
            ref_file
          ),
          call. = FALSE
        )
      }

      ref_vars = get_emep_vars(
        nc_file = ref_file,
        var_keywords = NULL
      )

      validate_vars_available(
        requested_vars = TEMPORAL_VARIATION_VARS,
        available_vars = ref_vars,
        task = 'Temporal variation check',
        run_label = paste0('reference ', domain, ' domain'),
        file = ref_file
      )
    }
  }
}

# -------------------------------------------------------------------------
# check EMEP summary inputs
# -------------------------------------------------------------------------

if (isTRUE(COMPARE_SUMMARIES)) {

  # At least one domain must be requested

  requested_summary_domains = names(SUMMARY_REGIONS)[
    !purrr::map_lgl(SUMMARY_REGIONS, is.null)
  ]

  if (length(requested_summary_domains) == 0) {
    stop(
      paste0(
        "COMPARE_SUMMARIES is TRUE, but no domain has been specified ",
        "in SUMMARY_REGIONS."
      ),
      call. = FALSE
    )
  }

  # A summary cannot be requested for an unavailable test domain

  unavailable_summary_domains = setdiff(
    requested_summary_domains,
    submitted_test_domains
  )

  if (length(unavailable_summary_domains) > 0) {
    stop(
      paste0(
        "SUMMARY_REGIONS contains selections for unavailable ",
        "test domains:\n  ",
        paste(unavailable_summary_domains, collapse = '\n  ')
      ),
      call. = FALSE
    )
  }

  # Check SUMMARY_VARS

  if (is.null(SUMMARY_VARS)) {
    stop(
      paste0(
        "COMPARE_SUMMARIES is TRUE, but SUMMARY_VARS is NULL. ",
        "Use 'all' to summarise all supported EMEP variables or specify ",
        "the required variables explicitly."
      ),
      call. = FALSE
    )
  }

  # Variables are common to the model domains, so resolve them once
  # using the most nested requested test domain

  test_summary_domain = requested_summary_domains[
    length(requested_summary_domains)
  ]

  test_summary_dir = TEST_DIR[[
    test_summary_domain
  ]]

  test_summary_file = select_emep_file_from_dir(
    EMEP_dir = test_summary_dir,
    file_tag = 'fullrun'
  )

  summary_vars = resolve_summary_vars(
    summary_vars = SUMMARY_VARS,
    test_file = test_summary_file
  )

  if (length(summary_vars) == 0) {
    stop(
      paste0(
        "EMEP summary validation failed.\n\n",
        "SUMMARY_VARS did not resolve to any supported EMEP variables.\n\n",
        "Variables were checked in:\n  ",
        test_summary_file
      ),
      call. = FALSE
    )
  }

  # Check reference variable availability

  if (ref_submitted) {

    ref_summary_domain = requested_summary_domains[
      requested_summary_domains %in% submitted_ref_domains
    ]

    if (length(ref_summary_domain) > 0) {

      ref_summary_domain = ref_summary_domain[
        length(ref_summary_domain)
      ]

      ref_summary_dir = REF_DIR[[
        ref_summary_domain
      ]]

      ref_summary_file = select_emep_file_from_dir(
        EMEP_dir = ref_summary_dir,
        file_tag = 'fullrun'
      )

      ref_vars = get_emep_vars(
        nc_file = ref_summary_file,
        var_keywords = NULL
      )

      missing_ref_vars = setdiff(
        summary_vars,
        ref_vars
      )

      if (length(missing_ref_vars) > 0) {
        logger::log_warn(
          paste0(
            "The following EMEP summary variables are available in the test ",
            "run but not in the reference run:\n  ",
            paste(missing_ref_vars, collapse = '\n  '),
            "\n\nThese variables will be retained in the summary comparison ",
            "with missing reference values."
          )
        )
      }
    }
  }
}

# -------------------------------------------------------------------------
# check mass budget inputs
# -------------------------------------------------------------------------

if (isTRUE(COMPARE_MASS_BUDGET) &&
    !ref_submitted) {

  stop(
    paste0(
      "COMPARE_MASS_BUDGET is TRUE, but no reference run has been submitted. ",
      "Set COMPARE_MASS_BUDGET = FALSE or provide a reference run."
    ),
    call. = FALSE
  )
}

# -------------------------------------------------------------------------
# check summary maps inputs
# -------------------------------------------------------------------------

if (SUMMARY_MAP_TASKS) {

  # Summary statistics.

  valid_summary_map_stats = c(
    'mean',
    'median',
    'min',
    'max'
  )

  for (input_name in c(
    'SUMMARY_MAP_TEST_STAT',
    'SUMMARY_MAP_REF_STAT'
  )) {

    input_value = get(
      input_name
    )

    valid_summary_map_stat =
      is.character(input_value) &&
      length(input_value) == 1 &&
      !is.na(input_value) &&
      (
        input_value %in% valid_summary_map_stats ||
        stringr::str_detect(
          input_value,
          '^p(?:100|[1-9]?\\d)$'
        )
      )

    if (!valid_summary_map_stat) {
      stop(
        paste0(
          input_name,
          " must be one of:\n  ",
          paste(
            valid_summary_map_stats,
            collapse = '\n  '
          ),
          "\n\nor a percentile from 'p0' to 'p100'."
        ),
        call. = FALSE
      )
    }
  }

  # Mapping file tags.

  for (input_name in c(
    'SUMMARY_MAP_TEST_FILE_TAG',
    'SUMMARY_MAP_REF_FILE_TAG'
  )) {

    input_value = get(
      input_name
    )

    if (
      is.null(input_value) ||
      !is.character(input_value) ||
      length(input_value) != 1 ||
      is.na(input_value) ||
      input_value == ''
    ) {
      stop(
        paste0(
          input_name,
          " must be a single non-empty character string."
        ),
        call. = FALSE
      )
    }
  }

  # Check that the requested Test mapping files exist for every domain.

  purrr::iwalk(
    TEST_DIR[submitted_test_domains],
    function(test_dir, domain) {

      test_map_file = select_emep_file_from_dir(
        EMEP_dir = test_dir,
        file_tag = SUMMARY_MAP_TEST_FILE_TAG
      )

      if (is.null(test_map_file)) {
        stop(
          paste0(
            "Summary map validation failed.\n\n",
            "No EMEP file matching SUMMARY_MAP_TEST_FILE_TAG = '",
            SUMMARY_MAP_TEST_FILE_TAG,
            "' was found for the test ",
            domain,
            " domain:\n  ",
            test_dir
          ),
          call. = FALSE
        )
      }
    }
  )

  # Check Reference mapping files where a corresponding Reference domain exists.

  if (ref_submitted) {

    purrr::iwalk(
      REF_DIR[submitted_ref_domains],
      function(ref_dir, domain) {

        ref_map_file = select_emep_file_from_dir(
          EMEP_dir = ref_dir,
          file_tag = SUMMARY_MAP_REF_FILE_TAG
        )

        if (is.null(ref_map_file)) {
          stop(
            paste0(
              "Summary map validation failed.\n\n",
              "No EMEP file matching SUMMARY_MAP_REF_FILE_TAG = '",
              SUMMARY_MAP_REF_FILE_TAG,
              "' was found for the reference ",
              domain,
              " domain:\n  ",
              ref_dir
            ),
            call. = FALSE
          )
        }
      }
    )
  }

  # Variables requested for map generation.

  if (is.null(SUMMARY_MAP_VARS)) {
    stop(
      paste0(
        "SUMMARY_MAP_VARS cannot be NULL when summary maps are requested. ",
        "Use 'all' to map all supported EMEP variables or specify the ",
        "required variables explicitly."
      ),
      call. = FALSE
    )
  }
  
  checkmate::assert_character(
    SUMMARY_MAP_VARS_REPORT,
    min.len = 1,
    max.len = 10,
    any.missing = FALSE,
    unique = TRUE,
    .var.name = 'SUMMARY_MAP_VARS_REPORT'
  )

  # Resolve requested map variables against the first submitted Test domain.

  summary_map_validation_file = select_emep_file_from_dir(
    EMEP_dir = domain_setup$test_dir[[1]],
    file_tag = SUMMARY_MAP_TEST_FILE_TAG
  )

  validated_summary_map_vars = resolve_summary_map_vars(
    selection = SUMMARY_MAP_VARS,
    test_file = summary_map_validation_file,
    var_params_list = EMEP_VAR_PARAMS_LIST
  )
  
  if (length(validated_summary_map_vars) == 0) {
    stop(
      paste0(
        "No requested summary-map variables have maps$testref_breaks ",
        "defined in EMEP_VAR_PARAMS_LIST."
      ),
      call. = FALSE
    )
  }

  if (length(validated_summary_map_vars) == 0) {
    stop(
      paste0(
        "SUMMARY_MAP_VARS did not resolve to any mappable EMEP variables.\n\n",
        "Variables were checked in:\n  ",
        summary_map_validation_file
      ),
      call. = FALSE
    )
  }

  # Variables displayed in the HTML report must be a subset of those
  # requested for map generation.

  validated_summary_map_vars_report = resolve_summary_map_vars(
    selection = SUMMARY_MAP_VARS_REPORT,
    test_file = summary_map_validation_file,
    var_params_list = EMEP_VAR_PARAMS_LIST,
    input_name = 'SUMMARY_MAP_VARS_REPORT',
    available = validated_summary_map_vars
  )

  if (length(validated_summary_map_vars_report) == 0) {
    stop(
      paste0(
        "SUMMARY_MAP_VARS_REPORT did not resolve to any generated ",
        "summary-map variables."
      ),
      call. = FALSE
    )
  }

  # Vertical indices.

  checkmate::assert_int(
    SUMMARY_MAP_TEST_Z_INDEX,
    lower = 1,
    null.ok = TRUE,
    .var.name = 'SUMMARY_MAP_TEST_Z_INDEX'
  )

  checkmate::assert_int(
    SUMMARY_MAP_REF_Z_INDEX,
    lower = 1,
    null.ok = TRUE,
    .var.name = 'SUMMARY_MAP_REF_Z_INDEX'
  )

  # Report map resolution.

  checkmate::assert_number(
    SUMMARY_MAP_REPORT_DPI,
    lower = .Machine$double.eps,
    .var.name = 'SUMMARY_MAP_REPORT_DPI'
  )

  # Interactive-map-specific inputs.
  
  if (isTRUE(PLOT_INTERACTIVE_SUMMARY_MAPS)) {
  
    # Map types.
  
    checkmate::assert_character(
      INTERACTIVE_SUMMARY_MAP_TYPES,
      min.len = 1,
      any.missing = FALSE,
      unique = TRUE,
      .var.name = 'INTERACTIVE_SUMMARY_MAP_TYPES'
    )
  
    valid_interactive_summary_map_types = c(
      'test',
      'ref',
      'absdiff',
      'reldiff',
      'ratio'
    )
  
    invalid_interactive_summary_map_types = setdiff(
      INTERACTIVE_SUMMARY_MAP_TYPES,
      valid_interactive_summary_map_types
    )
  
    if (length(invalid_interactive_summary_map_types) > 0) {
      stop(
        paste0(
          "INTERACTIVE_SUMMARY_MAP_TYPES contains unsupported map types:\n  ",
          paste(
            invalid_interactive_summary_map_types,
            collapse = '\n  '
          ),
          "\n\nSupported map types are:\n  ",
          paste(
            valid_interactive_summary_map_types,
            collapse = '\n  '
          )
        ),
        call. = FALSE
      )
    }
  
    # Reference-dependent map types require a Reference run.
  
    ref_map_types = intersect(
      INTERACTIVE_SUMMARY_MAP_TYPES,
      c(
        'ref',
        'absdiff',
        'reldiff'
      )
    )
  
    if (!ref_submitted && length(ref_map_types) > 0) {
      stop(
        paste0(
          "The following INTERACTIVE_SUMMARY_MAP_TYPES require a ",
          "Reference run:\n  ",
          paste(
            ref_map_types,
            collapse = '\n  '
          )
        ),
        call. = FALSE
      )
    }
  
    # Maximum number of interactive maps.
  
    checkmate::assert_int(
      INTERACTIVE_SUMMARY_MAP_MAX_MAPS,
      lower = 1,
      .var.name = 'INTERACTIVE_SUMMARY_MAP_MAX_MAPS'
    )
  
    n_interactive_summary_maps =
      length(SUMMARY_MAP_VARS_REPORT) *
      length(INTERACTIVE_SUMMARY_MAP_TYPES)
  
    if (
      n_interactive_summary_maps >
      INTERACTIVE_SUMMARY_MAP_MAX_MAPS
    ) {
      stop(
        paste0(
          "Too many interactive summary maps requested. ",
          "The current selection would generate ",
          n_interactive_summary_maps,
          " maps; the maximum allowed is ",
          INTERACTIVE_SUMMARY_MAP_MAX_MAPS,
          "."
        ),
        call. = FALSE
      )
    }
  
    # Display mode and basemap.
  
    checkmate::assert_choice(
      INTERACTIVE_SUMMARY_MAP_DISPLAY,
      choices = c(
        'raster',
        'points'
      ),
      .var.name = 'INTERACTIVE_SUMMARY_MAP_DISPLAY'
    )
  
    checkmate::assert_subset(
      INTERACTIVE_SUMMARY_MAP_BASEMAP,
      choices = c(
        'world_topo',
        'dark',
        'grey',
        'satellite',
        'terrain'
      ),
      empty.ok = FALSE,
      .var.name = 'INTERACTIVE_SUMMARY_MAP_BASEMAP'
    )
  
    # Raster opacity.
  
    checkmate::assert_number(
      INTERACTIVE_SUMMARY_MAP_OPACITY,
      lower = 0,
      upper = 1,
      .var.name = 'INTERACTIVE_SUMMARY_MAP_OPACITY'
    )
  
    # Hover styling and limits.
  
    checkmate::assert_number(
      INTERACTIVE_SUMMARY_MAP_HOVER_RADIUS,
      lower = 0,
      .var.name = 'INTERACTIVE_SUMMARY_MAP_HOVER_RADIUS'
    )
  
    checkmate::assert_string(
      INTERACTIVE_SUMMARY_MAP_HOVER_COLOUR,
      min.chars = 1,
      .var.name = 'INTERACTIVE_SUMMARY_MAP_HOVER_COLOUR'
    )
  
    checkmate::assert_int(
      INTERACTIVE_SUMMARY_MAP_HOVER_MAX_POINTS,
      lower = 1,
      .var.name = 'INTERACTIVE_SUMMARY_MAP_HOVER_MAX_POINTS'
    )
  
    # Hover-value overrides.
  
    valid_hover_value_input = function(x) {
  
      if (is.null(x)) {
        return(TRUE)
      }
  
      if (
        is.logical(x) &&
        length(x) == 1 &&
        !is.na(x)
      ) {
        return(TRUE)
      }
  
      if (
        is.character(x) &&
        length(x) >= 1 &&
        !anyNA(x)
      ) {
        return(TRUE)
      }
  
      FALSE
    }
  
    if (is.list(INTERACTIVE_SUMMARY_MAP_HOVER_VALUES_OVERRIDE)) {
  
      valid_hover_override_names = c(
        'test',
        'ref',
        'absdiff',
        'reldiff',
        'ratio'
      )
  
      invalid_hover_override_names = setdiff(
        names(INTERACTIVE_SUMMARY_MAP_HOVER_VALUES_OVERRIDE),
        valid_hover_override_names
      )
  
      if (length(invalid_hover_override_names) > 0) {
        stop(
          paste0(
            "INTERACTIVE_SUMMARY_MAP_HOVER_VALUES_OVERRIDE contains ",
            "unsupported names:\n  ",
            paste(
              invalid_hover_override_names,
              collapse = '\n  '
            )
          ),
          call. = FALSE
        )
      }
  
      invalid_hover_overrides =
        INTERACTIVE_SUMMARY_MAP_HOVER_VALUES_OVERRIDE %>%
        purrr::keep(
          ~ !valid_hover_value_input(.x)
        )
  
      if (length(invalid_hover_overrides) > 0) {
        stop(
          paste0(
            "Invalid values supplied in ",
            "INTERACTIVE_SUMMARY_MAP_HOVER_VALUES_OVERRIDE for:\n  ",
            paste(
              names(invalid_hover_overrides),
              collapse = '\n  '
            ),
            "\n\nEach value must be NULL, TRUE, FALSE, or a character ",
            "vector of hover conditions."
          ),
          call. = FALSE
        )
      }
  
    } else if (
      !valid_hover_value_input(
        INTERACTIVE_SUMMARY_MAP_HOVER_VALUES_OVERRIDE
      )
    ) {
  
      stop(
        paste0(
          "INTERACTIVE_SUMMARY_MAP_HOVER_VALUES_OVERRIDE must be NULL, ",
          "TRUE, FALSE, a character vector of hover conditions, or a ",
          "named list of such values."
        ),
        call. = FALSE
      )
    }
  
    # Legend.
  
    checkmate::assert_flag(
      INTERACTIVE_SUMMARY_MAP_LEGEND,
      .var.name = 'INTERACTIVE_SUMMARY_MAP_LEGEND'
    )
  }

}

# -------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Check MOBS inputs
# -------------------------------------------------------------------------

if (NEED_MOBS) {

  # General MOBS inputs.

  checkmate::assert_character(
    MOBS_SOURCE_LABELS,
    min.len = 1,
    any.missing = FALSE,
    unique = TRUE,
    names = 'unique',
    .var.name = 'MOBS_SOURCE_LABELS'
  )

  checkmate::assert_character(
    OBSERVED_POLLS,
    min.len = 1,
    any.missing = FALSE,
    unique = TRUE,
    .var.name = 'OBSERVED_POLLS'
  )

  checkmate::assert_choice(
    OX_UNITS,
    choices = c(
      'ppb',
      'ug/m3'
    ),
    .var.name = 'OX_UNITS'
  )

  if (!is.null(MOBS_DOMAIN_MASK)) {
    checkmate::assert_file_exists(
      MOBS_DOMAIN_MASK,
      .var.name = 'MOBS_DOMAIN_MASK'
    )
  }

  # Existing Test MOBS files are required when MOBS are needed but
  # are not being collated during this run.

  if (!COLLATE_MOBS) {

    sites_used_pth = find_sites_used_file(
      data_pth_out
    )

    if (is.null(sites_used_pth)) {
      stop(
        'Could not find Sites_used.rds or 00Sites_used.rds in: ',
        data_pth_out,
        call. = FALSE
      )
    }

    mobs_pths = fs::dir_ls(
      data_pth_out,
      regexp = '_mod_obs\\.rds$'
    )

    if (length(mobs_pths) == 0) {
      stop(
        'Could not find any mod_obs.rds files in: ',
        data_pth_out,
        call. = FALSE
      )
    }
  }

  # Existing Reference MOBS files when supplied.

  if (!is.null(REF_MOBS_DIR)) {

    ref_sites_used_pth = find_sites_used_file(
      REF_MOBS_DIR
    )

    if (is.null(ref_sites_used_pth)) {
      stop(
        'Could not find reference Sites_used.rds or 00Sites_used.rds in: ',
        REF_MOBS_DIR,
        call. = FALSE
      )
    }

    ref_mobs_pths = fs::dir_ls(
      REF_MOBS_DIR,
      regexp = '_mod_obs\\.rds$'
    )

    if (length(ref_mobs_pths) == 0) {
      stop(
        'Could not find any reference mod_obs.rds files in: ',
        REF_MOBS_DIR,
        call. = FALSE
      )
    }
  }
}

# MOBS collation.

if (COLLATE_MOBS) {

  checkmate::assert_character(
    OBSERVED_POLLS_EMEP_LINK,
    min.len = 1,
    any.missing = FALSE,
    unique = TRUE,
    names = 'unique',
    .var.name = 'OBSERVED_POLLS_EMEP_LINK'
  )

  invalid_observed_poll_links = setdiff(
    names(OBSERVED_POLLS_EMEP_LINK),
    OBSERVED_POLLS
  )

  if (length(invalid_observed_poll_links) > 0) {
    stop(
      paste0(
        "OBSERVED_POLLS_EMEP_LINK contains pollutants not listed in ",
        "OBSERVED_POLLS:\n  ",
        paste(
          invalid_observed_poll_links,
          collapse = '\n  '
        )
      ),
      call. = FALSE
    )
  }
}

# MOBS evaluation.

if (MOBS_EVALUATION_OUTPUTS) {

  checkmate::assert_subset(
    MOBS_EVAL_VARS,
    choices = OBSERVED_POLLS,
    empty.ok = FALSE,
    .var.name = 'MOBS_EVAL_VARS'
  )

  checkmate::assert_number(
    MOBS_THRESHOLD,
    lower = 0,
    upper = 100,
    .var.name = 'MOBS_THRESHOLD'
  )

  checkmate::assert_subset(
    MODSTATS_STATS,
    choices = c(
      'n',
      'FAC2',
      'MB',
      'NMB',
      'RMSE',
      'r_spearman',
      'r_pearson'
    ),
    empty.ok = FALSE,
    .var.name = 'MODSTATS_STATS'
  )

  checkmate::assert_string(
    MOBS_GROUPING_VAR,
    null.ok = TRUE,
    .var.name = 'MOBS_GROUPING_VAR'
  )

  checkmate::assert_string(
    MOBS_GROUPING_VAR_LABEL,
    min.chars = 1,
    .var.name = 'MOBS_GROUPING_VAR_LABEL'
  )

  checkmate::assert_character(
    MOBS_GROUPING_VAR_COLOURS,
    min.len = 1,
    any.missing = FALSE,
    names = 'unique',
    .var.name = 'MOBS_GROUPING_VAR_COLOURS'
  )
}

# MOBS model-statistics tables.

if (PRINT_MODSTATS_TABLES) {

  if (!is.null(MOBS_MODSTATS_VAR_FILL)) {

    checkmate::assert_string(
      MOBS_MODSTATS_VAR_FILL,
      .var.name = 'MOBS_MODSTATS_VAR_FILL'
    )

    if (MOBS_MODSTATS_VAR_FILL != 'params_file') {

      fill_valid = tryCatch(
        {
          grDevices::col2rgb(
            MOBS_MODSTATS_VAR_FILL
          )
          TRUE
        },
        error = function(e) {
          FALSE
        }
      )

      if (!fill_valid) {
        stop(
          'MOBS_MODSTATS_VAR_FILL must be NULL, "params_file", ',
          'or a valid R colour.',
          call. = FALSE
        )
      }
    }
  }
}

# MOBS time series.

if (PLOT_MOBS_TSERIES) {

  checkmate::assert_subset(
    MOBS_TSERIES_VARS,
    choices = OBSERVED_POLLS,
    empty.ok = FALSE,
    .var.name = 'MOBS_TSERIES_VARS'
  )

  checkmate::assert_choice(
    MOBS_TSERIES_SUMMARY_TIME,
    choices = c(
      'day',
      'month'
    ),
    .var.name = 'MOBS_TSERIES_SUMMARY_TIME'
  )

  checkmate::assert_choice(
    MOBS_TSERIES_SUMMARY_STAT,
    choices = c(
      'mean',
      'median',
      'max',
      'min',
      'sum'
    ),
    .var.name = 'MOBS_TSERIES_SUMMARY_STAT'
  )
  
  checkmate::assert_flag(
    PLOT_REF_TSERIES,
    .var.name = 'PLOT_REF_TSERIES'
  )

  checkmate::assert_character(
    MOBS_TSERIES_LABELS,
    len = 3,
    names = 'unique',
    .var.name = 'MOBS_TSERIES_LABELS'
  )
  
  checkmate::assert_character(
    MOBS_TSERIES_LABELS,
    len = 3,
    any.missing = TRUE,
    names = 'unique',
    .var.name = 'MOBS_TSERIES_LABELS'
  )
  
  checkmate::assert_set_equal(
    names(MOBS_TSERIES_LABELS),
    c(
      'obs',
      'mod',
      'ref_mod'
    ),
    .var.name = 'names(MOBS_TSERIES_LABELS)'
  )

  checkmate::assert_subset(
    names(MOBS_TSERIES_LABELS),
    choices = c(
      'obs',
      'mod',
      'ref_mod'
    ),
    empty.ok = FALSE,
    .var.name = 'names(MOBS_TSERIES_LABELS)'
  )

  checkmate::assert_choice(
    MOBS_TSERIES_OBS_STYLE,
    choices = c(
      'ribbon',
      'line'
    ),
    .var.name = 'MOBS_TSERIES_OBS_STYLE'
  )

  checkmate::assert_number(
    MOBS_TSERIES_OBS_ALPHA,
    lower = 0,
    upper = 1,
    .var.name = 'MOBS_TSERIES_OBS_ALPHA'
  )

  checkmate::assert_list(
    MOBS_REF_PLOT_PARAMS,
    names = 'unique',
    .var.name = 'MOBS_REF_PLOT_PARAMS'
  )

  checkmate::assert_subset(
    names(MOBS_REF_PLOT_PARAMS),
    choices = c(
      'colour',
      'linetype',
      'linewidth'
    ),
    empty.ok = FALSE,
    .var.name = 'names(MOBS_REF_PLOT_PARAMS)'
  )

  checkmate::assert_flag(
    MOBS_USE_LOCAL_TIME,
    .var.name = 'MOBS_USE_LOCAL_TIME'
  )

  checkmate::assert_flag(
    PLOT_ALL_MOBS_VARS,
    .var.name = 'PLOT_ALL_MOBS_VARS'
  )

  checkmate::assert_int(
    PPP,
    lower = 1,
    .var.name = 'PPP'
  )

  if (isTRUE(MOBS_USE_LOCAL_TIME)) {
    checkmate::assert_file_exists(
      TIMEZONE_FILE_PTH,
      .var.name = 'TIMEZONE_FILE_PTH'
    )
  }

  if (!is.null(MOBS_STATION_REPORT_TSERIES)) {

    checkmate::assert_list(
      MOBS_STATION_REPORT_TSERIES,
      names = 'unique',
      .var.name = 'MOBS_STATION_REPORT_TSERIES'
    )

    purrr::iwalk(
      MOBS_STATION_REPORT_TSERIES,
      function(site, site_name) {

        checkmate::assert_list(
          site,
          names = 'unique',
          .var.name = paste0(
            'MOBS_STATION_REPORT_TSERIES[[',
            site_name,
            ']]'
          )
        )

        checkmate::assert_string(
          site$code,
          min.chars = 1,
          .var.name = paste0(

          )

        if (!is.null(site$resolution)) {

            ),

              'MOBS_STATION_REPORT_TSERIES[[',

            )
          )
        }

        if (!is.null(site$vars)) {
          checkmate::assert_subset(
            site$vars,
            choices = MOBS_TSERIES_VARS,
            empty.ok = FALSE,
            .var.name = paste0(
              'MOBS_STATION_REPORT_TSERIES[[',
              site_name,
              ']]$vars'
            )
          )
        }
      }
    )
  }

  if (!is.null(MOBS_STATION_REPORT_TSERIES_PERIOD)) {

    checkmate::assert_character(
      MOBS_STATION_REPORT_TSERIES_PERIOD,
      len = 2,
      any.missing = FALSE,
      .var.name = 'MOBS_STATION_REPORT_TSERIES_PERIOD'
    )
  }
}

# MOBS scatter plots.

if (PLOT_MOBS_SCATTER_PLOTS) {

  if (!is.null(MOBS_SCATTER_POINT_COLOUR)) {

    checkmate::assert_string(
      MOBS_SCATTER_POINT_COLOUR,

}

# MOBS model-statistics maps.

if (PLOT_MOBS_MODSTAT_MAPS) {

  checkmate::assert_subset(

  checkmate::assert_list(

  )
}
```

```{r emissions_setup, eval = CHECK_EMISSIONS}

task_start = Sys.time()

# EMEP emission variables used by all emission checks

emission_check_vars = paste0(
  'Emis_mgm2_',
  EMISSION_CHECK_POLLS
)

emission_check_var_lookup = purrr::set_names(
  emission_check_vars,
  unname(
    inventory_pollutant_lookup[
      EMISSION_CHECK_POLLS
    ]
  )
)

# if the EMEP grid is in the region geofiles directory then remove it 
emep_grid_geofile = fs::path(
  REGION_GEODATA_DIR,
  'EMEP_grid_01deg_shp.gpkg'
)

# Prepare domain-specific information
#
# domain_setup defines which model domains are available. This allows an
# arbitrary number of nested domains (e.g. outer, middle, inner).
#
# EMISSION_CHECK_REGIONS can optionally restrict the regions checked within
# each domain. NULL means that all regions intersecting that domain are used.

emission_check_setup = domain_setup %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    !purrr::map_lgl(
      test_dir,
      is.null
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    emission_regions = purrr::map(
      domain,
      ~ EMISSION_CHECK_REGIONS[[.x]] %||% 'all'
    ),
    test_file = purrr::map(
      test_dir,
      ~ select_emep_file_from_dir(
        EMEP_dir = .x,
        file_tag = 'fullrun'
      )
    ),
    region_geofiles = purrr::map(
      emission_regions,
      ~ get_region_geofiles(
        geodata_dir = REGION_GEODATA_DIR,
        regions = .x,
        exclude_files = emep_grid_geofile
      )
    )
  )

# Create output columns

emission_check_setup$domain_region_geofiles =
  vector(
    'list',
    nrow(emission_check_setup)
  )

emission_check_setup$model_region_emissions =
  vector(
    'list',
    nrow(emission_check_setup)
  )

# Extract regional EMEP emission totals

set_parallel_plan(
  workers_requested = worker_cap,
  max_workers = 16,
  prefer_multicore = FALSE
)

workers_used = unclass(future::nbrOfWorkers())

qaqc_parallel_info[['Per region emission extraction']] = tibble::tibble(
  section = 'Per region emission extraction',
  workers = workers_used
)

for (i in seq_len(nrow(emission_check_setup))) {
  
  this_row = emission_check_setup[i, ]
  
  this_test_file = this_row$test_file[[1]]
  
  # Determine which regions intersect the model domain.
  #
  # No inventory coverage threshold is applied here because RunLog and
  # NetCDF comparisons can use regions that are only partly within the
  # model domain. coverage_prop is retained so that the inventory
  # comparison can subsequently apply EMISSION_INVENTORY_MIN_COVERAGE.
  
  this_region_geofiles = filter_region_geofiles_to_domain(
    region_geofiles = this_row$region_geofiles[[1]],
    emep_file = this_test_file,
    emep_crs = TEST_CRS,
    min_coverage = 0
  )
  
  emission_check_setup$domain_region_geofiles[[i]] =
    this_region_geofiles
  
  # Read EMEP emission variables
  
  this_emep_data = read_emep(
    emep_fname = this_test_file,
    emep_var = unname(
      emission_check_var_lookup
    ),
    emep_crs = TEST_CRS,
    proxy = FALSE,
    driver = 'gdal'
  )
  
  # Read grid-cell area
  
  this_area_data = read_emep(
    emep_fname = this_test_file,
    emep_var = 'Area_Grid_km2',
    emep_crs = TEST_CRS,
    proxy = FALSE,
    driver = 'gdal'
  )
  
  # Get emission-variable units
  
  this_var_units = get_nc_var_units(
    nc_file = this_test_file,
    vars = unname(
      emission_check_var_lookup
    )
  )
  
  # Calculate emission totals for each region.
  #
  # Regions extending beyond the model domain are naturally restricted
  # to the part represented by the EMEP grid.
  
  this_model_region_emissions = furrr::future_pmap_dfr(
    this_region_geofiles,
    function(region_id, fpath, ...) {
      
      area_mask_sf = sf::st_read(
        fpath,
        quiet = TRUE
      )
      
      masked_emep_data = apply_domain_mask(
        stars_object = this_emep_data,
        domain_mask = area_mask_sf
      )
      
      masked_area_data = apply_domain_mask(
        stars_object = this_area_data,
        domain_mask = area_mask_sf
      )
      
      purrr::imap_dfr(
        emission_check_var_lookup,
        function(var_name, pollutant) {
          
          summarise_emep_var(
            emep_stars = masked_emep_data,
            area_stars = masked_area_data,
            var_name = var_name,
            var_unit = unname(
              this_var_units[var_name]
            ),
            total_out_unit = 'Gg'
          ) %>%
            dplyr::transmute(
              pollutant = pollutant,
              model_value = value,
              model_unit = unit
            )
        }
      ) %>%
        dplyr::mutate(
          region = region_id,
          .before = 1
        )
    },
    .options = furrr::furrr_options(
      seed = TRUE,
      scheduling = 1,
      packages = c(
        'dplyr',
        'purrr',
        'sf',
        'stars'
      )
    )
  )
  
  emission_check_setup$model_region_emissions[[i]] =
    this_model_region_emissions
}

future::plan(
  future::sequential
)
```

```{r official_inventory_check, eval = CHECK_EMISSIONS, results = 'hide'}

# Create a tibble with data needed specifically for the inventory check

emission_inventory_check_setup = emission_check_setup %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    inventory_path = purrr::map(
      domain,
      ~ EMISSION_INVENTORY_PTH[[.x]]
    ),
    inventory_type = purrr::map_chr(
      domain,
      ~ EMISSION_INVENTORY_TYPE[[.x]] %||% NA_character_
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    !purrr::map_lgl(
      inventory_path,
      is.null
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    inventory_data = purrr::map2(
      inventory_type,
      inventory_path,
      function(inventory_type, inventory_path) {
        
        if (inventory_type == 'emep') {
          
          read_emep_country_inventory_file(
            inventory_path
          )
          
        } else if (inventory_type == 'naei') {
          
          read_processed_naei_inventory_file(
            fpath = inventory_path,
            inventory_year = test_emiss_year
          )
          
        } else {
          
          stop(
            glue::glue(
              "Emission inventory type '{inventory_type}' is not supported."
            ),
            call. = FALSE
          )
        }
      }
    )
  )

emission_inventory_check_results =
  emission_inventory_check_setup

emission_inventory_check_results$filtered_inventory_data =
  vector(
    'list',
    nrow(emission_inventory_check_results)
  )

emission_inventory_check_results$inventory_check =
  vector(
    'list',
    nrow(emission_inventory_check_results)
  )

for (i in seq_len(nrow(emission_inventory_check_results))) {
  
  this_row = emission_inventory_check_results[i, ]
  
  # Restrict inventory comparison to regions sufficiently covered by
  # the model domain
  
  this_region_geofiles =
    this_row$domain_region_geofiles[[1]] %>%
    dplyr::filter(
      coverage_prop >=
        EMISSION_INVENTORY_MIN_COVERAGE
    )
  
  this_model_region_emissions =
    this_row$model_region_emissions[[1]]
  
  # Prepare inventory data in a common format
  
  if (this_row$inventory_type == 'emep') {
    
    this_inventory_data = this_row$inventory_data[[1]] %>%
      dplyr::filter(
        sector == 'NATIONAL TOTAL',
        year == test_emiss_year,
        pollutant %in% names(
          emission_check_var_lookup
        ),
        iso2 %in% this_region_geofiles$region_id
      ) %>%
      dplyr::select(
        region = iso2,
        year,
        pollutant,
        inventory_unit = unit,
        inventory_value = value
      )
    
  } else if (this_row$inventory_type == 'naei') {
    
    this_inventory_data = this_row$inventory_data[[1]] %>%
      dplyr::filter(
        year == test_emiss_year,
        pollutant %in% names(
          emission_check_var_lookup
        )
      ) %>%
      dplyr::mutate(
        region = 'GB',
        .before = 1
      ) %>%
      dplyr::filter(
        region %in%
          this_region_geofiles$region_id
      ) %>%
      dplyr::select(
        region,
        year,
        pollutant,
        inventory_unit = unit,
        inventory_value = value
      )
  }
  
  emission_inventory_check_results$filtered_inventory_data[[i]] =
    this_inventory_data
  
  # Compare EMEP output emissions with the inventory
  
  this_inventory_check =
    this_model_region_emissions %>%
    dplyr::filter(
      region %in%
        this_inventory_data$region
    ) %>%
    dplyr::left_join(
      this_inventory_data,
      by = c(
        'region',
        'pollutant'
      )
    ) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      abs_diff =
        model_value -
        inventory_value,
      rel_diff = dplyr::if_else(
        inventory_value == 0,
        NA_real_,
        100 *
          (model_value - inventory_value) /
          inventory_value
      )
    )
  
  emission_inventory_check_results$inventory_check[[i]] =
    this_inventory_check
}

readr::write_rds(
  emission_inventory_check_results,
  fs::path(
    QAQC_DIR,
    'Data',
    'emission_inventory_check_results.rds'
  )
)


emission_inventory_plots_static = NULL
emission_inventory_plots_interactive = NULL


# Create static plots when required for the report or standalone outputs

if (
  REPORT_STYLE == 'static' ||
  SAVE_STATIC_OUTPUTS
) {
  
  emission_inventory_plots_static =
    emission_inventory_check_results$inventory_check %>%
    purrr::map(
      ~ if (
        is.null(.x) ||
        nrow(.x) == 0
      ) {
        NULL
      } else {
        plot_emission_comparison_diff(
          emiss_data = .x,
          comparison = 'inventory',
          threshold = EMISSION_COMPARISON_THRESHOLD,
          interactive = FALSE
        )
      }
    )
  
  names(emission_inventory_plots_static) =
    emission_inventory_check_results$domain
}


# Create interactive plots when required for the report

if (REPORT_STYLE == 'interactive') {
  
  emission_inventory_plots_interactive =
    emission_inventory_check_results$inventory_check %>%
    purrr::map(
      ~ if (
        is.null(.x) ||
        nrow(.x) == 0
      ) {
        NULL
      } else {
        plot_emission_comparison_diff(
          emiss_data = .x,
          comparison = 'inventory',
          threshold = EMISSION_COMPARISON_THRESHOLD,
          interactive = TRUE
        )
      }
    )
  
  names(emission_inventory_plots_interactive) =
    emission_inventory_check_results$domain
}


# Save the static plots in a PDF

if (SAVE_STATIC_OUTPUTS) {
  
  purrr::iwalk(
    emission_inventory_plots_static,
    function(domain_plots, domain_id) {
      
      if (is.null(domain_plots)) {
        return(invisible(NULL))
      }
      
      domain_info = emission_inventory_check_results %>%
        dplyr::filter(
          domain == domain_id
        )
      
      domain_name = domain_info %>%
        dplyr::pull(
          domain_name
        ) %>%
        dplyr::first()
      
      emep_dir = domain_info %>%
        dplyr::pull(
          test_dir
        ) %>%
        purrr::pluck(1)
      
      inventory_file = domain_info %>%
        dplyr::pull(
          inventory_path
        ) %>%
        purrr::pluck(1)
      
      pdf_file = fs::path(
        plots_pth_out,
        paste0(
          domain_name,
          '_emiss_inventory_plots.pdf'
        )
      )
      
      grDevices::pdf(
        file = pdf_file,
        width = 10,
        height = 6
      )
      
      purrr::iwalk(
        domain_plots,
        function(plot, pollutant) {
          
          pollutant_title = format_inventory_pollutant(
            pollutant,
            output = 'plain'
          )
          
          emission_inventory =
            emission_inventory_check_results %>%
            dplyr::filter(
              domain == domain_id
            ) %>%
            dplyr::pull(
              inventory_type
            ) %>%
            dplyr::first() %>%
            stringr::str_to_upper()
          
          combined_plot =
            plot$absolute +
            plot$relative +
            patchwork::plot_layout(
              ncol = 2
            ) +
            patchwork::plot_annotation(
              title = glue::glue(
                '{pollutant_title} — {emission_inventory} emission inventory'
              ),
              caption = paste0(
                'EMEP output directory: ',
                emep_dir,
                '\n',
                'Emission inventory file: ',
                inventory_file
              ),
              theme = ggplot2::theme(
                plot.caption = ggplot2::element_text(
                  size = 7,
                  hjust = 0
                )
              )
            )
          
          print(combined_plot)
        }
      )
      
      grDevices::dev.off()
    }
  )
}
```

child_text = character()

for (domain_i in seq_along(emission_inventory_report_plots)) {

  domain_id =
    names(emission_inventory_report_plots)[[domain_i]]

  domain_plots =
    emission_inventory_report_plots[[domain_i]]

  if (
    is.null(domain_plots) ||
    length(domain_plots) == 0
  ) {
    next
  }

  domain_name = emission_inventory_check_results %>%
    dplyr::filter(
      domain == domain_id
    ) %>%
    dplyr::pull(
      domain_name
    ) %>%
    dplyr::first()

  # Domain heading --------------------------------------------------------

  child_text = c(
    child_text,
    paste0(
      '## ',
      domain_name,
      if (REPORT_STYLE == 'interactive') {
        paste0(
          ' {.tabset #emission-inventory-',
          domain_id,
          '}'
        )
      } else {
        paste0(
          ' {#emission-inventory-',
          domain_id,
          '}'
        )
      }
    ),
    ''
  )

  for (pollutant_i in seq_along(domain_plots)) {

    pollutant_id =
      names(domain_plots)[[pollutant_i]]

    pollutant_label = format_inventory_pollutant(
      pollutant_id,
      output = 'html'
    )

    # Pollutant heading ---------------------------------------------------

    child_text = c(
      child_text,
      paste0(
        '### ',
        pollutant_label,
        ' {#emission-inventory-',
        domain_id,
        '-pollutant-',
        pollutant_i,
        '}'
      ),
      ''
    )
    
    # Plot height ---------------------------------------------------------

    if (REPORT_STYLE == 'interactive') {
  
      this_chunk_header =
        '```{r, echo=FALSE}'
  
    } else {
  
      n_regions = emission_inventory_check_results %>%
        dplyr::filter(
          domain == domain_id
        ) %>%
        dplyr::pull(
          inventory_check
        ) %>%
        purrr::pluck(1) %>%
        dplyr::filter(
          pollutant == pollutant_id,
          !is.na(rel_diff)
        ) %>%
        nrow()
  
      static_plot_height = max(
        4,
        0.18 * n_regions + 1.5
      )
  
      this_chunk_header = glue::glue(
        '```{{r, echo=FALSE, fig.height={round(static_plot_height, 1)}}}'
      )
    }

    # Plot ----------------------------------------------------------------

    child_text = c(
      child_text,
      this_chunk_header,
      paste0(
        'emission_inventory_report_plots[[',
        domain_i,
        ']][[',
        pollutant_i,
        ']]'
      ),
      '```',
      ''
    )
  }
}


cat(
  knitr::knit_child(
    text = child_text,
    envir = environment(),
    quiet = TRUE
  ),
  sep = '\n'
)

```{r RunLog_emission_check, eval = CHECK_EMISSIONS, results = 'hide'}
# Process RunLog emissions for each Test domain

emission_runlog_check_results = emission_check_setup

emission_runlog_check_results$runlog_emissions =
  vector(
    'list',
    nrow(emission_runlog_check_results)
  )

emission_runlog_check_results$runlog_check =
  vector(
    'list',
    nrow(emission_runlog_check_results)
  )


for (i in seq_len(nrow(emission_runlog_check_results))) {
  
  this_row = emission_runlog_check_results[i, ]
  
  runlog_path = fs::path(
    this_row$test_dir[[1]],
    'RunLog.out'
  )
  
  
  # Read and summarise RunLog emissions
  
  if (!fs::file_exists(runlog_path)) {
    
    warning(
      paste0(
        "RunLog.out not found: ",
        runlog_path
      )
    )
    
    next
  }
  
  this_runlog_emissions = extract_runlog_emissions(
    runlog_path
  ) %>%
    summarise_runlog_emissions()
  
  emission_runlog_check_results$runlog_emissions[[i]] =
    this_runlog_emissions
  
  
  # Compare RunLog emissions with EMEP output emissions
  
  this_model_region_emissions =
    this_row$model_region_emissions[[1]]
  
  this_runlog_check = this_runlog_emissions %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      pollutant = unname(
        inventory_pollutant_lookup[
          pollutant
        ]
      )
    ) %>%
    dplyr::rename(
      runlog_value = emission
    ) %>%
    dplyr::left_join(
      this_model_region_emissions,
      by = c(
        'region',
        'pollutant'
      )
    ) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      abs_diff =
        model_value -
        runlog_value,
      rel_diff = dplyr::if_else(
        runlog_value == 0,
        NA_real_,
        100 *
          (model_value - runlog_value) /
          runlog_value
      )
    )
  
  emission_runlog_check_results$runlog_check[[i]] =
    this_runlog_check
}
```

# Emission NetCDF setup ---------------------------------------------------

if (is.null(EMISSION_NETCDF_FILES)) {

  # Extract emission directory from run script

  emis_dir = get_run_script_var(
    RUN_SCRIPT_PTH,
    'emis_dir'
  )

  # Extract emission NetCDF files from config

  emission_netcdf_files = get_emission_source_files(
    CONFIG_FILE_PTH
  )

} else {

  emission_netcdf_files = tibble::tibble(
    source_id = seq_along(EMISSION_NETCDF_FILES),
    resolved_fpath = EMISSION_NETCDF_FILES
  )
}

emission_netcdf_vars = purrr::pmap_dfr(
  emission_netcdf_files,
  function(
      source_id,
      resolved_fpath,
      ...
  ) {

    get_emep_combined_emission_netcdf_vars(
      nc_file = resolved_fpath,
      pollutants = EMISSION_CHECK_POLLS
    ) %>%
      dplyr::mutate(
        source_id = source_id,
        resolved_fpath = resolved_fpath,
        .before = 1
      )
  }
)

emission_netcdf_check_results =
  emission_check_setup

emission_netcdf_check_results$netcdf_emissions =
  vector(
    'list',
    nrow(emission_netcdf_check_results)
  )


emission_netcdf_check_results$netcdf_check =
  vector(
    'list',
    nrow(emission_netcdf_check_results)
  )


set_parallel_plan(
  workers_requested = worker_cap,
  max_workers = 16,
  prefer_multicore = FALSE
)

workers_used = unclass(future::nbrOfWorkers())

qaqc_parallel_info[['NetCDF emission extraction']] = tibble::tibble(
  section = 'NetCDF emission extraction',
  workers = workers_used
)

for (i in seq_len(nrow(emission_netcdf_check_results))) {

  this_row = emission_netcdf_check_results[i, ]

  this_test_file = this_row$test_file[[1]]

  this_regions =
    this_row$domain_region_geofiles[[1]]$region_id

  # Get rectangular extent of this EMEP domain

  this_domain_crop = get_emep_domain_polygon(
    emep_file = this_test_file,
    emep_crs = TEST_CRS
  )

  # Region × pollutant combinations to process

  this_netcdf_vars = emission_netcdf_vars %>%
    dplyr::filter(
      region %in% this_regions
    ) %>%
    dplyr::distinct(
      region,
      pollutant
    )

  # Calculate emission totals from input NetCDF files

  this_netcdf_emissions = furrr::future_pmap_dfr(
    this_netcdf_vars,
    function(
        region,
        pollutant
    ) {

      get_emep_combined_emission_netcdf_total(
        region_nm = region,
        pollutant_nm = pollutant,
        emission_netcdf_vars = emission_netcdf_vars,
        sectors = EMISSION_NETCDF_SECTORS,
        domain_crop = this_domain_crop
      )
    },
    .options = furrr::furrr_options(
      seed = TRUE,
      scheduling = 1,
      packages = c(
        'dplyr',
        'purrr',
        'sf',
        'stars',
        'ncdf4'
      )
    )
  ) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      pollutant = unname(
        inventory_pollutant_lookup[
          pollutant
        ]
      ),
      netcdf_value = emission_value / 1000,
      netcdf_unit = 'Gg'
    ) %>%
      dplyr::select(
        region,
        pollutant,
        netcdf_value,
        netcdf_unit
      )

  emission_netcdf_check_results$netcdf_emissions[[i]] =
    this_netcdf_emissions

  # Compare EMEP output emissions with input NetCDF emissions

  this_model_region_emissions =
    this_row$model_region_emissions[[1]]

  this_netcdf_check =
    this_model_region_emissions %>%
    dplyr::inner_join(
      this_netcdf_emissions,
      by = c(
        'region',
        'pollutant'
      )
    ) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      abs_diff =
        model_value -
        netcdf_value,
      rel_diff = dplyr::if_else(
        netcdf_value == 0,
        NA_real_,
        100 *
          (model_value - netcdf_value) /
          netcdf_value
      )
    )

  emission_netcdf_check_results$netcdf_check[[i]] =
    this_netcdf_check
}

future::plan(
  future::sequential
)

# the following is the chunk header for the following chunk once this functionality is enabled
