```{asis emission_netcdf_user_text, eval = FALSE}
# Emission - NetCDF comparison

The model annual emission totals are compared with the corresponding emission
totals calculated from the input emission NetCDF files. Differences exceeding
`r EMISSION_COMPARISON_THRESHOLD`% are highlighted by the shaded threshold
range.
```

```{r emission_netcdf_plots, echo=FALSE, eval=FALSE, results='asis'}
#normally echo=CHECK_EMISSIONS

# Create plots ------------------------------------------------------------

emission_netcdf_plots_static =
  emission_netcdf_check_results$netcdf_check %>%
  purrr::set_names(
    emission_netcdf_check_results$domain
  ) %>%
  purrr::map(
    ~ plot_emission_comparison_diff(
      emiss_data = .x,
      comparison = 'netcdf',
      threshold = EMISSION_COMPARISON_THRESHOLD,
      interactive = FALSE
    )
  )

emission_netcdf_plots_interactive =
  emission_netcdf_check_results$netcdf_check %>%
  purrr::set_names(
    emission_netcdf_check_results$domain
  ) %>%
  purrr::map(
    ~ plot_emission_comparison_diff(
      emiss_data = .x,
      comparison = 'netcdf',
      threshold = EMISSION_COMPARISON_THRESHOLD,
      interactive = TRUE
    )
  )


# Select report style -----------------------------------------------------

if (REPORT_STYLE == 'interactive') {

  emission_netcdf_plots =
    emission_netcdf_plots_interactive

} else {

  emission_netcdf_plots =
    emission_netcdf_plots_static
}


# Combine absolute and relative plots ------------------------------------

emission_netcdf_report_plots =
  purrr::imap(
    emission_netcdf_plots,
    function(domain_plots, domain_id) {

      if (
        is.null(domain_plots) ||
        length(domain_plots) == 0
      ) {
        return(NULL)
      }

      purrr::imap(
        domain_plots,
        function(plot, pollutant) {

          pollutant_title = format_inventory_pollutant(
            pollutant,
            output = 'plain'
          )

          plot_title = glue::glue(
            '{pollutant_title} — NetCDF emission comparison'
          )

          if (REPORT_STYLE == 'interactive') {

            combined_plot = plotly::subplot(
              plot$absolute,
              plot$relative,
              nrows = 1,
              shareY = FALSE,
              margin = 0.08,
              titleX = TRUE,
              titleY = TRUE
            ) %>%
              plotly::layout(
                xaxis = list(
                  domain = c(
                    0,
                    0.47
                  )
                ),
                xaxis2 = list(
                  domain = c(
                    0.53,
                    1
                  )
                )
              )

            add_plotly_interactive_controls(
              p = combined_plot,
              plot_title = plot_title,
              export_width = 1200,
              export_height = 600
            )

          } else {

            plot$absolute +
              plot$relative +
              patchwork::plot_layout(
                ncol = 2
              )
          }
        }
      )
    }
  ) %>%
  purrr::compact()


# Build report section ----------------------------------------------------

child_text = character()

for (domain_i in seq_along(emission_netcdf_report_plots)) {

  domain_id =
    names(emission_netcdf_report_plots)[[domain_i]]

  domain_plots =
    emission_netcdf_report_plots[[domain_i]]

  if (
    is.null(domain_plots) ||
    length(domain_plots) == 0
  ) {
    next
  }

  domain_name = emission_netcdf_check_results %>%
    dplyr::filter(
      domain == domain_id
    ) %>%
    dplyr::pull(
      domain_name
    ) %>%
    dplyr::first()

  # Domain heading --------------------------------------------------------

  child_text = c(
    child_text,
    paste0(
      '## ',
      domain_name,
      if (REPORT_STYLE == 'interactive') {
        paste0(
          ' {.tabset #emission-netcdf-',
          domain_id,
          '}'
        )
      } else {
        paste0(
          ' {#emission-netcdf-',
          domain_id,
          '}'
        )
      }
    ),
    ''
  )

  for (pollutant_i in seq_along(domain_plots)) {

    pollutant_id =
      names(domain_plots)[[pollutant_i]]

    pollutant_label = format_inventory_pollutant(
      pollutant_id,
      output = 'html'
    )

    # Pollutant heading ---------------------------------------------------

    child_text = c(
      child_text,
      paste0(
        '### ',
        pollutant_label,
        ' {#emission-netcdf-',
        domain_id,
        '-pollutant-',
        pollutant_i,
        '}'
      ),
      ''
    )

    # Plot height ---------------------------------------------------------

    if (REPORT_STYLE == 'interactive') {

      this_chunk_header =
        '```{r, echo=FALSE}'

    } else {

      n_regions = emission_netcdf_check_results %>%
        dplyr::filter(
          domain == domain_id
        ) %>%
        dplyr::pull(
          netcdf_check
        ) %>%
        purrr::pluck(1) %>%
        dplyr::filter(
          pollutant == pollutant_id,
          !is.na(rel_diff)
        ) %>%
        nrow()

      static_plot_height = max(
        4,
        0.18 * n_regions + 1.5
      )

      this_chunk_header = glue::glue(
        '```{{r, echo=FALSE, fig.height={round(static_plot_height, 1)}}}'
      )
    }

    # Plot ----------------------------------------------------------------

    child_text = c(
      child_text,
      this_chunk_header,
      paste0(
        'emission_netcdf_report_plots[[',
        domain_i,
        ']][[',
        pollutant_i,
        ']]'
      ),
      '```',
      ''
    )
  }
}


cat(
  knitr::knit_child(
    text = child_text,
    envir = environment(),
    quiet = TRUE
  ),
  sep = '\n'
)

  runtime_seconds = as.numeric(

      Sys.time(),

)

``` {asis emiss_temporal_user_text, echo = CHECK_EMISSION_TEMPORAL, eval = CHECK_EMISSION_TEMPORAL}
# Emission Temporal Variation

This section examines the temporal variation in EMEP emissions over the model
run. Emission totals are shown for the full model domain and, where specified,
for individual regions at the available temporal resolutions.
```

```{r Temporal_emission_check, eval = CHECK_EMISSION_TEMPORAL, results = 'hide'}

task_start = Sys.time()

temporal_emission_vars = paste0(
  'Emis_mgm2_',
  EMISSION_TEMPORAL_POLLS
)

emission_temporal_check_setup = domain_setup %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    temporal_regions = purrr::map(
      domain,
      ~ EMISSION_TEMPORAL_REGIONS[[.x]]
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    !purrr::map_lgl(temporal_regions, is.null)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    test_temporal_file = purrr::map_chr(
      test_dir,
      ~ select_emep_file_from_dir(
        EMEP_dir = .x,
        file_tag = EMISSION_TEMPORAL_FILE_TAG
      )
    ),
    ref_temporal_file = purrr::map(
      ref_dir,
      function(this_dir) {

        if (is.null(this_dir)) {
          return(NULL)
        }

        select_emep_file_from_dir(
          EMEP_dir = this_dir,
          file_tag = EMISSION_TEMPORAL_FILE_TAG
        )
      }
    ),
    region_geofiles = purrr::map(
      temporal_regions,
      function(regions) {

        regional_selection = setdiff(
          regions,
          'full_domain'
        )

        if (length(regional_selection) == 0) {
          return(
            tibble::tibble(
              region_id = character(),
              fpath = character()
            )
          )
        }

        get_region_geofiles(
          geodata_dir = REGION_GEODATA_DIR,
          regions = regional_selection
        )
      }
    )
  )

emission_temporal_check_results =
  emission_temporal_check_setup

emission_temporal_check_results$temporal_emissions =
  vector(
    'list',
    nrow(emission_temporal_check_results)
  )


for (i in seq_len(nrow(emission_temporal_check_results))) {

  this_row = emission_temporal_check_results[i, ]

  test_area_file = select_emep_file_from_dir(
    EMEP_dir = this_row$test_dir[[1]],
    file_tag = 'fullrun'
  )

  ref_area_file = if (!is.null(this_row$ref_dir[[1]])) {
    select_emep_file_from_dir(
      EMEP_dir = this_row$ref_dir[[1]],
      file_tag = 'fullrun'
    )
  } else {
    NULL
  }

  # Test run

  test_emissions = summarise_temporal_emep(
    emep_file = this_row$test_temporal_file[[1]],
    area_file = test_area_file,
    region_geofiles = this_row$region_geofiles[[1]],
    include_full_domain = 'full_domain' %in%
      this_row$temporal_regions[[1]],
    emep_crs = TEST_CRS,
    region_min_coverage = EMISSION_INVENTORY_MIN_COVERAGE,
    configured_vars = temporal_emission_vars,
    var_params_list = EMEP_VAR_PARAMS_LIST
  ) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      run = 'test',
      resolution = EMISSION_TEMPORAL_FILE_TAG,
      .before = 1
    )

  # Reference run

  ref_emissions = tibble::tibble()

  if (
    !is.null(this_row$ref_temporal_file[[1]]) &&
    !is.null(ref_area_file)
  ) {

    ref_emissions = summarise_temporal_emep(
      emep_file = this_row$ref_temporal_file[[1]],
      area_file = ref_area_file,
      region_geofiles = this_row$region_geofiles[[1]],
      include_full_domain = 'full_domain' %in%
        this_row$temporal_regions[[1]],
      emep_crs = REF_CRS,
      region_min_coverage = EMISSION_INVENTORY_MIN_COVERAGE,
      configured_vars = temporal_emission_vars,
      var_params_list = EMEP_VAR_PARAMS_LIST
    ) %>%
      dplyr::mutate(
        run = 'ref',
        resolution = EMISSION_TEMPORAL_FILE_TAG,
        .before = 1
      )
  }

  emission_temporal_check_results$temporal_emissions[[i]] =
    dplyr::bind_rows(
      test_emissions,
      ref_emissions
    )
}

emission_var_groups_report = emission_var_groups

if (!PLOT_NATURAL_EMISSION_TEMPORAL) {
  emission_var_groups_report$natural = NULL
}


emission_var_labels = unique(
  unlist(
    emission_var_groups_report,
    use.names = FALSE
  )
)

emission_var_labels = stats::setNames(
  emission_var_labels,
  emission_var_labels
)


make_emission_temporal_plots = function(
    interactive = TRUE
) {

  emission_temporal_check_results$temporal_emissions %>%
    purrr::map(
      function(domain_data) {

        region_plots = domain_data %>%
          split(.$location_id) %>%
          purrr::imap(
            function(region_data, region_name) {

              group_plots = emission_var_groups_report %>%
                purrr::map(
                  function(group_vars) {

                    group_data = region_data %>%
                      dplyr::filter(
                        variable %in% group_vars
                      )

                    if (nrow(group_data) == 0) {
                      return(NULL)
                    }

                    comparison_data =
                      prepare_temporal_comparison_data(
                        group_data
                      )

                    list(
                      test = plot_temporal_profiles(
                        temporal_data = group_data,
                        var_params_list = EMEP_VAR_PARAMS_LIST,
                        run_labels = RUN_LABELS,
                        var_labels = emission_var_labels,
                        palette = EMISSION_PALETTE,
                        value_label = 'Emissions',
                        plot_type = 'test',
                        value_mode = 'fraction',
                        group_var = 'variable',
                        region_label = region_name,
                        year = test_emiss_year,
                        interactive = interactive
                      ),

                      ref = if (
                        any(group_data$run == 'ref')
                      ) {
                        plot_temporal_profiles(
                          temporal_data = group_data,
                          var_params_list = EMEP_VAR_PARAMS_LIST,
                          run_labels = RUN_LABELS,
                          var_labels = emission_var_labels,
                          palette = EMISSION_PALETTE,
                          value_label = 'Emissions',
                          plot_type = 'ref',
                          value_mode = 'fraction',
                          group_var = 'variable',
                          region_label = region_name,
                          year = ref_emiss_year,
                          interactive = interactive
                        )
                      } else {
                        NULL
                      },

                      absdiff = if (
                        nrow(comparison_data) > 0
                      ) {
                        plot_temporal_profiles(
                          temporal_data = comparison_data,
                          var_params_list = EMEP_VAR_PARAMS_LIST,
                          run_labels = RUN_LABELS,
                          var_labels = emission_var_labels,
                          palette = EMISSION_PALETTE,
                          value_label = 'Emissions',
                          plot_type = 'absdiff',
                          value_mode = 'value',
                          group_var = 'variable',
                          region_label = region_name,
                          year = test_emiss_year,
                          interactive = interactive
                        )
                      } else {
                        NULL
                      },

                      reldiff = if (
                        nrow(comparison_data) > 0
                      ) {
                        plot_temporal_profiles(
                          temporal_data = comparison_data,
                          var_params_list = EMEP_VAR_PARAMS_LIST,
                          run_labels = RUN_LABELS,
                          var_labels = emission_var_labels,
                          palette = EMISSION_PALETTE,
                          value_label = 'Emissions',
                          plot_type = 'reldiff',
                          value_mode = 'value',
                          group_var = 'variable',
                          region_label = region_name,
                          year = test_emiss_year,
                          interactive = interactive
                        )
                      } else {
                        NULL
                      }
                    ) %>%
                      purrr::compact()
                  }
                ) %>%
                purrr::compact()

              group_plots
            }
          )

        region_order = names(region_plots)

        if ('Full domain' %in% region_order) {

          region_order = c(
            'Full domain',
            sort(
              setdiff(
                region_order,
                'Full domain'
              )
            )
          )

        } else {

          region_order = sort(
            region_order
          )
        }

        region_plots[
          region_order
        ]
      }
    )
}

emission_temporal_plots_static = NULL
emission_temporal_plots_interactive = NULL

if (REPORT_STYLE == 'static') {

  emission_temporal_plots_static =
    make_emission_temporal_plots(
      interactive = FALSE
    )

  names(emission_temporal_plots_static) =
    emission_temporal_check_results$domain
  
  # save the plots in a pdf

  purrr::iwalk(
    emission_temporal_plots_static,
    function(domain_plots, domain_id) {
  
      if (
        is.null(domain_plots) ||
        length(domain_plots) == 0
      ) {
        return(invisible(NULL))
      }
  
      domain_label = EMEP_domains[[domain_id]]
      
      domain_row = emission_temporal_check_results %>%
        dplyr::filter(
          domain == domain_id
        )
      
      test_run_dir = domain_row$test_dir[[1]]
      ref_run_dir = domain_row$ref_dir[[1]]
      
      run_caption = paste0(
        'Test run directory: ',
        test_run_dir
      )
      
      if (!is.null(ref_run_dir)) {
        run_caption = paste0(
          run_caption,
          '\nReference run directory: ',
          ref_run_dir
        )
      }
  
      pdf_fname = fs::path(
        plots_pth_out,
        paste0(
          domain_label,
          '_emiss_temporal_plots.pdf'
        )
      )
  
      grDevices::pdf(
        file = pdf_fname,
        width = 10,
        height = 4.5,
        onefile = TRUE
      )
  
      purrr::iwalk(
        domain_plots,
        function(region_plots, region_name) {
  
          if (
            is.null(region_plots) ||
            length(region_plots) == 0
          ) {
            return(invisible(NULL))
          }
  
          purrr::iwalk(
            region_plots,
            function(group_plots, group_name) {
  
              if (
                is.null(group_plots) ||
                length(group_plots) == 0
              ) {
                return(invisible(NULL))
              }
  
              group_label = dplyr::recode(
                group_name,
                anthropogenic = 'Anthropogenic',
                natural = 'Natural',
                .default = group_name
              )
  
              plot_order = c(
                'test',
                'ref',
                'absdiff',
                'reldiff'
              )
  
              purrr::walk(
                plot_order,
                function(plot_type) {
  
                  p = group_plots[[plot_type]]
  
                  if (is.null(p)) {
                    return(invisible(NULL))
                  }
  
                  print(
                    p +
                      ggplot2::labs(
                        subtitle = paste(
                          region_name,
                          group_label,
                          sep = ' — '
                        ),
                        caption = run_caption
                      ) +
                      ggplot2::theme(
                        plot.caption = ggplot2::element_text(
                          hjust = 0,
                          size = 7
                        )
                      )
                  )
                }
              )
            }
          )
        }
      )
  
      grDevices::dev.off()
    }
  )

} else {

  emission_temporal_plots_interactive =
    make_emission_temporal_plots(
      interactive = TRUE
    )

  names(emission_temporal_plots_interactive) =
    emission_temporal_check_results$domain
}

```

```{r emission-temporal-plots, results='asis', eval = CHECK_EMISSION_TEMPORAL}

child_text = character()

if (REPORT_STYLE == 'interactive') {

  emission_temporal_plots =
    emission_temporal_plots_interactive
  
  chunk_header = '```{r, echo=FALSE}'

} else {

  emission_temporal_plots =
    emission_temporal_plots_static
  
  chunk_header = '```{r, echo=FALSE, fig.height=3.8}'
}


for (domain_i in seq_along(emission_temporal_plots)) {

  domain_name = names(emission_temporal_plots)[[domain_i]]

  this_domain_plots =
    emission_temporal_plots[[domain_i]]

  if (
    is.null(this_domain_plots) ||
    length(this_domain_plots) == 0
  ) {
    next
  }

  domain_label = EMEP_domains[[domain_name]]

  # Domain heading --------------------------------------------------------

  child_text = c(
    child_text,
    paste0(
      '## ',
      domain_label,
      if (REPORT_STYLE == 'interactive') {
        paste0(
          ' {.tabset #emission-temporal-',
          domain_name,
          '}'
        )
      } else {
        paste0(
          ' {#emission-temporal-',
          domain_name,
          '}'
        )
      }
    ),
    ''
  )

  for (region_i in seq_along(this_domain_plots)) {

    region_name = names(this_domain_plots)[[region_i]]
    region_plots = this_domain_plots[[region_i]]

    if (
      is.null(region_plots) ||
      length(region_plots) == 0
    ) {
      next
    }

    # Country heading -----------------------------------------------------

    child_text = c(
      child_text,
      paste0(
        '### ',
        region_name,
        ' {#emission-temporal-',
        domain_name,
        '-region-',
        region_i,
        '}'
      ),
      ''
    )

    show_group_headings =
      length(region_plots) > 1

    for (group_i in seq_along(region_plots)) {

      group_name = names(region_plots)[[group_i]]
      group_plots = region_plots[[group_i]]

      if (
        is.null(group_plots) ||
        length(group_plots) == 0
      ) {
        next
      }

      # Emission-group heading --------------------------------------------

      if (show_group_headings) {

        group_label = dplyr::recode(
          group_name,
          anthropogenic = 'Anthropogenic',
          natural = 'Natural',
          .default = group_name
        )

        child_text = c(
          child_text,
          paste0(
            '#### ',
            group_label
          ),
          ''
        )
      }

      # Plots -------------------------------------------------------------

      plot_order = c(
        'test',
        'ref',
        'absdiff',
        'reldiff'
      )

      for (plot_type in plot_order) {

        if (is.null(group_plots[[plot_type]])) {
          next
        }

        child_text = c(
          child_text,
          chunk_header,
          paste0(
            'emission_temporal_plots[[',
            domain_i,
            ']][[',
            region_i,
            ']][[',
            group_i,
            ']][[',
            shQuote(plot_type),
            ']]'
          ),
          '```',
          ''
        )
      }
    }
  }
}


cat(
  knitr::knit_child(
    text = child_text,
    envir = environment(),
    quiet = TRUE
  ),
  sep = '\n'
)

# create temporal profile plots

make_temporal_variation_plots = function(
    interactive = TRUE
) {

  temporal_variation_data %>%
    purrr::imap(
      function(domain_data, domain_id) {

        if (nrow(domain_data) == 0) {
          return(NULL)
        }

        domain_name = domain_data %>%
          dplyr::distinct(
            domain_name
          ) %>%
          dplyr::pull(
            domain_name
          ) %>%
          dplyr::first()

        if (TEMPORAL_VARIATION_GROUP_BY == 'location') {

          plot_groups = domain_data %>%
            dplyr::distinct(
              location_id
            ) %>%
            dplyr::pull(
              location_id
            )

          group_var = 'variable'

        } else {

          plot_groups = domain_data %>%
            dplyr::distinct(
              variable
            ) %>%
            dplyr::pull(
              variable
            )

          group_var = 'location_id'
        }

        plot_palette = if (group_var == 'location_id') {
          temporal_location_colours
        } else {
          TEMPORAL_PALETTE
        }

        plots = purrr::map(
          plot_groups,
          function(plot_group) {

            if (TEMPORAL_VARIATION_GROUP_BY == 'location') {

              plot_data = domain_data %>%
                dplyr::filter(
                  location_id == plot_group
                )

              plot_label = plot_group
              plot_title = plot_group
              plot_label_static = plot_group

            } else {

              plot_data = domain_data %>%
                dplyr::filter(
                  variable == plot_group
                )

              plot_label = format_temporal_var_label(
                var = plot_group,
                var_params_list = EMEP_VAR_PARAMS_LIST,
                output = 'html',
                include_units = FALSE
              )
              
              plot_label_static = format_temporal_var_label(
                var = plot_group,
                var_params_list = EMEP_VAR_PARAMS_LIST,
                output = 'plotmath',
                include_units = FALSE
              )

              plot_title = format_temporal_var_label(
                var = plot_group,
                var_params_list = EMEP_VAR_PARAMS_LIST,
                output = 'plain',
                include_units = FALSE
              )
            }

            comparison_data = prepare_temporal_comparison_data(
              plot_data
            )

            test_plot = plot_temporal_profiles(
              temporal_data = plot_data,
              var_params_list = EMEP_VAR_PARAMS_LIST,
              run_labels = RUN_LABELS,
              palette = plot_palette,
              value_label = 'Value',
              plot_type = 'test',
              value_mode = TEMPORAL_VARIATION_VALUE_MODE,
              group_var = group_var,
              region_label = plot_title,
              interactive = interactive
            )

            ref_plot = if (
              any(plot_data$run == 'ref')
            ) {

              plot_temporal_profiles(
                temporal_data = plot_data,
                var_params_list = EMEP_VAR_PARAMS_LIST,
                run_labels = RUN_LABELS,
                palette = plot_palette,
                value_label = 'Value',
                plot_type = 'ref',
                value_mode = TEMPORAL_VARIATION_VALUE_MODE,
                group_var = group_var,
                region_label = plot_title,
                interactive = interactive
              )

            } else {

              NULL
            }

            absdiff_plot = if (
              nrow(comparison_data) > 0
            ) {

              plot_temporal_profiles(
                temporal_data = comparison_data,
                var_params_list = EMEP_VAR_PARAMS_LIST,
                run_labels = RUN_LABELS,
                palette = plot_palette,
                value_label = 'Value',
                plot_type = 'absdiff',
                value_mode = 'value',
                group_var = group_var,
                region_label = plot_title,
                interactive = interactive
              )

            } else {

              NULL
            }

            reldiff_plot = if (
              nrow(comparison_data) > 0
            ) {

              plot_temporal_profiles(
                temporal_data = comparison_data,
                var_params_list = EMEP_VAR_PARAMS_LIST,
                run_labels = RUN_LABELS,
                palette = plot_palette,
                value_label = 'Value',
                plot_type = 'reldiff',
                value_mode = 'value',
                group_var = group_var,
                region_label = plot_title,
                interactive = interactive
              )

            } else {

              NULL
            }

            list(
              label = plot_label,
              title = plot_title,
              label_static = plot_label_static,
              test = test_plot,
              ref = ref_plot,
              absdiff = absdiff_plot,
              reldiff = reldiff_plot
            )
          }
        ) %>%
          rlang::set_names(
            plot_groups
          )

        list(
          domain_name = domain_name,
          plots = plots
        )
      }
    ) %>%
    purrr::compact()
}

temporal_summary_plots_static = NULL

if (
  REPORT_STYLE == 'static' ||
  SAVE_STATIC_OUTPUTS
) {

  temporal_summary_plots_static =
    make_temporal_variation_plots(
      interactive = FALSE
    )
}

temporal_summary_plots = if (REPORT_STYLE == 'interactive') {

  make_temporal_variation_plots(
    interactive = TRUE
  )

} else {

  temporal_summary_plots_static
}

if (SAVE_STATIC_OUTPUTS) {

  # save the plots in a pdf

  purrr::iwalk(
    temporal_summary_plots_static,
    function(domain_result, domain_id) {

      if (
        is.null(domain_result) ||
        length(domain_result$plots) == 0
      ) {
        return(invisible(NULL))
      }

      domain_row = domain_setup %>%
        dplyr::filter(
          domain == domain_id
        )

      test_run_dir = domain_row$test_dir[[1]]

      ref_run_dir = if (
        length(domain_row$ref_dir) > 0 &&
        !is.null(domain_row$ref_dir[[1]])
      ) {
        domain_row$ref_dir[[1]]
      } else {
        NULL
      }

      run_caption = paste0(
        'Test run directory: ',
        test_run_dir
      )

      if (!is.null(ref_run_dir)) {

        run_caption = paste0(
          run_caption,
          '\nReference run directory: ',
          ref_run_dir
        )
      }

      pdf_fname = fs::path(
        plots_pth_out,
        paste0(
          domain_result$domain_name,
          '_temporal_variation_plots.pdf'
        )
      )

      grDevices::pdf(
        file = pdf_fname,
        width = 10,
        height = 4.5,
        onefile = TRUE
      )

      purrr::iwalk(
        domain_result$plots,
        function(group_plots, group_id) {

          if (
            is.null(group_plots) ||
            length(group_plots) == 0
          ) {
            return(invisible(NULL))
          }

          plot_order = c(
            'test',
            'ref',
            'absdiff',
            'reldiff'
          )

          purrr::walk(
            plot_order,
            function(plot_type) {

              p = group_plots[[plot_type]]

              if (is.null(p)) {
                return(invisible(NULL))
              }

              print(
                p +
                  ggplot2::labs(
                    subtitle = parse(
                      text = group_plots$label_static
                    )[[1]],
                    caption = run_caption
                  ) +
                  ggplot2::theme(
                    plot.caption = ggplot2::element_text(
                      hjust = 0,
                      size = 7
                    )
                  )
              )
            }
          )
        }
      )

      grDevices::dev.off()
    }
  )
}

```{r calculate_summaries, eval = COMPARE_SUMMARIES, results = 'hide'}

task_start = Sys.time()

# Resolve requested summary variables once
requested_summary_domains = names(SUMMARY_REGIONS)[
  !purrr::map_lgl(SUMMARY_REGIONS, is.null)
]

test_summary_domain = requested_summary_domains[
  length(requested_summary_domains)
]

test_summary_dir = TEST_DIR[[
  test_summary_domain
]]

test_summary_file = select_emep_file_from_dir(
  EMEP_dir = test_summary_dir,
  file_tag = 'fullrun'
)

summary_vars = resolve_summary_vars(
  summary_vars = SUMMARY_VARS,
  test_file = test_summary_file
)

# Build summary setup by model domain
summary_domain_setup = domain_setup %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    summary_regions = purrr::map(
      domain,
      ~ SUMMARY_REGIONS[[.x]]
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    !purrr::map_lgl(summary_regions, is.null)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    test_file = purrr::map(
      test_dir,
      ~ select_emep_file_from_dir(
        EMEP_dir = .x,
        file_tag = 'fullrun'
      )
    ),
    ref_file = purrr::map(
      ref_dir,
      function(this_dir) {

        if (is.null(this_dir)) {
          return(NULL)
        }

        select_emep_file_from_dir(
          EMEP_dir = this_dir,
          file_tag = 'fullrun'
        )
      }
    )
  )

# expand domain selections into individual summary regions
emep_summary_setup = purrr::pmap_dfr(
  summary_domain_setup,
  function(
      domain,
      domain_name,
      test_dir,
      ref_dir,
      summary_regions,
      test_file,
      ref_file
  ) {

    include_full_domain =
      'full_domain' %in% summary_regions

    region_selection = setdiff(
      summary_regions,
      'full_domain'
    )

    this_setup = tibble::tibble()

    #
    # Full-domain summary
    #

    if (include_full_domain) {

      this_setup = dplyr::bind_rows(
        this_setup,
        tibble::tibble(
          region_id = 'Full domain',
          fpath = NA_character_,
          domain = domain,
          domain_name = domain_name,
          test_dir = list(test_dir),
          ref_dir = list(ref_dir),
          test_file = list(test_file),
          ref_file = list(ref_file),
          full_domain = TRUE
        )
      )
    }

    #
    # Regional summaries
    #

    if (length(region_selection) > 0) {

      this_region_geofiles = get_region_geofiles(
        geodata_dir = SUMMARY_REGION_GEODATA_DIR,
        regions = region_selection
      ) %>%
        dplyr::mutate(
          domain = domain,
          domain_name = domain_name,
          test_dir = list(test_dir),
          ref_dir = list(ref_dir),
          test_file = list(test_file),
          ref_file = list(ref_file),
          full_domain = FALSE
        )

      this_setup = dplyr::bind_rows(
        this_setup,
        this_region_geofiles
      )
    }

    this_setup
  }
)

# initialise result columns
emep_summary_results = emep_summary_setup %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    test_summary = vector(
      'list',
      dplyr::n()
    ),
    ref_summary = vector(
      'list',
      dplyr::n()
    ),
    summary_comparison = vector(
      'list',
      dplyr::n()
    )
  )

# calculate summaries
for (i in seq_len(nrow(emep_summary_results))) {

  this_row = emep_summary_results[i, ]

  #
  # Region mask
  #

  area_mask_sf = if (isTRUE(this_row$full_domain)) {
    NULL
  } else {
    sf::st_read(
      this_row$fpath,
      quiet = TRUE
    )
  }

  #
  # Test run
  #

  test_emep_data = read_emep(
    emep_fname = this_row$test_file[[1]],
    emep_var = summary_vars,
    emep_crs = TEST_CRS,
    proxy = FALSE,
    driver = 'gdal'
  )

  test_area_data = read_emep(
    emep_fname = this_row$test_file[[1]],
    emep_var = 'Area_Grid_km2',
    emep_crs = TEST_CRS,
    proxy = FALSE,
    driver = 'gdal'
  )

  test_var_units = get_nc_var_units(
    nc_file = this_row$test_file[[1]],
    vars = summary_vars
  )

  if (is.null(area_mask_sf)) {

    masked_test_data = test_emep_data
    masked_test_area = test_area_data

  } else {

    masked_test_data = apply_domain_mask(
      stars_object = test_emep_data,
      domain_mask = area_mask_sf
    )

    masked_test_area = apply_domain_mask(
      stars_object = test_area_data,
      domain_mask = area_mask_sf
    )
  }

  test_summary = purrr::map_dfr(
    summary_vars,
    function(var_name) {

      summarise_emep_var(
        emep_stars = masked_test_data,
        area_stars = masked_test_area,
        var_name = var_name,
        var_unit = unname(
          test_var_units[var_name]
        ),
        total_out_unit = 'Gg'
      )
    }
  ) %>%
    dplyr::rename(
      test_value = value,
      test_unit = unit
    )

  emep_summary_results$test_summary[[i]] =
    test_summary

  #
  # Reference run
  #

  this_ref_file = this_row$ref_file[[1]]

  if (is.null(this_ref_file)) {
    next
  }

  ref_vars = get_emep_vars(
    nc_file = this_ref_file,
    var_keywords = NULL
  )

  available_ref_vars = intersect(
    summary_vars,
    ref_vars
  )

  if (length(available_ref_vars) == 0) {
    next
  }

  ref_emep_data = read_emep(
    emep_fname = this_ref_file,
    emep_var = available_ref_vars,
    emep_crs = REF_CRS,
    proxy = FALSE,
    driver = 'gdal'
  )

  ref_area_data = read_emep(
    emep_fname = this_ref_file,
    emep_var = 'Area_Grid_km2',
    emep_crs = REF_CRS,
    proxy = FALSE,
    driver = 'gdal'
  )

  ref_var_units = get_nc_var_units(
    nc_file = this_ref_file,
    vars = available_ref_vars
  )

  if (is.null(area_mask_sf)) {

    masked_ref_data = ref_emep_data
    masked_ref_area = ref_area_data

  } else {

    masked_ref_data = apply_domain_mask(
      stars_object = ref_emep_data,
      domain_mask = area_mask_sf
    )

    masked_ref_area = apply_domain_mask(
      stars_object = ref_area_data,
      domain_mask = area_mask_sf
    )
  }

  ref_summary = purrr::map_dfr(
    available_ref_vars,
    function(var_name) {

      summarise_emep_var(
        emep_stars = masked_ref_data,
        area_stars = masked_ref_area,
        var_name = var_name,
        var_unit = unname(
          ref_var_units[var_name]
        ),
        total_out_unit = 'Gg'
      )
    }
  ) %>%
    dplyr::rename(
      ref_value = value,
      ref_unit = unit
    )

  emep_summary_results$ref_summary[[i]] =
    ref_summary

  #
  # Test-reference comparison
  #

  summary_comparison = test_summary %>%
    dplyr::left_join(
      ref_summary,
      by = 'variable'
    ) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      abs_diff = test_value - ref_value,
      rel_diff = 100 *
        (test_value - ref_value) /
        ref_value
    )

  emep_summary_results$summary_comparison[[i]] =
    summary_comparison
}

readr::write_rds(
  emep_summary_results,
  fs::path(
    QAQC_DIR,
    'Data',
    'emep_summary_results.rds'
  )
)

if (SAVE_STATIC_OUTPUTS) {

  emep_summary_csv_data =
    emep_summary_results %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      summary_comparison = purrr::pmap(
        list(
          summary_comparison,
          region_id,
          fpath,
          test_dir,
          ref_dir
        ),
        function(
            summary_data,
            region_id,
            fpath,
            test_dir,
            ref_dir
        ) {

          summary_data %>%
            dplyr::mutate(
              region_id = region_id,
              fpath = as.character(fpath),
              test_run_dir = test_dir,
              ref_run_dir = ref_dir,
              .before = 1
            )
        }
      )
    ) %>%
    dplyr::select(
      domain,
      domain_name,
      summary_comparison
    ) %>%
    tidyr::unnest(
      summary_comparison
    )

  emep_summary_csv_data %>%
    dplyr::group_split(
      domain,
      domain_name
    ) %>%
    purrr::walk(
      function(domain_data) {

        domain_name = domain_data$domain_name[[1]]

        csv_file = fs::path(
          tables_pth_out,
          paste0(
            domain_name,
            '_emep_variable_summary.csv'
          )
        )

        domain_data %>%
          dplyr::select(
            -domain,
            -domain_name
          ) %>%
          readr::write_csv(
            csv_file
          )
      }
    )
}

```{r EMEP_summary_tables, eval = COMPARE_SUMMARIES, results = 'asis'}
summary_domain_order = unique(
  emep_summary_results$domain
)

for (domain in summary_domain_order) {

  domain_results = emep_summary_results %>%
    dplyr::filter(
      domain == !!domain
    )

  if (nrow(domain_results) == 0) {
    next
  }

  domain_name = domain_results$domain_name[[1]]

  cat(
    '\n## ',
    domain_name,
    if (REPORT_STYLE == 'interactive') {
      ' {.tabset}'
    } else {
      ''
    },
    '\n\n',
    sep = ''
  )

  for (i in seq_len(nrow(domain_results))) {

    this_row = domain_results[i, ]

    region_id = this_row$region_id
    region_fpath = this_row$fpath[[1]]

    comparison_data = this_row$summary_comparison[[1]]
    test_data = this_row$test_summary[[1]]

    cat(
      '\n### ',
      region_id,
      '\n\n',
      sep = ''
    )

    # Summary text --------------------------------------------------------

    if (
      !is.null(comparison_data) &&
      nrow(comparison_data) > 0
    ) {

      n_compared = sum(
        !is.na(comparison_data$ref_value)
      )

      n_missing_ref = sum(
        is.na(comparison_data$ref_value)
      )

      n_exceed = sum(
        abs(comparison_data$rel_diff) >
          SUMMARY_DIFF_THRESHOLD,
        na.rm = TRUE
      )

      if (
        n_compared > 0 &&
        n_exceed == 0
      ) {

        cat(
          glue::glue(
            "All variables available in both runs are within ",
            "{SUMMARY_DIFF_THRESHOLD}% of the corresponding ",
            "{ref_label} values."
          ),
          '\n\n'
        )
      }

      if (n_exceed > 0) {

        cat(
          glue::glue(
            "{n_exceed} of {n_compared} variables available in both runs ",
            "{if (n_exceed == 1) 'exceeds' else 'exceed'} the ",
            "{SUMMARY_DIFF_THRESHOLD}% {test_label}–{ref_label} ",
            "difference threshold."
          ),
          '\n\n'
        )
      }

      if (n_missing_ref > 0) {

        cat(
          glue::glue(
            "{n_missing_ref} test-run variable",
            "{if (n_missing_ref == 1) ' is' else 's are'} not available ",
            "in the {ref_label} run and therefore cannot be compared."
          ),
          '\n\n'
        )
      }

      summary_data = comparison_data

    } else {

      cat(
        glue::glue(
          "No {ref_label} summary is available for this region. ",
          "{test_label} values are shown below."
        ),
        '\n\n'
      )

      summary_data = test_data
    }
    
    
    # Masking geofile -----------------------------------------------------

    if (
      length(region_fpath) > 0 &&
      !is.na(region_fpath)
    ) {

      cat(
        "<div class='file-path'>",
        '<strong>Area mask used:</strong> ',
        format_file_path(region_fpath),
        '</div>\n\n',
        sep = ''
      )
    }

    # Table ---------------------------------------------------------------

    if (REPORT_STYLE == 'interactive') {

      summary_table = make_emep_summary_dt(
        df = summary_data,
        run_labels = RUN_LABELS,
        threshold = SUMMARY_DIFF_THRESHOLD
      )

      print(
        htmltools::tagList(
          summary_table
        )
      )

    } else {

      summary_table = make_emep_summary_gt(
        df = summary_data,
        run_labels = RUN_LABELS,
        threshold = SUMMARY_DIFF_THRESHOLD
      )

      print(summary_table)
    }

    cat('\n\n')
  }
}

```{r compare_mass_budget, eval = COMPARE_MASS_BUDGET, results = 'asis'}
MBS_setup = domain_setup

MBS_results = MBS_setup %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    comparison = purrr::map2(
      test_dir,
      ref_dir,
      function(test_dir, ref_dir) {

        if (is.null(ref_dir)) {
          return(NULL)
        }

        test_MBS = read_MBS(test_dir)
        ref_MBS = read_MBS(ref_dir)

        compare_MBS(
          test_MBS = test_MBS,
          ref_MBS = ref_MBS
        )
      }
    )
  )

MBS_results_available = MBS_results %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    !purrr::map_lgl(
      comparison,
      is.null
    )
  )

if (nrow(MBS_results_available) == 0) {

  cat(
    'No reference run is available for comparison of the EMEP mass budget.\n'
  )

} else {
  
  if (SAVE_STATIC_OUTPUTS) {

    MBS_results_available %>%
      purrr::pwalk(
        function(
            domain,
            domain_name,
            test_dir,
            ref_dir,
            comparison,
            ...
        ) {
  
          csv_file = fs::path(
            tables_pth_out,
            paste0(
              domain_name,
              '_MBS_comparison.csv'
            )
          )
  
          comparison %>%
            dplyr::mutate(
              test_run_dir = test_dir,
              ref_run_dir = ref_dir,
              .before = 1
            ) %>%
            readr::write_csv(
              csv_file
            )
        }
      )
  }

  for (i in seq_len(nrow(MBS_results_available))) {

    this_domain = MBS_results_available[i, ]
    this_comparison = this_domain$comparison[[1]]

    cat(
      '## ',
      this_domain$domain_name,
      '\n\n',
      sep = ''
    )

    cat(
      'The mass budget comparison is for the full ',
      this_domain$domain_name,
      ' model domain.\n\n',
      sep = ''
    )

    if (REPORT_STYLE == 'interactive') {
    
      this_table = make_MBS_dt(
        df = this_comparison,
        run_labels = RUN_LABELS,
        threshold = MASS_BUDGET_DIFF_THRESHOLD
      )
    
      print(
        htmltools::tagList(
          this_table
        )
      )
    
    } else {
    
      this_table = make_MBS_gt(
        df = this_comparison,
        run_labels = RUN_LABELS,
        threshold = MASS_BUDGET_DIFF_THRESHOLD
      )
    
      print(this_table)
    }

    cat('\n\n')
  }
}

```{r create-summary-map-data, eval = PLOT_STATIC_SUMMARY_MAPS || PLOT_INTERACTIVE_SUMMARY_MAPS, include=FALSE}

task_start = Sys.time()

summary_map_data = NULL
summary_map_plots = NULL
summary_map_grobs = NULL
summary_map_leaflet = NULL
report_map_height = NULL

show_static_summary_maps =
  REPORT_STYLE == 'static' ||
  (
    REPORT_STYLE == 'interactive' &&
    PLOT_STATIC_SUMMARY_MAPS
  )

show_interactive_summary_maps =
  REPORT_STYLE == 'interactive' &&
  PLOT_INTERACTIVE_SUMMARY_MAPS

make_static_summary_maps =
  show_static_summary_maps ||
  SAVE_STATIC_OUTPUTS

make_interactive_summary_maps =
  show_interactive_summary_maps

make_summary_maps =
  make_static_summary_maps ||
  make_interactive_summary_maps

if (make_summary_maps) {
  
  # Use the first submitted Test domain to identify the variables available
  # in the selected mapping file.
  
  summary_map_test_file = select_emep_file_from_dir(
    EMEP_dir = domain_setup$test_dir[[1]],
    file_tag = SUMMARY_MAP_TEST_FILE_TAG
  )
  
  # Resolve variables requested for mapping.
  
  summary_map_vars = resolve_summary_map_vars(
    selection = SUMMARY_MAP_VARS,
    test_file = summary_map_test_file,
    var_params_list = EMEP_VAR_PARAMS_LIST
  )
  
  if (length(summary_map_vars) == 0) {
    stop(
      paste0(
        "No requested summary-map variables are available for plotting."
      ),
      call. = FALSE
    )
  }
  
  # Resolve the subset to be displayed in the HTML report.
  
  summary_map_vars_report = resolve_selection(
    selection = SUMMARY_MAP_VARS_REPORT,
    available = summary_map_vars,
    input_name = 'SUMMARY_MAP_VARS_REPORT'
  )
  
  # Prepare optional spatial filters. These are applied to all submitted
  # domains before either static or interactive maps are created.

  domain_crop_sf = as_domain_polygon_sf(
    SUMMARY_MAP_DOMAIN_CROP,
    filter_name = 'domain crop'
  )

  domain_mask_sf = as_domain_polygon_sf(
    SUMMARY_MAP_DOMAIN_MASK,
    filter_name = 'domain mask'
  )
  
  # Build Test / Reference / difference data for every requested variable.
  #
  # Parallelisation is across variables. Domains are processed sequentially
  # within build_emep_diff_list().
  
  summary_map_workers = set_parallel_plan(
    workers_requested = worker_cap,
    max_workers = 4,
    prefer_multicore = TRUE
  )
  
  workers_used = unclass(future::nbrOfWorkers())
  
  qaqc_parallel_info[['Summary maps prep']] = tibble::tibble(
    section = 'Summary maps prep',
    workers = workers_used
  )
  
  summary_map_data = summary_map_vars %>%
    purrr::set_names() %>%
    furrr::future_map(
      function(
        emep_var,
        domain_setup,
        test_crs,
        ref_crs,
        test_file_tag,
        ref_file_tag,
        test_t_index,
        ref_t_index,
        test_z_index,
        ref_z_index,
        test_summary_stat,
        ref_summary_stat,
        diff_direction,
        domain_crop,
        domain_mask
      ) {
        
        calculation_vars = if (
          stringr::str_detect(
            emep_var,
            '_vs_'
          )
        ) {
          stringr::str_split(
            emep_var,
            '_vs_'
          )[[1]]
        } else {
          emep_var
        }
        
        effective_test_z_index = test_z_index %||%
          get_var_param(
            var = emep_var,
            key = 'z_index',
            var_params_list = EMEP_VAR_PARAMS_LIST,
            default = NULL
          )
        
        effective_ref_z_index = ref_z_index %||%
          get_var_param(
            var = emep_var,
            key = 'z_index',
            var_params_list = EMEP_VAR_PARAMS_LIST,
            default = NULL
          )
        
        this_diff = build_emep_diff_list(
          domain_setup = domain_setup,
          emep_var = calculation_vars,
          test_crs = test_crs,
          ref_crs = ref_crs,
          test_file_tag = test_file_tag,
          ref_file_tag = ref_file_tag,
          time_index_test = test_t_index,
          time_index_ref = ref_t_index,
          z_index_test = effective_test_z_index,
          z_index_ref = effective_ref_z_index,
          test_summary_fun = test_summary_stat,
          ref_summary_fun = ref_summary_stat,
          diff_direction = diff_direction
        )
        
        this_diff = apply_domain_filters_stars(
          x = this_diff,
          domain_crop = domain_crop,
          domain_mask = domain_mask
        )
        
      this_diff
      },
      domain_setup = domain_setup,
      test_crs = TEST_CRS,
      ref_crs = REF_CRS,
      test_file_tag = SUMMARY_MAP_TEST_FILE_TAG,
      ref_file_tag = SUMMARY_MAP_REF_FILE_TAG,
      test_t_index = SUMMARY_MAP_TEST_T_INDEX,
      ref_t_index = SUMMARY_MAP_REF_T_INDEX,
      test_z_index = SUMMARY_MAP_TEST_Z_INDEX,
      ref_z_index = SUMMARY_MAP_REF_Z_INDEX,
      test_summary_stat = SUMMARY_MAP_TEST_STAT,
      ref_summary_stat = SUMMARY_MAP_REF_STAT,
      diff_direction = DIFF_DIRECTION,
      domain_crop = domain_crop_sf,
      domain_mask = domain_mask_sf,
      .options = furrr::furrr_options(
        seed = TRUE,
        packages = c(
          'dplyr',
          'purrr',
          'tibble',
          'fs',
          'sf',
          'stars',
          'glue',
          'logger'
        ),
        globals = c(
          'build_emep_diff_list',
          'calculate_emep_diff_pair',
          'calculate_summary_diff',
          'calculate_summary_ratio',
          'align_summary_grid',
          'select_emep_file_from_dir',
          'read_emep',
          'get_var_param',
          'resolve_var_id',
          'EMEP_VAR_PARAMS_LIST',
          '%||%',
          'apply_domain_filters_stars',
          'apply_domain_crop',
          'apply_domain_mask',
          'as_domain_polygon_sf'
        )
      )
    )
  
  # Remove relative-difference maps for variables where they are not
  # physically meaningful. Relative differences are enabled by default.
  
  summary_map_z_index = summary_map_vars %>%
    purrr::set_names() %>%
    purrr::map(
      function(emep_var) {
        
        var_z_index = get_var_param(
          var = emep_var,
          key = 'z_index',
          var_params_list = EMEP_VAR_PARAMS_LIST,
          default = NULL
        )
        
        if (is.null(var_z_index)) {
          
          return(
            list(
              test = NULL,
              reference = NULL
            )
          )
        }
        
        list(
          test = SUMMARY_MAP_TEST_Z_INDEX %||%
            var_z_index,
          reference = SUMMARY_MAP_REF_Z_INDEX %||%
            var_z_index
        )
      }
    )
  
  summary_map_data = summary_map_data %>%
    purrr::imap(
      function(this_diff, var) {
        
        plot_reldiff = get_var_param(
          var = var,
          key = 'plot_reldiff',
          var_params_list = EMEP_VAR_PARAMS_LIST,
          default = TRUE
        )
        
        if (!isTRUE(plot_reldiff)) {
          
          this_diff = this_diff %>%
            purrr::map(
              function(domain_diff) {
                
                domain_diff$rel_diff = NULL
                
                domain_diff
              }
            )
        }
        
        this_diff
      }
    )
  
  future::plan(future::sequential)
}


```

summary_map_vars_tbl2

cat('\n\n')

if (ref_submitted) {

if (show_interactive_summary_maps) {

cat(

cat('\n\n')

```{r create-static-summary-maps, include=FALSE, eval=(PLOT_STATIC_SUMMARY_MAPS || PLOT_INTERACTIVE_SUMMARY_MAPS) && SAVE_STATIC_OUTPUTS}
if (make_static_summary_maps) {

  # Format summary statistic for map titles

  summary_map_test_stat_title = format_summary_stat(
    SUMMARY_MAP_TEST_STAT
  )

  summary_map_ref_stat_title = format_summary_stat(
    SUMMARY_MAP_REF_STAT
  )


  # -----------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Create static maps
  #
  # Maps are created separately for each EMEP domain so that domains are
  # shown sequentially rather than overlaid.
  #
  # For Test / Reference comparisons, each domain normally produces:
  #
  # Test             Reference
  # Absolute diff    Relative diff
  #
  # Domain order is inherited from summary_map_data, which in turn follows
  # domain_setup (e.g. outer then inner).
  # -----------------------------------------------------------------------

  summary_map_plots = summary_map_data %>%
    purrr::imap(
      function(this_var_diff, v) {
  
        is_ratio = stringr::str_detect(
          v,
          '_vs_'
        )
  
        plot_vars = if (is_ratio) {
          stringr::str_split(
            v,
            '_vs_'
          )[[1]]
        } else {
          v
        }
  
        this_var_diff %>%
          purrr::imap(
            function(domain_diff, domain) {
  
              has_ref = if (is_ratio) {
                length(plot_vars) == 2 &&
                  plot_vars[2] %in% names(domain_diff)
              } else {
                'Reference' %in% names(domain_diff)
              }
  
              n_plot_cols = if (has_ref) {
                2
              } else {
                1
              }
  
              this_cbar_width = get_summary_map_cbar_width(
                n_plot_cols = n_plot_cols,
                fig_width = knitr::opts_chunk$get('fig.width') %||% 8.4,
                cbar_width = CBAR_WIDTH
              )
  
              plot_obj = plot_summary_maps(
                diff_list = stats::setNames(
                  list(domain_diff),
                  domain
                ),
                emep_var = plot_vars,
                var_params_list = EMEP_VAR_PARAMS_LIST,
                testref_pal_pth = TESTREF_PALETTE,
                absdiff_pal_pth = ABSDIFF_PALETTE,
                reldiff_pal_pth = RELDIFF_PALETTE,
                plot_titles = PLOT_TITLES,
                cbar_label_angle = CBAR_LABEL_ANGLE,
                cbar_label_vjust = CBAR_LABEL_VJUST,
                cbar_label_hjust = CBAR_LABEL_HJUST,
                cbar_width = this_cbar_width,
                cbar_height = CBAR_HEIGHT,
                legend_title_size = LEGEND_TITLE_SIZE,
                legend_text_size = LEGEND_TEXT_SIZE,
                rasterise_map_layers = SUMMARY_MAP_PDF_RASTERISE,
                raster_dpi = SUMMARY_MAP_PDF_DPI
              )
  
              attr(
                plot_obj,
                'map_stars'
              ) = if (is_ratio) {
                domain_diff[[plot_vars[1]]]
              } else {
                domain_diff$Test
              }
  
              attr(
                plot_obj,
                'map_data'
              ) = domain_diff
  
              attr(
                plot_obj,
                'domain'
              ) = domain
  
              plot_obj
            }
          )
      }
    )

  # -----------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Arrange the panels for each variable / domain
  # -----------------------------------------------------------------------

  summary_map_grobs = summary_map_plots %>%
    purrr::map(
      function(var_plots) {

        var_plots %>%
          purrr::map(
            arrange_comp_map_output
          ) %>%
          purrr::map(
            add_grob_outer_margin,
            left = 0.25,
            right = 0.25,
            top = 0.05,
            bottom = 0.10
          )
      }
    )


  # -----------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Prepare standalone PDF output
  # -----------------------------------------------------------------------

  if (SAVE_STATIC_OUTPUTS) {

    # ---------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Determine whether each variable contains Test-only maps.
    #
    # If every domain for a variable contains only one map, its domains are
    # combined vertically on a single PDF page:
    #
    # Outer domain
    #   Test
    #
    # Inner domain
    #   Test
    #
    # Otherwise each domain is given its own PDF page.
    # ---------------------------------------------------------------------

    test_only_maps = summary_map_plots %>%
      purrr::map_lgl(
        function(var_plots) {

          all(
            purrr::map_int(
              var_plots,
              ~ length(.x$plots)
            ) == 1
          )
        }
      )


    # ---------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Create PDF map pages
    #
    # Test / Reference case:
    #   one variable / domain comparison per page.
    #
    # Test-only case:
    #   all domains for a variable are combined vertically on one page,
    #   preserving outer -> inner order.
    #
    # Raw EMEP variable names are used as page titles.
    # ---------------------------------------------------------------------

    summary_map_pdf_pages = summary_map_grobs %>%
      .[sort(names(.))] %>%
      purrr::imap(
        function(var_grobs, v) {

          test_z_index = summary_map_z_index[[v]]$test

          ref_z_index = summary_map_z_index[[v]]$reference

          purrr::imap(
            var_grobs,
            function(domain_grob, domain) {

              list(
                title = v,
                domain = domain,
                test_z_index = test_z_index,
                ref_z_index = ref_z_index,
                grob = domain_grob
              )
            }
          )
        }
      ) %>%
      purrr::list_flatten()


    # ---------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Create paginated PDF contents pages.
    #
    # The front page is unnumbered. Contents pages are also unnumbered.
    # Map-page numbers therefore remain independent of the physical PDF
    # page number.
    # ---------------------------------------------------------------------
    
    summary_map_contents = summary_map_pdf_pages %>%
      unname() %>%
      purrr::imap_dfr(
        function(page, i) {
          
          tibble::tibble(
            var = page$title,
            page = i
          )
        }
      ) %>%
      dplyr::distinct(
        var,
        .keep_all = TRUE
      )
    
    
    contents_rows_per_page = 24
    
    contents_page_groups = split(
      summary_map_contents,
      ceiling(
        seq_len(
          nrow(summary_map_contents)
        ) /
          contents_rows_per_page
      )
    )
    
    
    make_contents_page = function(
      contents_data,
      contents_page
    ) {
      
      contents_title = grid::textGrob(
        if (contents_page == 1) {
          'Contents'
        } else {
          'Contents (continued)'
        },
        x = grid::unit(
          0.08,
          'npc'
        ),
        just = 'left',
        gp = grid::gpar(
          fontsize = 16,
          fontface = 'bold'
        )
      )
      
      contents_rows = contents_data %>%
        purrr::pmap(
          function(var, page) {
            
            var_grob = grid::textGrob(
              var,
              x = grid::unit(
                0.08,
                'npc'
              ),
              just = 'left',
              gp = grid::gpar(
                fontsize = 10
              )
            )
            
            page_grob = grid::textGrob(
              page,
              x = grid::unit(
                0.92,
                'npc'
              ),
              just = 'right',
              gp = grid::gpar(
                fontsize = 10
              )
            )
            
            leader_grob = grid::segmentsGrob(
              x0 =
                grid::unit(
                  0.08,
                  'npc'
                ) +
                grid::stringWidth(
                  var
                ) +
                grid::unit(
                  0.08,
                  'in'
                ),
              x1 =
                grid::unit(
                  0.92,
                  'npc'
                ) -
                grid::stringWidth(
                  as.character(page)
                ) -
                grid::unit(
                  0.08,
                  'in'
                ),
              y0 = grid::unit(
                0.45,
                'npc'
              ),
              y1 = grid::unit(
                0.45,
                'npc'
              ),
              gp = grid::gpar(
                lty = 'dotted',
                lwd = 1
              )
            )
            
            grid::grobTree(
              var_grob,
              leader_grob,
              page_grob
            )
          }
        )
      
      contents_grob = gridExtra::arrangeGrob(
        grobs = c(
          contents_rows,
          list(
            grid::nullGrob()
          )
        ),
        ncol = 1,
        heights = grid::unit.c(
          grid::unit(
            rep(
              0.32,
              length(contents_rows)
            ),
            'in'
          ),
          grid::unit(
            1,
            'null'
          )
        )
      )
      
      gridExtra::arrangeGrob(
        contents_title,
        contents_grob,
        ncol = 1,
        heights = c(
          0.08,
          0.92
        )
      )
    }
    
    
    summary_map_contents_pages = contents_page_groups %>%
      purrr::imap(
        ~ make_contents_page(
          contents_data = .x,
          contents_page = .y
        )
      )


    # ---------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Add map-page titles and page numbers.
    #
    # The front page is not numbered, so map pages start at Page 1.
    # ---------------------------------------------------------------------

    summary_map_grobs_pdf = summary_map_pdf_pages %>%
      unname() %>%
      purrr::imap(
        function(page, i) {

          z_index_text = if (
            is.null(page$test_z_index) &&
            is.null(page$ref_z_index)
          ) {

            NULL

          } else if (
            identical(
              page$test_z_index,
              page$ref_z_index
            )
          ) {

            stringr::str_glue(
              'Vertical level: z-index {page$test_z_index}'
            )

          } else {

            z_parts = character()

            if (!is.null(page$test_z_index)) {

              z_parts = c(
                z_parts,
                stringr::str_glue(
                  'Test z-index {page$test_z_index}'
                )
              )
            }

            if (!is.null(page$ref_z_index)) {

              z_parts = c(
                z_parts,
                stringr::str_glue(
                  'Reference z-index {page$ref_z_index}'
                )
              )
            }

            stringr::str_glue(
              'Vertical level: {stringr::str_c(z_parts, collapse = "; ")}'
            )
          }

          page_title = grid::textGrob(
            page$title,
            gp = grid::gpar(
              fontsize = 13,
              fontface = 'bold'
            )
          )

          page_header = if (is.null(z_index_text)) {

            page_title

          } else {

            gridExtra::arrangeGrob(
              page_title,
              grid::textGrob(
                z_index_text,
                gp = grid::gpar(
                  fontsize = 9
                )
              ),
              ncol = 1,
              heights = c(
                0.6,
                0.4
              )
            )
          }

          page_number = grid::textGrob(
            stringr::str_glue(
              'Page {i}'
            ),
            x = grid::unit(
              0.96,
              'npc'
            ),
            just = 'right',
            gp = grid::gpar(
              fontsize = 9
            )
          )

          gridExtra::arrangeGrob(
            page_header,
            page$grob,
            page_number,
            ncol = 1,
            heights = c(
              0.055,
              0.915,
              0.03
            )
          )
        }
      )


    # ---------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Create PDF front page
    # ---------------------------------------------------------------------

    front_page_title = grid::textGrob(
      'EMEP QAQC summary maps',
      x = 0.5,
      just = 'centre',
      gp = grid::gpar(
        fontsize = 18,
        fontface = 'bold'
      )
    )

    domain_info = domain_setup %>%
      dplyr::transmute(
        domain = stringr::str_to_title(
          domain
        ),
        domain_name = domain_name
      ) %>%
      dplyr::mutate(
        domain_line = stringr::str_glue(
          '{domain}: {domain_name}'
        )
      ) %>%
      dplyr::pull(
        domain_line
      ) %>%
      stringr::str_c(
        collapse = '\n'
      )

    front_page_info = c(
      'Test run',
      test_run_info
    )

    if (!is.null(ref_run_info)) {

      front_page_info = c(
        front_page_info,
        '',
        'Reference run',
        ref_run_info
      )
    }

    front_page_info = c(
      front_page_info,
      '',
      stringr::str_glue(
        'Domains:\n{domain_info}'
      ),
      '',
      'Test statistic',
      SUMMARY_MAP_TEST_STAT,
      '',
      'Test file tag',
      SUMMARY_MAP_TEST_FILE_TAG
    )

    if (!is.null(ref_run_info)) {

      front_page_info = c(
        front_page_info,
        '',
        'Reference statistic',
        SUMMARY_MAP_REF_STAT,
        '',
        'Reference file tag',
        SUMMARY_MAP_REF_FILE_TAG
      )
    }

    if (!is.null(SUMMARY_MAP_TEST_T_INDEX)) {

      front_page_info = c(
        front_page_info,
        '',
        'Test time index',
        SUMMARY_MAP_TEST_T_INDEX
      )
    }

    if (!is.null(SUMMARY_MAP_REF_T_INDEX)) {

      front_page_info = c(
        front_page_info,
        '',
        'Reference time index',
        SUMMARY_MAP_REF_T_INDEX
      )
    }

    if (!is.null(SUMMARY_MAP_TEST_Z_INDEX)) {

      front_page_info = c(
        front_page_info,
        '',
        'Test vertical index',
        SUMMARY_MAP_TEST_Z_INDEX
      )
    }

    if (!is.null(SUMMARY_MAP_REF_Z_INDEX)) {

      front_page_info = c(
        front_page_info,
        '',
        'Reference vertical index',
        SUMMARY_MAP_REF_Z_INDEX
      )
    }

    front_page_info_grob = grid::textGrob(
      paste(
        front_page_info,
        collapse = '\n'
      ),
      x = 0.5,
      just = 'centre',
      gp = grid::gpar(
        fontsize = 11,
        lineheight = 1.35
      )
    )

    summary_map_front_page = gridExtra::arrangeGrob(
      front_page_title,
      front_page_info_grob,
      ncol = 1,
      heights = c(
        0.18,
        0.82
      )
    )
  }


  # -----------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Determine suitable figure height for static maps shown in the HTML
  # report.
  #
  # Use the largest required height so that dynamically generated child
  # chunks can share one figure height.
  # -----------------------------------------------------------------------

  if (show_static_summary_maps) {

    report_map_heights = summary_map_plots %>%
      purrr::map(
        function(var_plots) {

          var_plots %>%
            purrr::map_dbl(
              function(plot_obj) {

                get_comp_map_fig_height(
                  map_stars = attr(
                    plot_obj,
                    'map_stars'
                  ),
                  n_plots = length(
                    plot_obj$plots
                  ),
                  fig_width = knitr::opts_chunk$get('fig.width') %||% 8.4
                )
              }
            )
        }
      ) %>%
      purrr::list_c()

    report_map_heights = report_map_heights[
      is.finite(report_map_heights) &
        !is.na(report_map_heights)
    ]

    if (length(report_map_heights) > 0) {

      report_map_height = max(
        report_map_heights
      )
    }
  }
}

```{r create-interactive-summary-maps, eval=REPORT_STYLE == 'interactive' && PLOT_INTERACTIVE_SUMMARY_MAPS}

interactive_summary_map_vars = intersect(
  summary_map_vars_report,
  names(summary_map_data)
)

if (length(interactive_summary_map_vars) == 0) {
  
  stop(
    "None of SUMMARY_MAP_VARS_REPORT were found in the available summary map data.",
    call. = FALSE
  )
}

summary_map_leaflet = summary_map_data[
  interactive_summary_map_vars
] %>%
  purrr::imap(
    function(this_diff, v) {

      is_ratio = stringr::str_detect(
        v,
        '_vs_'
      )
      
      plot_vars = if (is_ratio) {
        stringr::str_split(
          v,
          '_vs_'
        )[[1]]
      } else {
        v
      }
      
      plot_types = if (is_ratio) {
        INTERACTIVE_SUMMARY_MAP_TYPES %>%
          intersect(
            c(
              'test',
              'ref',
              'ratio'
            )
          )
      } else {
        INTERACTIVE_SUMMARY_MAP_TYPES %>%
          intersect(
            c(
              'test',
              'ref',
              'absdiff',
              'reldiff'
            )
          )
      }

      this_diff %>%
        purrr::imap(
          function(domain_diff, domain) {

            plot_summary_maps_leaflet(
              diff_list = stats::setNames(
                list(domain_diff),
                domain
              ),
              var_nm = plot_vars,
              map_types = plot_types,
              var_params_list = EMEP_VAR_PARAMS_LIST,
              testref_pal_pth = TESTREF_PALETTE,
              absdiff_pal_pth = ABSDIFF_PALETTE,
              reldiff_pal_pth = RELDIFF_PALETTE,
              display = INTERACTIVE_SUMMARY_MAP_DISPLAY,
              basemap = INTERACTIVE_SUMMARY_MAP_BASEMAP,
              opacity = INTERACTIVE_SUMMARY_MAP_OPACITY,
              hover_radius = INTERACTIVE_SUMMARY_MAP_HOVER_RADIUS,
              hover_values = INTERACTIVE_SUMMARY_MAP_HOVER_VALUES_OVERRIDE,
              hover_colour = INTERACTIVE_SUMMARY_MAP_HOVER_COLOUR,
              hover_max_points = INTERACTIVE_SUMMARY_MAP_HOVER_MAX_POINTS,
              show_leaflet_legend = INTERACTIVE_SUMMARY_MAP_LEGEND
            )
          }
        )
    }
  )

```{r include-summary-maps, results='asis', eval=PLOT_STATIC_SUMMARY_MAPS || PLOT_INTERACTIVE_SUMMARY_MAPS, fig.width=8.4}
available_summary_map_vars = unique(
  c(
    names(summary_map_plots %||% list()),
    names(summary_map_leaflet %||% list())
  )
)

summary_map_vars_to_render = summary_map_vars_report[
  summary_map_vars_report %in% available_summary_map_vars
] %>%
  sort()

chunk_fence = stringr::str_c(
  '`',
  '`',
  '`'
)

make_safe_chunk_label = function(
    x,
    i
) {

  out = x %>%
    stringr::str_replace_all(
      '[^A-Za-z0-9_-]+',
      '-'
    ) %>%
    stringr::str_replace_all(
      '^-|-$',
      ''
    )

  if (is.na(out) || out == '') {

    out = stringr::str_glue(
      'var-{i}'
    )
  }

  out
}

report_map_height_safe = if (
  !is.null(report_map_height) &&
  length(report_map_height) == 1 &&
  is.finite(report_map_height) &&
  !is.na(report_map_height)
) {

  report_map_height

} else {

  6
}


# -------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Create variable sections
#
# Static report:
#
# ## Variable
# ### Domain
# [static map]
#
# Interactive report, one map type:
#
# ## Variable {.tabset}
# ### Domain
# [map]
#
# Interactive report, both map types:
#
# ## Variable {.tabset}
# ### Domain {.tabset}
# #### Static
# [static map]
# #### Interactive
# [interactive map]
# -------------------------------------------------------------------------

summary_map_child = purrr::imap_chr(
  summary_map_vars_to_render,
  function(var_nm, i) {

    # ---------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Effective vertical index
    # ---------------------------------------------------------------------

    test_z_index = summary_map_z_index[[var_nm]]$test

    ref_z_index = summary_map_z_index[[var_nm]]$reference

    z_index_md = if (
      is.null(test_z_index) &&
      is.null(ref_z_index)
    ) {

      ''

    } else if (
      identical(
        test_z_index,
        ref_z_index
      )
    ) {

      stringr::str_glue(
        '\n\n*Vertical level: z-index {test_z_index}*\n\n'
      )

    } else {

      z_parts = character()

      if (!is.null(test_z_index)) {

        z_parts = c(
          z_parts,
          stringr::str_glue(
            'Test z-index {test_z_index}'
          )
        )
      }

      if (!is.null(ref_z_index)) {

        z_parts = c(
          z_parts,
          stringr::str_glue(
            'Reference z-index {ref_z_index}'
          )
        )
      }

      stringr::str_glue(
        '\n\n*Vertical level: {stringr::str_c(z_parts, collapse = "; ")}*\n\n'
      )
    }


    # ---------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Determine map types to display in the report
    # ---------------------------------------------------------------------

    show_static =
      show_static_summary_maps &&
      var_nm %in% names(
        summary_map_plots %||% list()
      )

    show_interactive =
      show_interactive_summary_maps &&
      var_nm %in% names(
        summary_map_leaflet %||% list()
      )

    show_both =
      show_static &&
      show_interactive

    safe_var_nm = make_safe_chunk_label(
      var_nm,
      i
    )


    # ---------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Determine domains available for this variable
    # ---------------------------------------------------------------------

    static_domains = if (show_static) {

      names(
        summary_map_plots[[var_nm]]
      )

    } else {

      character()
    }

    interactive_domains = if (show_interactive) {

      names(
        summary_map_leaflet[[var_nm]]
      )

    } else {

      character()
    }

    domain_names = unique(
      c(
        static_domains,
        interactive_domains
      )
    )


    # ---------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Create domain sections
    # ---------------------------------------------------------------------

    domain_chunks = purrr::imap_chr(
      domain_names,
      function(domain_id, domain_i) {

        domain_lab = EMEP_domains[[domain_id]]

        safe_domain = make_safe_chunk_label(
          domain_id,
          domain_i
        )

        this_static =
          show_static &&
          domain_id %in% static_domains

        this_interactive =
          show_interactive &&
          domain_id %in% interactive_domains

        this_show_both =
          this_static &&
          this_interactive


        # -----------------------------------------------------------------
        # Static map
        # -----------------------------------------------------------------

        static_chunk = if (this_static) {

          static_heading = if (this_show_both) {
            '\n\n#### Static\n\n'
          } else {
            '\n\n'
          }

          stringr::str_c(
            static_heading,
            glue::glue(
              .open = '<<',
              .close = '>>',
                '<<chunk_fence>>{r summary-map-static-<<safe_var_nm>>-<<safe_domain>>, echo=FALSE, fig.width=8.4, fig.height=report_map_height_safe, dpi=SUMMARY_MAP_REPORT_DPI, fig.retina=1}
  
  print(
    arrange_comp_map_output(
      summary_map_plots[["<<var_nm>>"]][["<<domain_id>>"]]
    )
  )
  
  <<chunk_fence>>
  
  '
            )
          )

        } else {

          ''
        }


        # -----------------------------------------------------------------
        # Interactive map
        # -----------------------------------------------------------------

        interactive_chunk = if (this_interactive) {

          interactive_heading = if (this_show_both) {
            '\n\n#### Interactive\n\n'
          } else {
            '\n\n'
          }

          stringr::str_c(
            interactive_heading,
            glue::glue(
              .open = '<<',
              .close = '>>',
              '<<chunk_fence>>{r summary-map-interactive-<<safe_var_nm>>-<<safe_domain>>, echo=FALSE}

              domain_maps = summary_map_leaflet[["<<var_nm>>"]][["<<domain_id>>"]]
              
              htmltools::tagList(
                purrr::imap(
                  domain_maps,
                  function(this_map, map_type) {
              
                    plot_title = dplyr::case_when(
                      map_type == "test" ~ PLOT_TITLES[1],
                      map_type == "ref" ~ PLOT_TITLES[2],
                      map_type == "absdiff" ~ PLOT_TITLES[3],
                      map_type == "reldiff" ~ PLOT_TITLES[4],
                      TRUE ~ NA_character_
                    )
              
                    map_type_label = if (
                      !is.na(plot_title) &&
                      nzchar(plot_title)
                    ) {
              
                      plot_title
              
                    } else {
              
                      dplyr::case_when(
                        map_type == "test" ~ test_label,
                        map_type == "ref" ~ ref_label,
                        map_type == "absdiff" ~ "Absolute difference",
                        map_type == "reldiff" ~ "Relative difference",
                        TRUE ~ stringr::str_to_sentence(
                          stringr::str_replace_all(
                            map_type,
                            "_",
                            " "
                          )
                        )
                      )
                    }
              
                    htmltools::tagList(
                      if (length(domain_maps) > 1) {
              
                        htmltools::tags$h4(
                          map_type_label
                        )
                      },
                      this_map
                    )
                  }
                )
              )
              
              <<chunk_fence>>
              
              '
            )
          )

        } else {

          ''
        }


        # -----------------------------------------------------------------
        # Domain heading
        #
        # In an interactive report, domains are tabs because the variable
        # heading is a tabset. If both static and interactive maps are
        # present, the domain itself becomes a nested tabset.
        # -----------------------------------------------------------------

        domain_heading = paste0(
          '\n\n### ',
          domain_lab,
          if (
            REPORT_STYLE == 'interactive' &&
            this_show_both
          ) {
            ' {.tabset}'
          } else {
            ''
          },
          '\n\n'
        )

        stringr::str_c(
          domain_heading,
          static_chunk,
          interactive_chunk
        )
      }
    ) %>%
      stringr::str_c(
        collapse = '\n'
      )


    # ---------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Variable heading
    #
    # Interactive reports use the variable heading as the domain tabset.
    # Static reports retain ordinary headings so all domains are visible
    # sequentially.
    # ---------------------------------------------------------------------

    variable_heading = paste0(
      '\n\n## ',
      var_nm,
      if (REPORT_STYLE == 'interactive') {
        ' {.tabset}'
      } else {
        ''
      },
      '\n\n'
    )

    stringr::str_c(
      variable_heading,
      z_index_md,
      domain_chunks
    )
  }
)


# -------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Render Maps section
# -------------------------------------------------------------------------

cat(
  knitr::knit_child(
    text = summary_map_child,
    envir = environment(),
    quiet = TRUE
  ),
  sep = '\n'
)

qaqc_task_timings[['Summary maps']] = tibble::tibble(
  task = 'Summary maps',
  runtime_seconds = as.numeric(
    difftime(
      Sys.time(),
      task_start,
      units = 'secs'
    )
  )
)
