```{r collate-mobs, eval=COLLATE_MOBS}

task_start = Sys.time()
if (COLLATE_MOBS) {
  
  # Remove outputs from any previous MOBS collation.

  old_mobs_files = fs::dir_ls(
    data_pth_out,
    type = 'file'
  ) %>%
    purrr::keep(
      ~ stringr::str_detect(
        fs::path_file(.x),
        '(?i)(^Sites_used\\.rds$|_mod_obs\\.rds$)'
      )
    )
  
  if (length(old_mobs_files) > 0) {
    
    fs::file_delete(
      old_mobs_files
    )
    
    logger::log_info(
      glue::glue(
        "Removed {length(old_mobs_files)} files from the previous MOBS collation"
      )
    )
  }
  
  # Read site metadata from all submitted observation repositories.
  # The order of TEST_OBS_DIR determines repository priority.
  
  sites_available = read_obs_sites_available(
    obs_dirs = TEST_OBS_DIR,
    year = test_time_range$start_year
  )
  
  # Resolve processed observation file paths. Stored paths may originate
  # from another user's filesystem, so fall back to the corresponding
  # submitted observation repository where necessary.
  
  sites_available = sites_available %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      output_pth = purrr::map2_chr(
        output_pth,
        obs_repo,
        resolve_obs_file_path
      )
    )
  
  message(
    glue::glue(
      "Loaded {nrow(sites_available)} monitoring sites from ",
      "{length(TEST_OBS_DIR)} observation repository/repositories."
    )
  )
  
  # Link the requested observed pollutants to their corresponding
  # EMEP variables.
  
  mobs_polls = OBSERVED_POLLS_EMEP_LINK[
    OBSERVED_POLLS
  ] %>%
    stats::na.omit()
  
  # Use the most nested submitted Test domain for MOBS collation.
  
  mobs_model_dir = test_date_dir
  
  # Use the fullrun output for the initial domain check because only a
  # two-dimensional spatial slice is required.
  
  mobs_domain_file = select_emep_file_from_dir(
    EMEP_dir = mobs_model_dir,
    file_tag = 'fullrun'
  )
  
  emep_slice = read_emep(
    mobs_domain_file,
    emep_var = unname(mobs_polls[1]),
    emep_crs = TEST_CRS,
    proxy = FALSE
  )
  
  sites_in = get_sites_in_domain(
    sites_available,
    emep_slice
  )
  
  # filter out duplicate sites (based on coordinates) by obs_priority
  sites_in = sites_in %>%
  dplyr::arrange(
    obs_priority
  ) %>%
  dplyr::distinct(
    latitude,
    longitude,
    .keep_all = TRUE
  )
  
  # Get the i and j grid indexes for the retained observation sites.

  set_parallel_plan(
    workers_requested = worker_cap
  )
  
  emep_indexes = furrr::future_pmap_dfr(
    list(
      longitude = sites_in$longitude,
      latitude = sites_in$latitude
    ),
    get_emep_indexes,
    emep_pth = mobs_domain_file,
    .options = furrr::furrr_options(
      seed = TRUE
    )
  )
  
  future::plan(
    future::sequential
  )
  
  if ('poll_info' %in% names(sites_in)) {
  
    sites_used = sites_in %>%
      dplyr::mutate(
        i = emep_indexes$row,
        j = emep_indexes$col,
        .before = poll_info
      )
    
  } else {
    
    sites_used = sites_in %>%
      dplyr::mutate(
        i = emep_indexes$row,
        j = emep_indexes$col
      )
  }
  
  logger::log_info(
    '"i" and "j" indexes for observation sites extracted and added to the dataframe'
  )
  
  sites_used = sites_used %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      obs_time_resolution = purrr::map_chr(
        output_pth,
        get_obs_file_time_resolution
      )
    )
  
  sites_used_pth = fs::path(
    data_pth_out,
    'Sites_used.rds'
  )
  
  readr::write_rds(
    sites_used,
    sites_used_pth
  )
  
  logger::log_info(
    glue::glue(
      "Saved metadata for {nrow(sites_used)} observation sites to Sites_used.rds"
    )
  )
  
  mobs_iterator = sites_used %>%
    sf::st_drop_geometry() %>%
    dplyr::select(
      code,
      source,
      obs_file = output_pth,
      i,
      j,
      obs_time_resolution,
      poll_info
    ) %>%
    tidyr::unnest(
      poll_info
    ) %>%
    dplyr::filter(
      poll %in% names(mobs_polls)
    ) %>%
    dplyr::rename(
      obs_var = poll
    ) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      emep_var = unname(
        mobs_polls[obs_var]
      )
    ) %>%
    dplyr::filter(
      !is.na(i),
      !is.na(j),
      !is.na(obs_file)
    )
  
  select_required_emep_file = function(
    emep_dir,
    resolution
  ) {
    
    emep_file = select_emep_file_from_dir(
      EMEP_dir = emep_dir,
      file_tag = resolution
    )
    
    if (length(emep_file) == 0) {
      stop(
        'No EMEP ',
        resolution,
        ' file was found, but this temporal resolution is required ',
        'by the submitted observation data.',
        call. = FALSE
      )
    }
    
    emep_file
  }
  
  mobs_emep_files = mobs_resolutions %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      emep_file = purrr::map_chr(
        obs_time_resolution,
        ~ select_required_emep_file(
          emep_dir = mobs_model_dir,
          resolution = .x
        )
      )
    )
  
  mobs_emep_files = mobs_emep_files %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      emep_vars_available = purrr::map(
        emep_file,
        ~ get_emep_vars(
          nc_file = .x,
          var_keywords = NULL
        )
      )
    )
  
  mobs_iterator = mobs_iterator %>%
    dplyr::left_join(
    mobs_emep_files,
    by = 'obs_time_resolution'
  )
  
  unsupported_mobs = mobs_iterator %>%
    dplyr::filter(
      !purrr::map2_lgl(
        emep_var,
        emep_vars_available,
        ~ .x %in% .y
      )
    ) %>%
    dplyr::distinct(
      obs_var,
      emep_var,
      obs_time_resolution,
      emep_file
    )
  
  if (nrow(unsupported_mobs) > 0) {
  
    unsupported_message = unsupported_mobs %>%
      dplyr::mutate(
        issue = glue::glue(
          '{obs_var}: {emep_var} is not available in the ',
          '{obs_time_resolution} EMEP file'
        )
      ) %>%
      dplyr::pull(
        issue
      ) %>%
      paste(
        collapse = '\n'
      )
    
    stop(
      paste0(
        'Some observation variables cannot be collated at their required ',
        'temporal resolution:\n\n',
        unsupported_message
      ),
      call. = FALSE
    )
  }
  
  mobs_iterator = mobs_iterator %>%
    dplyr::select(
      -emep_vars_available
    )
  
  set_parallel_plan(
    workers_requested = worker_cap
  )
  
  qaqc_parallel_info[['MOBS collation']] = tibble::tibble(
    section = 'MOBS collation',
    workers = unclass(future::nbrOfWorkers())
  )
  
  logger::log_info(
    'MOBS collation started'
  )
  
  mobs_tlist = furrr::future_pmap(
    list(
      nc_pth = mobs_iterator$emep_file,
      site_code = mobs_iterator$code,
      i_index = mobs_iterator$i,
      j_index = mobs_iterator$j,
      obs_file = mobs_iterator$obs_file,
      obs_var = mobs_iterator$obs_var,
      emep_var = mobs_iterator$emep_var
    ),
    purrr::safely(
      collate_emep_mobs
    ),
    .options = furrr::furrr_options(
      seed = TRUE
    )
  ) %>%
    purrr::transpose()
  
  future::plan(
    future::sequential
  )
  
  logger::log_info(
    'MOBS collation finished'
  )
  
  is_ok = mobs_tlist$error %>%
    purrr::map_lgl(
      is.null
    )
  
  logger::log_info(
    glue::glue(
      "{sum(is_ok)} of {length(is_ok)} site-pollutant ",
      "MOBS collations completed successfully"
    )
  )
  
  if (!any(is_ok)) {
    
    logger::log_error(
      'All MOBS collations failed - stopping.'
    )
    
    stop(
      'No successful site-pollutant combinations.',
      call. = FALSE
    )
  }
  
  if (any(!is_ok)) {
    
    mobs_failed = mobs_iterator[!is_ok, ] %>%
      dplyr::mutate(
        error = purrr::map_chr(
          mobs_tlist$error[!is_ok],
          conditionMessage
        )
      )
    
    logger::log_warn(
      glue::glue(
        "{nrow(mobs_failed)} site-pollutant MOBS collations failed"
      )
    )
    
    purrr::pwalk(
      mobs_failed,
      function(code, obs_var, emep_var, error, ...) {
        
        logger::log_warn(
          glue::glue(
            "{code}, {obs_var} ({emep_var}): {error}"
          )
        )
      }
    )
  }
  
  mobs_list = mobs_tlist$result[is_ok] %>%
    dplyr::bind_rows() %>%
    dplyr::distinct() %>%
    split(
      .$code
    )
  
  mobs_wide = mobs_list %>%
    purrr::map(
      function(x) {
        
        has_date = 'date' %in% names(x)
        has_start = 'start_date' %in% names(x)
        has_end = 'end_date' %in% names(x)
        
        regular = NULL
        interval = NULL
        
        if (has_date) {
          
          regular = x %>%
            dplyr::filter(
              !is.na(date)
            ) %>%
            dplyr::select(
              date,
              code,
              obs,
              mod,
              var
            )
          
          if (nrow(regular) > 0) {
            
            regular = regular %>%
              tidyr::pivot_wider(
                id_cols = c(
                  date,
                  code
                ),
                names_from = var,
                values_from = c(
                  obs,
                  mod
                )
              )
          } else {
            
            regular = NULL
          }
        }
        
        if (has_start && has_end) {
          
          interval = x %>%
            dplyr::filter(
              !is.na(start_date),
              !is.na(end_date)
            ) %>%
            dplyr::select(
              start_date,
              end_date,
              code,
              obs,
              mod,
              var
            )
          
          if (nrow(interval) > 0) {
            
            interval = interval %>%
              tidyr::pivot_wider(
                id_cols = c(
                  start_date,
                  end_date,
                  code
                ),
                names_from = var,
                values_from = c(
                  obs,
                  mod
                )
              )
          } else {
            
            interval = NULL
          }
        }
        
        list(
          regular = regular,
          interval = interval
        )
      }
    )
  
  mobs_data_pths = fs::path(
    data_pth_out,
    paste0(
      names(mobs_wide),
      '_mod_obs.rds'
    )
  )
  
  purrr::walk2(
    mobs_wide,
    mobs_data_pths,
    readr::write_rds
  )
  
  logger::log_info(
    glue::glue(
      "{length(mobs_data_pths)} site MOBS files written to {data_pth_out}"
    )
  )
}

qaqc_task_timings[['Collate mobs']] = tibble::tibble(
  task = 'Collate mobs',
  runtime_seconds = as.numeric(
    difftime(
      Sys.time(),
      task_start,
      units = 'secs'
    )
  )
)

task_start = Sys.time()
load_test_mobs_task_start = Sys.time()

mobs_domain_name = tail(

future::plan(

names(mobs_list) = mobs_pths %>%
  fs::path_file() %>%
  stringr::str_remove(
    '_mod_obs\\.rds$'
  )

dodgy_sites = mobs_list %>%
  purrr::keep(
    function(x) {
      
      regular_dodgy = !is.null(x$regular) &&
        (
          !'obs' %in% names(x$regular) ||
            is.list(x$regular$obs)
        )
      
      interval_dodgy = !is.null(x$interval) &&
        (
          !'obs' %in% names(x$interval) ||
            is.list(x$interval$obs)
        )
      
      regular_dodgy || interval_dodgy
    }
  )

if (length(dodgy_sites) > 0) {
  
  logger::log_warn(
    glue::glue(
      "Removing {length(dodgy_sites)} site(s) with invalid observation data: ",
      "{paste(names(dodgy_sites), collapse = ', ')}"

  )
  
  mobs_list = mobs_list[
    !names(mobs_list) %in% names(dodgy_sites)
  ]
}

ox_var = if (OX_UNITS == 'ppb') {
  'ox(ppb)'
} else if (OX_UNITS == 'ug/m3') {
  'ox'
} else {
  stop(

    call. = FALSE
  )
}

if (ox_var %in% OBSERVED_POLLS) {
  
  mobs_list = mobs_list %>%
    purrr::map(
      function(mobs) {
        
        if (!is.null(mobs$regular)) {
          
          mobs$regular = add_ox(

            units = OX_UNITS
          )
        }
        
        mobs
      }
    )
}

sites_geo = sites_geo %>%

) {
  
  MOBS_STATION_REPORT_TSERIES %>%

    )
  
} else {

names(report_tseries_config) = report_site_codes

# retain only requested sites with available MOBS data

if (length(missing_report_site_codes) > 0) {
  
  logger::log_warn(

      "Requested MOBS time-series site(s) not available for reporting: ",

  )
}

report_site_codes = intersect(

)

report_tseries_config = report_tseries_config[

]

ox_var = if (OX_UNITS == 'ppb') {
  'ox(ppb)'
} else if (OX_UNITS == 'ug/m3') {
  'ox'
} else {
  stop(
    'Units for Ox calculation can either be "ppb" or "ug/m3".',
    call. = FALSE
  )
}

if (ox_var %in% OBSERVED_POLLS) {
  
  ref_mobs_list = ref_mobs_list %>%
    purrr::map(
      function(mobs) {
        
        if (!is.null(mobs$regular)) {
          
          mobs$regular = add_ox(
            mobs$regular,
            units = OX_UNITS
          )
        }
        
        mobs
      }
    )
}
  
  names(ref_mobs_list) = ref_mobs_pths %>%
    fs::path_file() %>%
    stringr::str_remove(
      '_mod_obs\\.rds$'
    )
}

qaqc_task_timings[['Load reference MOBS']] = tibble::tibble(
  task = 'Load reference MOBS',
  runtime_seconds = as.numeric(
    difftime(
      Sys.time(),
      load_ref_mobs_task_start,
      units = 'secs'
    )
  )
)

sites_geo_map_sub = if (length(report_site_codes) > 0) {
  sites_geo %>%
    dplyr::filter(code %in% report_site_codes)
} else {
  sites_geo[0, ]
}

highlight_sites_for_map = if (nrow(sites_geo_map_sub) > 0) {
  sites_geo_map_sub
} else {
  NULL
}

mobs_grouping_var = MOBS_GROUPING_VAR

if (!is.null(mobs_grouping_var)) {
  if (!mobs_grouping_var %in% names(sites_geo)) {
    logger::log_warn(glue::glue("Grouping column '{mobs_grouping_var}' not found - plotting ungrouped."))
    mobs_grouping_var = NULL
  }
}

n_site_types = if (!is.null(mobs_grouping_var)) {
  sites_geo %>%
    dplyr::pull(dplyr::all_of(mobs_grouping_var)) %>%
    unique() %>%
    stats::na.omit() %>%
    length()
} else {
  1
}

show_site_type_legend = is.null(mobs_grouping_var) || n_site_types > 1

if (is.null(mobs_grouping_var)) {
  m = plot_mobs_sites_map2(
    sites_geo,
    legend_label = 'Monitoring site',

} else {

    highlight_label = 'Sites shown in report'
  )
}

# unique choices for autocomplete (code / station / site / name squished)
na2empty = function(x) if (is.null(x)) "" else ifelse(is.na(x), "", as.character(x))

code_vec    = if ("code"    %in% names(sites_geo)) sites_geo$code    else rep("", nrow(sites_geo))
station_vec = if ("station" %in% names(sites_geo)) sites_geo$station else rep("", nrow(sites_geo))
site_vec    = if ("site"    %in% names(sites_geo)) sites_geo$site    else rep("", nrow(sites_geo))
name_vec    = if ("name"    %in% names(sites_geo)) sites_geo$name    else rep("", nrow(sites_geo))

sites_geo_search = sites_geo %>%
  mutate(search_key = str_squish(
    paste(na2empty(code_vec), na2empty(station_vec), na2empty(site_vec), na2empty(name_vec))
  ))

search_choices = sites_geo_search %>%
  distinct(search_key) %>%
  filter(nchar(search_key) > 0) %>%
  arrange(search_key) %>%
  pull(search_key)

if (all(c('longitude', 'latitude') %in% names(sites_geo_search))) {
  m = m %>%
    leaflet::addCircleMarkers(
      data = sites_geo_search,
      lng = ~longitude,
      lat = ~latitude,
      opacity = 0,
      fillOpacity = 0,
      radius = 0.1,
      popup = ~search_key,
      group = 'search_layer',
      options = leaflet::pathOptions(
        interactive = FALSE
      )
    )
} else {
  # assume sf geometry is present
  m = m %>%
    leaflet::addCircleMarkers(
      data = sites_geo_search,
      opacity = 0,
      fillOpacity = 0,
      radius = 0.1,
      popup = ~search_key,
      group = 'search_layer',
      options = leaflet::pathOptions(
        interactive = FALSE
      )
    )
}

m = m %>%
  htmlwidgets::onRender(
    "
function(el, x){
  var map = this;

  function flyToMatch(q){
    if(!q) return;
    q = (''+q).toLowerCase().trim();
    var hit = null;

    map.eachLayer(function(lyr){
      if (!hit && lyr && lyr.options && lyr.options.group === 'search_layer' && lyr.getLatLng){
        var txt = '';

        if (lyr.getPopup && lyr.getPopup()){
          txt = ('' + lyr.getPopup().getContent()).toLowerCase();
        } else if (lyr.options.layerId){
          txt = ('' + lyr.options.layerId).toLowerCase();
        }

        if (txt.indexOf(q) !== -1) hit = lyr;
      }
    });

    if (hit){
      var ll = hit.getLatLng();
      map.flyTo(ll, 10);
    }
  }

  function bindBox(){
    var box = document.getElementById('site_search_input');
    if (!box) return;
    box.addEventListener('change', function(){ flyToMatch(this.value); });
    box.addEventListener('keydown', function(e){ if(e.key === 'Enter'){ flyToMatch(this.value); } });
  }

  setTimeout(bindBox, 0);
}
    "
  )

# datalist options (escape just in case)
dl_opts = lapply(search_choices, function(val) {
  htmltools::tags$option(value = htmltools::htmlEscape(val))
})

# RENDER: map + input together (no print/browsable)
htmltools::tagList(
  m,
  htmltools::tags$div(
    style = "margin-top: .75rem; max-width: 600px;",
    htmltools::tags$label(`for` = "site_search_input", "Search monitoring sites:"),
    htmltools::tags$input(
      id = "site_search_input", type = "text", list = "site_choices",
      placeholder = "Type and press Enter...",
      style = "width: 100%; padding: .4rem .5rem; margin-top: .25rem;"
    ),
    htmltools::tags$datalist(id = "site_choices", dl_opts)
  )
)

```{r prepare_mobs_tseries, include=FALSE, eval = PLOT_MOBS_TSERIES}

# Plot daily and hourly MOBS time series per site.
# Data preparation and optional PDF writing are parallelised.
# If the report is pure R, set_parallel_plan() can use multicore on HPC and
# multisession on Windows.

mobs_tseries_prep_task_start = Sys.time()

mobs_tseries_labels = MOBS_TSERIES_LABELS

if (is.na(mobs_tseries_labels['ref_mod'])) {
  mobs_tseries_labels['ref_mod'] = RUN_LABELS[[2]]
}

mobs_tzone = if (isTRUE(MOBS_USE_LOCAL_TIME)) {
    'local'
  } else {
    'UTC'
  }

if (isTRUE(MOBS_USE_LOCAL_TIME)) {
  
  tz_sf = sf::st_read(
    TIMEZONE_FILE_PTH,
    quiet = TRUE
  ) %>%
    sf::st_make_valid() %>%
    dplyr::select(timezone = tzid) %>%
    sf::st_transform(sf::st_crs(sites_geo))
  
  nearest_tz_idx = sf::st_nearest_feature(sites_geo, tz_sf)
  
  sites_geo = sites_geo %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      timezone = tz_sf$timezone[nearest_tz_idx]
    )
  
  mobs_site_codes = names(mobs_list)
  
  missing_tzone = sites_geo %>%
    sf::st_drop_geometry() %>%
    dplyr::filter(
      code %in% mobs_site_codes,
      is.na(timezone)
    ) %>%
    dplyr::pull(code) %>%
    unique()
  
  if (length(missing_tzone) > 0) {
    logger::log_warn(
      glue::glue(
        'No timezone assigned to the following sites: {paste(missing_tzone, collapse = ", ")}. ',
        'These sites will be plotted in UTC.'
      )
    )
  }
  
} else if (!'timezone' %in% names(sites_geo)) {
  
  sites_geo = sites_geo %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      timezone = NA_character_
    )
}

sites_meta = if (inherits(sites_geo, 'sf')) {
  sf::st_drop_geometry(sites_geo)
} else {
  sites_geo
}

sites_meta = sites_meta %>%
  dplyr::select(
    dplyr::any_of(c('code', 'station', 'site', 'name', 'timezone', MOBS_GROUPING_VAR))
  ) %>%
  dplyr::distinct()

mobs_tseries_workers = set_parallel_plan(
  workers_requested = worker_cap,
  max_workers = 4,
  prefer_multicore = TRUE
)

qaqc_parallel_info[['MOBS time series prep']] = tibble::tibble(
  section = 'MOBS time series prep',
  workers = unclass(future::nbrOfWorkers())
)

mobs_tseries_opts = furrr::furrr_options(
  seed = TRUE,
  scheduling = Inf,
  packages = c(
    'dplyr',
    'tidyr',
    'lubridate',
    'purrr',
    'tibble',
    'openair',
    'stringr'
  ),
  globals = c(
    'format_mobs_to_plot',
    'summarise_mobs',
    'calculate_cumsum',
    'resolve_mobs_plot_tzone',
    'resolve_var_id',
    'mobs_tzone',
    'MOBS_THRESHOLD',
    'MOBS_TSERIES_VARS',
    'MOBS_TSERIES_SUMMARY_TIME',
    'MOBS_TSERIES_SUMMARY_STAT',
    'sites_meta'
  )
)

# keep only variables requested for MOBS time-series plots.
# expanded includes 'subprecip'
MOBS_TSERIES_VARS_EXPANDED = MOBS_TSERIES_VARS %>%
  purrr::map(function(var_nm) {
    
    var_id = resolve_var_id(
      var = var_nm,
      var_params_list = EMEP_VAR_PARAMS_LIST
    )
    
    c(
      var_nm,
      var_id,
      get_var_param(
        var = var_id,
        key = 'aliases',
        var_params_list = EMEP_VAR_PARAMS_LIST,
        default = character()
      )
    )
  }) %>%
  unlist() %>%
  unique()

mobs_list_for_plot = mobs_list %>%
  purrr::map(
    function(mobs) {
      
      df = mobs$regular
      
      if (is.null(df) || nrow(df) == 0) {
        return(NULL)
      }
      
      df %>%
        dplyr::filter(
          var %in% MOBS_TSERIES_VARS_EXPANDED
        )
    }
  ) %>%
  purrr::compact()

if (
  PLOT_REF_TSERIES &&
  !is.null(REF_MOBS_DIR) &&
  exists('ref_mobs_list')
) {
  
  mobs_list_for_plot = purrr::imap(
    mobs_list_for_plot,
    function(test_df, site_code) {
      
      if (is.null(test_df) || nrow(test_df) == 0) {
        return(test_df)
      }
      
      ref_mobs = ref_mobs_list[[site_code]]
      
      if (is.null(ref_mobs)) {
        return(test_df)
      }
      
      ref_df = ref_mobs$regular
      
      if (is.null(ref_df) || nrow(ref_df) == 0) {
        return(test_df)
      }
      
      ref_df = ref_df %>%
        dplyr::filter(
          var %in% MOBS_TSERIES_VARS_EXPANDED
        ) %>%
        dplyr::select(
          code,
          date,
          var,
          ref_mod = mod
        )
      
      test_df %>%
        dplyr::left_join(
          ref_df,
          by = c(
            'code',
            'date',
            'var'
          )
        )
    }
  )
}

# If standalone PDFs are not required, only prepare sites that will
# actually be shown in the HTML report.

if (!isTRUE(SAVE_STATIC_OUTPUTS)) {
  mobs_list_for_plot = mobs_list_for_plot[
    intersect(
      report_site_codes,
      names(mobs_list_for_plot)
    )
  ]
}

mobs_plotlist = mobs_list_for_plot %>%
  furrr::future_map(
    function(df) {
      
      if (is.null(df) || nrow(df) == 0) {
        return(NULL)
      }
      
      site_code = df %>%
        dplyr::pull(code) %>%
        unique() %>%
        .[1]
      
      site_tzone = resolve_mobs_plot_tzone(
        site_code = site_code,
        sites_meta = sites_meta,
        mobs_tzone = mobs_tzone,
        timezone_col = 'timezone'
      )
      
    df %>%
      dplyr::mutate(
        date = lubridate::with_tz(date, tzone = site_tzone)
      ) %>%
      dplyr::filter(
        lubridate::year(date) == min(lubridate::year(date), na.rm = TRUE)
      ) %>%
      dplyr::group_by(var) %>%
      dplyr::filter(
        any(is.finite(mod)),
        date >= min(date[is.finite(mod)], na.rm = TRUE),
        date <= max(date[is.finite(mod)], na.rm = TRUE)
      ) %>%
      dplyr::ungroup() %>%
      format_mobs_to_plot(
        data_thresh = MOBS_THRESHOLD,
        drop_na_mod = FALSE, # this is used in summarise_mobs, not for plotting
        avg_time = MOBS_TSERIES_SUMMARY_TIME,
        summary_stat = MOBS_TSERIES_SUMMARY_STAT
      ) %>%
      dplyr::left_join(sites_meta, by = 'code')
    },
    .options = mobs_tseries_opts
  ) %>%
  purrr::compact()

future::plan(future::sequential)

names(mobs_plotlist) = mobs_plotlist %>%
  purrr::map_chr(~ .x %>%
                   dplyr::pull('code') %>%
                   unique() %>%
                   .[1])

qaqc_task_timings[['MOBS time series prep']] = tibble::tibble(
  task = 'MOBS time series prep',
  runtime_seconds = as.numeric(
    difftime(
      Sys.time(),
      mobs_tseries_prep_task_start,
      units = 'secs'
    )
  )
)

```{r prepare-mobs-tseries-text-flags, echo = FALSE, eval = PLOT_MOBS_TSERIES}
mobs_report_tseries_period = parse_mobs_tseries_period(
  MOBS_STATION_REPORT_TSERIES_PERIOD %||% NULL
)

get_report_tseries_vars_for_site = function(
    df,
    cfg,
    period,
    var_params_list,
    var_param_names = NULL,
    var_order = NULL
) {
  
  resolution = cfg$resolution %||% 'summary'
  
  if (resolution == 'raw') {
    
    data_tbl = df %>%
      dplyr::filter(month > 0) %>%
      dplyr::pull(data) %>%
      dplyr::bind_rows() %>%
      filter_mobs_tseries_period(
        period = period
      )
    
  } else {
    
    data_tbl = df %>%
      dplyr::filter(month == -1) %>%
      dplyr::pull(data) %>%
      dplyr::bind_rows() %>%
      filter_mobs_tseries_period(
        period = period
      )
  }
  
  if (nrow(data_tbl) == 0) {
    return(character())
  }
  
  vars_available = unique(data_tbl$var) %>%
    setdiff('subprecip')
  
  vars_available = vars_available[
    purrr::map_lgl(
      vars_available,
      function(var_nm) {
        
        var_param_nm = if (
          !is.null(var_param_names) &&
            var_nm %in% names(var_param_names)
        ) {
          var_param_names[[var_nm]]
        } else {
          var_nm
        }
        
        resolve_var_id(
          var = var_param_nm,
          var_params_list = var_params_list
        ) %in% names(var_params_list)
      }
    )
  ]
  
  vars_selected = if (is.null(cfg$vars)) {
    vars_available
  } else {
    intersect(vars_available, cfg$vars)
  }
  
  if (!is.null(var_order)) {
    
    vars_selected = c(
      var_order[
        var_order %in% vars_selected
      ],
      vars_selected[
        !vars_selected %in% var_order
      ]
    )
    
  } else {
    
    vars_selected = vars_selected[
      order(
        get_var_order_index(
          vars_selected,
          var_params_list
        ),
        vars_selected
      )
    ]
  }
  
  vars_selected
}

mobs_report_tseries_period = parse_mobs_tseries_period(
  MOBS_STATION_REPORT_TSERIES_PERIOD %||% NULL
)

report_site_codes_used = intersect(

)

show_ref_tseries_note = purrr::map2_lgl(
  report_mobs_plotlist_used,
  report_tseries_config_used,
  function(df, cfg) {
    
    resolution = cfg$resolution %||% 'summary'
    
    if (resolution == 'raw') {
      
      data_tbl = df %>%
        dplyr::filter(month > 0) %>%
        dplyr::pull(data) %>%
        dplyr::bind_rows() %>%
        filter_mobs_tseries_period(
          period = mobs_report_tseries_period
        )
      
    } else {
      
      data_tbl = df %>%
        dplyr::filter(month == -1) %>%
        dplyr::pull(data) %>%
        dplyr::bind_rows() %>%
        filter_mobs_tseries_period(
          period = mobs_report_tseries_period
        )
    }
    
    'ref_mod' %in% names(data_tbl) &&
      any(is.finite(data_tbl$ref_mod))
  }
) %>%
  any()

```{r mobs_report_plot_tseries, eval = PLOT_MOBS_TSERIES && exists('sites_geo_map_sub') && nrow(sites_geo_map_sub) != 0, results = 'asis'}

if (length(MOBS_STATION_REPORT_TSERIES) > 0) {

  # Prepare interactive MOBS time series for the report.
  
  mobs_report_tseries_period = parse_mobs_tseries_period(
    MOBS_STATION_REPORT_TSERIES_PERIOD %||% NULL
  )
  
  period_label = format_mobs_period_label(
    list(
      period_start = mobs_report_tseries_period$start,
      period_end = mobs_report_tseries_period$end
    )
  )
  
  summary_label = format_mobs_summary_label(
    summary_time = MOBS_TSERIES_SUMMARY_TIME,
    summary_stat = MOBS_TSERIES_SUMMARY_STAT
  )
  
  
  # Create individual interactive plot ----------------------------------------
  
  make_interactive_plot_block = function(
      data,
      var,
      site_name,
      var_params_list,
      var_param_names = NULL,
      summary_label,
      resolution = 'summary',
      period_label = NULL
  ) {
    
    var_param_nm = if (
      !is.null(var_param_names) &&
        var %in% names(var_param_names)
    ) {
      var_param_names[[var]]
    } else {
      var
    }
    
    plot_height = if (resolution == 'raw') {
      340
    } else {
      280
    }
    
    htmltools::tags$div(
      class = 'mobs-ts-block',
      style = paste(
        'margin-top: 1.0em;',
        'margin-bottom: 1.0em;'
      ),
      htmltools::tags$div(
        style = paste(
          stringr::str_glue(
            'height: {plot_height}px;'
          ),
          'margin: 0;',
          'padding: 0;',
          'overflow: visible;'
        ),
        plot_mobs_tseries_interactive(
          df = data,
          var_nm = var,
          site_name = site_name,
          var_param_nm = var_param_nm,
          var_params_list = var_params_list,
          height = plot_height,
          obs_style = MOBS_TSERIES_OBS_STYLE,
          obs_alpha = MOBS_TSERIES_OBS_ALPHA,
          ref_colour = MOBS_REF_PLOT_PARAMS[['colour']],
          ref_linetype = MOBS_REF_PLOT_PARAMS[['linetype']],
          ref_linewidth = MOBS_REF_PLOT_PARAMS[['linewidth']],
          legend_labels = mobs_tseries_labels,
          x_resolution = resolution
        )
      )
    )
  }
  
  
  # Monitoring-site key -------------------------------------------------------
  
  site_name_col = c(
    'site',
    'site_name',
    'name'
  ) %>%
    intersect(
      names(sites_geo)
    ) %>%
    dplyr::first(
      default = NA_character_
    )
  
  site_key = sites_geo %>%
    sf::st_drop_geometry() %>%
    dplyr::filter(
      code %in% names(report_mobs_plotlist_used)
    ) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      site_name = if (!is.na(site_name_col)) {
        as.character(.data[[site_name_col]])
      } else {
        NA_character_
      }
    ) %>%
    dplyr::select(
      code,
      site_name
    ) %>%
    dplyr::distinct() %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      code = factor(
        code,
        levels = names(report_mobs_plotlist_used)
      )
    ) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(
      code
    ) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      code = as.character(code)
    )

  
  cat(
    stringr::str_to_sentence(
      paste0(
        summary_label,
       ' data are shown for all selected sites.\n\n'
      )
    )
  )
  
  
  # Site-code key -------------------------------------------------------------
  
  if (nrow(site_key) > 0) {
    
    site_key_tbl_data = site_key %>%
      dplyr::left_join(
        sites_geo %>%
          sf::st_drop_geometry() %>%
          dplyr::select(
            code,
            dplyr::any_of(MOBS_GROUPING_VAR)
          ) %>%
          dplyr::distinct(),
        by = 'code'
      ) %>%
      dplyr::select(
        site_name,
        dplyr::any_of(MOBS_GROUPING_VAR),
        code
      )
    
    site_key_tbl = site_key_tbl_data %>%
      gt::gt() %>%
      gt::sub_missing(
        columns = dplyr::everything(),
        missing_text = ''
      ) %>%
      gt::cols_label(
        site_name = 'Monitoring site',
        code = 'Code'
      )
    
    if (
      !is.null(MOBS_GROUPING_VAR) &&
      length(MOBS_GROUPING_VAR) == 1 &&
      MOBS_GROUPING_VAR %in% names(site_key_tbl_data)
    ) {
      site_key_tbl = site_key_tbl %>%
        gt::cols_label(
          !!rlang::sym(MOBS_GROUPING_VAR) :=
            MOBS_GROUPING_VAR_LABEL
        )
    }
    
    site_key_tbl = site_key_tbl %>%
      gt::tab_options(
        data_row.padding = gt::px(3),
        table.align = 'left'
      )
    
    print(site_key_tbl)
  }
  
  
  # Site tabs and pollutant subtabs -------------------------------------------
  
  purrr::walk2(
    report_mobs_plotlist_used,
    report_tseries_config_used,
    function(site_df, site_cfg) {
      
      site_code = unique(
        site_df$code
      )[1]
      
      site_name = site_key %>%
        dplyr::filter(
          code == site_code
        ) %>%
        dplyr::pull(
          site_name
        ) %>%
        dplyr::first(
          default = NA_character_
        )
      
      site_name_heading = stringr::str_remove_all(
        site_name,
        fixed('.')
      )
      
      site_label = if (
        is.na(site_name_heading) ||
        site_name_heading == '' ||
        site_name_heading == site_code
      ) {
        site_code
      } else {
        paste0(
          site_name_heading,
          ' (',
          site_code,
          ')'
        )
      }
      
      cat(
        '\n\n### ',
        site_label,
        '\n\n',
        sep = ''
      )
      
      
      site_vars = filter_report_site_vars(
        df = site_df,
        cfg = site_cfg,
        period = mobs_report_tseries_period,
        var_params_list = EMEP_VAR_PARAMS_LIST,
        var_param_names = mobs_var_params,
        var_order = OBSERVED_POLLS
      )
      
      
      if (nrow(site_vars) == 0) {
        
        cat(
          'No time-series variables are available for this site.\n\n'
        )
        
        return(invisible(NULL))
      }
      
      
      for (i in seq_len(nrow(site_vars))) {
        
        var_nm = site_vars$var[[i]]
        
        var_param_nm = if (
          var_nm %in% names(mobs_var_params)
        ) {
          mobs_var_params[[var_nm]]
        } else {
          var_nm
        }
        
        
        var_heading = format_var_label_emep(
          var = var_param_nm,
          var_params_list = EMEP_VAR_PARAMS_LIST,
          context = 'mobs',
          output = 'html',
          include_units = FALSE
        )
        
        
        p = make_interactive_plot_block(
          data = site_vars$data[[i]],
          var = var_nm,
          site_name = site_name,
          var_params_list = EMEP_VAR_PARAMS_LIST,
          var_param_names = mobs_var_params,
          summary_label = summary_label,
          resolution = site_vars$resolution[[i]],
          period_label = period_label
        )
        
        
        child_env = new.env(
          parent = environment()
        )
        
        child_env$var_heading = var_heading
        child_env$p = p
        
        
        child_text = c(
          '#### `r var_heading`',
          '',
          '```{r, echo=FALSE}',
          'p',
          '```',
          ''
        )
        
        
        cat(
          knitr::knit_child(
            text = child_text,
            envir = child_env,
            quiet = TRUE
          ),
          sep = '\n'
        )
      }
    }
  )

}

```{r modStats, include = F, eval = MOBS_EVALUATION_OUTPUTS}

evaluate_mobs_task_start = Sys.time()
# Prepare regular MOBS data for evaluation.

mobs_regular_eval = mobs_list %>%
  purrr::map(function(mobs) {

    df = mobs$regular

    if (is.null(df) || nrow(df) == 0) {
      return(NULL)
    }

    df %>%
      dplyr::filter(
        date >= test_time_range$first_time,
        date < test_time_range$last_time,
        var %in% MOBS_EVAL_VARS
      ) %>%
      dplyr::mutate(
        # Mask observations wherever modelled data are missing.
        obs = dplyr::if_else(
          is.na(mod),
          NA_real_,
          obs
        )
      )
  })


# Calculate temporal modstats for each site.
test_mobs_regular_site_stats = mobs_regular_eval %>%
  purrr::map_dfr(
    calculate_modstats,
    modstats = MODSTATS_STATS,
    type = c('code', 'var'),
    pretty_format = FALSE
  ) %>%
  dplyr::filter(n > 0) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(var)


# Add site metadata to regular site-level modstats.
site_meta_for_stats = sites_geo %>%
  sf::st_drop_geometry() %>%
  dplyr::select(
    dplyr::any_of(c(
      'code',
      'site',
      'station',
      MOBS_GROUPING_VAR
    ))
  ) %>%
  dplyr::distinct(
    code,
    .keep_all = TRUE
  )


test_mobs_regular_site_stats = test_mobs_regular_site_stats %>%
  dplyr::ungroup() %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    site_meta_for_stats,
    by = 'code'
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    run = test_label
  ) %>%
  dplyr::relocate(
    run,
    code,
    dplyr::any_of(
      c(
        'site',
        'station',
        MOBS_GROUPING_VAR
      )
    ),
    var
  ) %>%
  format_mobs_group_labels(
    grouping_var = MOBS_GROUPING_VAR,
    missing_label = 'All sites'
  ) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(
    code,
    dplyr::across(
      dplyr::any_of(
        c(
          'site',
          'station'
        )
      )
    ),
    get_var_order_index(
      var,
      EMEP_VAR_PARAMS_LIST
    ),
    var
  )

test_mobs_regular_site_stats %>%
  dplyr::group_by(var) %>%
  dplyr::group_split() %>%
  purrr::walk(function(df) {

    this_var = unique(df$var)

    readr::write_csv(
      df,
      fs::path(
        tables_pth_out,
        stringr::str_glue(
          'Mobs_modstats_{this_var}.csv'
        )
      )
    )
  })


# Calculate modelled-period means for each site.
test_mobs_regular_site_means = mobs_regular_eval %>%
  purrr::map_dfr(
    summarise_mobs,
    avg_time = 'period',
    summary_stat = 'mean',
    data_thresh = MOBS_THRESHOLD,
    drop_na_mod = TRUE,
    start_date = NULL,
    end_date = NULL
  )

# Prepare interval MOBS data for evaluation.

mobs_interval_eval = mobs_list %>%
  purrr::map(function(mobs) {

    df = mobs$interval

    if (is.null(df) || nrow(df) == 0) {
      return(NULL)
    }

    df %>%
      dplyr::filter(
        start_date >= test_time_range$first_time,
        end_date <= test_time_range$last_time,
        var %in% MOBS_EVAL_VARS
      ) %>%
      dplyr::mutate(
        interval_hours = as.numeric(
          difftime(
            end_date,
            start_date,
            units = 'hours'
          )
        ),
        obs = dplyr::if_else(
          is.na(mod),
          NA_real_,
          obs
        )
      )
  })


# Calculate duration-weighted modelled-period means for each site.

test_mobs_interval_site_means = mobs_interval_eval %>%
  purrr::map_dfr(function(df) {

    if (is.null(df) || nrow(df) == 0) {
      return(NULL)
    }

    df %>%
      dplyr::filter(
        is.finite(mod),
        is.finite(obs),
        is.finite(interval_hours),
        interval_hours > 0
      ) %>%
      dplyr::group_by(
        code,
        var
      ) %>%
      dplyr::summarise(
        mod = stats::weighted.mean(
          mod,
          w = interval_hours
        ),
        obs = stats::weighted.mean(
          obs,
          w = interval_hours
        ),
        .groups = 'drop'
      )
  })

# Check that site-variable combinations occur in only one MOBS data type.

if (
  nrow(test_mobs_regular_site_means) > 0 &&
  nrow(test_mobs_interval_site_means) > 0
) {

  duplicate_mobs_site_vars = dplyr::inner_join(
    test_mobs_regular_site_means %>%
      dplyr::distinct(
        code,
        var
      ),
    test_mobs_interval_site_means %>%
      dplyr::distinct(
        code,
        var
      ),
    by = c(
      'code',
      'var'
    )
  )

  if (nrow(duplicate_mobs_site_vars) > 0) {

    duplicate_mobs_site_vars_text =
      duplicate_mobs_site_vars %>%
      dplyr::transmute(
        site_var = paste0(
          code,
          ' (',
          var,
          ')'
        )
      ) %>%
      dplyr::pull(site_var) %>%
      toString()

    stop(
      paste0(
        'The following Test site-variable combinations occur in ',
        'both regular and interval MOBS data: ',
        duplicate_mobs_site_vars_text,
        '. Each site-variable combination must use only one ',
        'observation data type.'
      ),
      call. = FALSE
    )
  }
}
# Combine regular and interval site means.

test_mobs_site_means = dplyr::bind_rows(
  test_mobs_regular_site_means,
  test_mobs_interval_site_means
)

test_mobs_site_means = test_mobs_site_means %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    site_meta_for_stats,
    by = 'code'
  )

# Modstats for modelled-period means across sites, spatial.

test_mobs_stats = calculate_modstats(
  test_mobs_site_means,
  modstats = MODSTATS_STATS,
  type = 'var',
  pretty_format = FALSE
)

if (
  !is.null(MOBS_GROUPING_VAR) &&
  MOBS_GROUPING_VAR %in% names(test_mobs_site_means)
) {

  test_mobs_stats = calculate_modstats(
    test_mobs_site_means,
    modstats = MODSTATS_STATS,
    type = unique(c('var', MOBS_GROUPING_VAR)),
    pretty_format = FALSE
  ) %>%
    dplyr::bind_rows(
      test_mobs_stats
    ) %>%
    dplyr::filter(
      n > 0
    ) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(
      get_var_order_index(
        var,
        EMEP_VAR_PARAMS_LIST
      ),
      var
    ) %>%
    dplyr::relocate(
      dplyr::any_of(MOBS_GROUPING_VAR),
      .after = var
    ) %>%
    format_mobs_group_labels(
      grouping_var = MOBS_GROUPING_VAR,
      missing_label = 'All sites'
    )
}


# Save spatial modstats to CSV.

readr::write_csv(
  test_mobs_stats,
  fs::path(
    tables_pth_out,
    'Mobs_modstats.csv'
  )
)



# Prepare spatial modstats for the report table.

test_mobs_stats_table = test_mobs_stats %>%
  dplyr::ungroup() %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    run = test_label
  ) %>%
  dplyr::relocate(
    run,
    var,
    dplyr::any_of(MOBS_GROUPING_VAR)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(
    get_var_order_index(
      var,
      EMEP_VAR_PARAMS_LIST
    ),
    var,
    dplyr::across(
      dplyr::any_of(MOBS_GROUPING_VAR)
    )
  )

```

```{r mobs_report_stats_comp, include=FALSE,   eval=isTRUE(MOBS_EVALUATION_OUTPUTS) && ref_submitted && testref_period_overlap}

# Prepare Test and Reference MOBS data for comparison over their
# common modelled period.

# Test regular MOBS data.

testref_test_regular_eval = mobs_list %>%
  purrr::map(function(mobs) {

    df = mobs$regular

    if (is.null(df) || nrow(df) == 0) {
      return(NULL)
    }

    df %>%
      dplyr::filter(
        date >= testref_start_date,
        date < testref_end_date,
        var %in% MOBS_EVAL_VARS
      ) %>%
      dplyr::mutate(
        obs = dplyr::if_else(
          is.na(mod),
          NA_real_,
          obs
        )
      )
  })


# Reference regular MOBS data.

testref_ref_regular_eval = ref_mobs_list %>%
  purrr::map(function(mobs) {

    df = mobs$regular

    if (is.null(df) || nrow(df) == 0) {
      return(NULL)
    }

    df %>%
      dplyr::filter(
        date >= testref_start_date,
        date < testref_end_date,
        var %in% MOBS_EVAL_VARS
      ) %>%
      dplyr::mutate(
        obs = dplyr::if_else(
          is.na(mod),
          NA_real_,
          obs
        )
      )
  })


# Test interval MOBS data.

testref_test_interval_eval = mobs_list %>%
  purrr::map(function(mobs) {

    df = mobs$interval

    if (is.null(df) || nrow(df) == 0) {
      return(NULL)
    }

    df %>%
      dplyr::filter(
        start_date >= testref_start_date,
        end_date <= testref_end_date,
        var %in% MOBS_EVAL_VARS
      ) %>%
      dplyr::mutate(
        interval_hours = as.numeric(
          difftime(
            end_date,
            start_date,
            units = 'hours'
          )
        ),
        obs = dplyr::if_else(
          is.na(mod),
          NA_real_,
          obs
        )
      )
  })


# Reference interval MOBS data.

testref_ref_interval_eval = ref_mobs_list %>%
  purrr::map(function(mobs) {

    df = mobs$interval

    if (is.null(df) || nrow(df) == 0) {
      return(NULL)
    }

    df %>%
      dplyr::filter(
        start_date >= testref_start_date,
        end_date <= testref_end_date,
        var %in% MOBS_EVAL_VARS
      ) %>%
      dplyr::mutate(
        interval_hours = as.numeric(
          difftime(
            end_date,
            start_date,
            units = 'hours'
          )
        ),
        obs = dplyr::if_else(
          is.na(mod),
          NA_real_,
          obs
        )
      )
  })

# Combine MOBS lists into data frames with consistent schemas.

testref_test_regular_df = bind_mobs_rows(
  testref_test_regular_eval
)

testref_ref_regular_df = bind_mobs_rows(
  testref_ref_regular_eval
)

testref_test_interval_df = bind_mobs_rows(
  testref_test_interval_eval,
  interval = TRUE
)

testref_ref_interval_df = bind_mobs_rows(
  testref_ref_interval_eval,
  interval = TRUE
)

# Match regular Test and Reference MOBS records so that comparison
# statistics use the same sites, variables and timestamps.

testref_regular_pairs = dplyr::inner_join(
  testref_test_regular_df %>%
    dplyr::select(
      code,
      date,
      var,
      test_obs = obs,
      test_mod = mod
    ),
  testref_ref_regular_df %>%
    dplyr::select(
      code,
      date,
      var,
      ref_obs = obs,
      ref_mod = mod
    ),
  by = c(
    'code',
    'date',
    'var'
  )
) %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    is.finite(test_obs),
    is.finite(test_mod),
    is.finite(ref_obs),
    is.finite(ref_mod)
  )

# Test and Reference should contain the same observation for each
# matched site-variable-timestamp combination.

testref_obs_mismatch = testref_regular_pairs %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    !dplyr::near(
      test_obs,
      ref_obs
    )
  )

if (nrow(testref_obs_mismatch) > 0) {

  stop(
    paste0(
      'Test and Reference MOBS data contain different observation ',
      'values for ',
      nrow(testref_obs_mismatch),
      ' matched regular record(s).'
    ),
    call. = FALSE
  )
}

# Create paired Test and Reference regular evaluation datasets.

testref_test_regular_paired = testref_regular_pairs %>%
  dplyr::transmute(
    code,
    date,
    var,
    obs = test_obs,
    mod = test_mod
  )

testref_ref_regular_paired = testref_regular_pairs %>%
  dplyr::transmute(
    code,
    date,
    var,
    obs = ref_obs,
    mod = ref_mod
  )

# Match interval Test and Reference MOBS records so that comparison
# statistics use the same sites, variables and observation intervals.

testref_interval_pairs = dplyr::inner_join(
  testref_test_interval_df %>%
    dplyr::select(
      code,
      start_date,
      end_date,
      var,
      test_obs = obs,
      test_mod = mod
    ),
  testref_ref_interval_df %>%
    dplyr::select(
      code,
      start_date,
      end_date,
      var,
      ref_obs = obs,
      ref_mod = mod
    ),
  by = c(
    'code',
    'start_date',
    'end_date',
    'var'
  )
) %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    is.finite(test_obs),
    is.finite(test_mod),
    is.finite(ref_obs),
    is.finite(ref_mod)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    interval_hours = as.numeric(
      difftime(
        end_date,
        start_date,
        units = 'hours'
      )
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    is.finite(interval_hours),
    interval_hours > 0
  )


# Test and Reference should contain the same observation for each
# matched site-variable-interval combination.

testref_interval_obs_mismatch = testref_interval_pairs %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    !dplyr::near(
      test_obs,
      ref_obs
    )
  )

if (nrow(testref_interval_obs_mismatch) > 0) {

  stop(
    paste0(
      'Test and Reference MOBS data contain different observation ',
      'values for ',
      nrow(testref_interval_obs_mismatch),
      ' matched interval record(s).'
    ),
    call. = FALSE
  )
}


# Create paired Test and Reference interval evaluation datasets.

testref_test_interval_paired = testref_interval_pairs %>%
  dplyr::transmute(
    code,
    start_date,
    end_date,
    var,
    obs = test_obs,
    mod = test_mod,
    interval_hours
  )

testref_ref_interval_paired = testref_interval_pairs %>%
  dplyr::transmute(
    code,
    start_date,
    end_date,
    var,
    obs = ref_obs,
    mod = ref_mod,
    interval_hours
  )

# Calculate paired temporal modstats for regular MOBS data.

testref_test_regular_site_stats = calculate_modstats(
  testref_test_regular_paired,
  modstats = MODSTATS_STATS,
  type = c('code', 'var'),
  pretty_format = FALSE
) %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    n > 0
  )

testref_ref_regular_site_stats = calculate_modstats(
  testref_ref_regular_paired,
  modstats = MODSTATS_STATS,
  type = c('code', 'var'),
  pretty_format = FALSE
) %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    n > 0
  )


# Add site metadata and run labels.

testref_test_regular_site_stats = testref_test_regular_site_stats %>%
  dplyr::ungroup() %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    site_meta_for_stats,
    by = 'code'
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    run = test_label
  )

testref_ref_regular_site_stats = testref_ref_regular_site_stats %>%
  dplyr::ungroup() %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    site_meta_for_stats,
    by = 'code'
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    run = ref_label
  )


# Combine paired temporal site statistics.

testref_mobs_site_stats = dplyr::bind_rows(
  testref_test_regular_site_stats,
  testref_ref_regular_site_stats
) %>%
  dplyr::relocate(
    run,
    code,
    dplyr::any_of(
      c(
        'site',
        'station',
        MOBS_GROUPING_VAR
      )
    ),
    var
  ) %>%
  format_mobs_group_labels(
    grouping_var = MOBS_GROUPING_VAR,
    missing_label = 'All sites'
  ) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(
    get_var_order_index(
      var,
      EMEP_VAR_PARAMS_LIST
    ),
    var,
    code,
    run
  )

# Calculate paired regular site means.

testref_test_regular_site_means =
  testref_test_regular_paired %>%
  dplyr::group_by(
    code,
    var
  ) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    obs = mean(
      obs,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    mod = mean(
      mod,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    .groups = 'drop'
  )

testref_ref_regular_site_means =
  testref_ref_regular_paired %>%
  dplyr::group_by(
    code,
    var
  ) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    obs = mean(
      obs,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    mod = mean(
      mod,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    .groups = 'drop'
  )

# Calculate paired duration-weighted interval site means.

testref_test_interval_site_means =
  testref_test_interval_paired %>%
  dplyr::group_by(
    code,
    var
  ) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    obs = stats::weighted.mean(
      obs,
      w = interval_hours
    ),
    mod = stats::weighted.mean(
      mod,
      w = interval_hours
    ),
    .groups = 'drop'
  )

testref_ref_interval_site_means =
  testref_ref_interval_paired %>%
  dplyr::group_by(
    code,
    var
  ) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    obs = stats::weighted.mean(
      obs,
      w = interval_hours
    ),
    mod = stats::weighted.mean(
      mod,
      w = interval_hours
    ),
    .groups = 'drop'
  )

# Check that paired site-variable combinations occur in only one
# MOBS data type.

if (
  nrow(testref_test_regular_site_means) > 0 &&
  nrow(testref_test_interval_site_means) > 0
) {

  duplicate_testref_site_vars = dplyr::inner_join(
    testref_test_regular_site_means %>%
      dplyr::distinct(
        code,
        var
      ),
    testref_test_interval_site_means %>%
      dplyr::distinct(
        code,
        var
      ),
    by = c(
      'code',
      'var'
    )
  )

  if (nrow(duplicate_testref_site_vars) > 0) {

    duplicate_testref_site_vars_text =
      duplicate_testref_site_vars %>%
      dplyr::transmute(
        site_var = paste0(
          code,
          ' (',
          var,
          ')'
        )
      ) %>%
      dplyr::pull(site_var) %>%
      toString()

    stop(
      paste0(
        'The following paired Test/Reference site-variable ',
        'combinations occur in both regular and interval MOBS data: ',
        duplicate_testref_site_vars_text,
        '. Each site-variable combination must use only one ',
        'observation data type.'
      ),
      call. = FALSE
    )
  }
}

# Combine regular and interval paired site means.

testref_test_site_means = dplyr::bind_rows(
  testref_test_regular_site_means,
  testref_test_interval_site_means
) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    site_meta_for_stats,
    by = 'code'
  )

testref_ref_site_means = dplyr::bind_rows(
  testref_ref_regular_site_means,
  testref_ref_interval_site_means
) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    site_meta_for_stats,
    by = 'code'
  )

# Calculate spatial modstats over the paired Test/Reference data.

testref_test_stats = calculate_modstats(
  testref_test_site_means,
  modstats = MODSTATS_STATS,
  type = 'var',
  pretty_format = FALSE
)  %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    n > 0
  )

testref_ref_stats = calculate_modstats(
  testref_ref_site_means,
  modstats = MODSTATS_STATS,
  type = 'var',
  pretty_format = FALSE
) %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    n > 0
  )

if (
  !is.null(MOBS_GROUPING_VAR) &&
  MOBS_GROUPING_VAR %in% names(testref_test_site_means)
) {

  testref_test_stats = calculate_modstats(
    testref_test_site_means,
    modstats = MODSTATS_STATS,
    type = unique(
      c(
        'var',
        MOBS_GROUPING_VAR
      )
    ),
    pretty_format = FALSE
  ) %>%
    dplyr::filter(
      n > 0
    ) %>%
    dplyr::bind_rows(
      testref_test_stats
    )
  
  testref_ref_stats = calculate_modstats(
    testref_ref_site_means,
    modstats = MODSTATS_STATS,
    type = unique(
      c(
        'var',
        MOBS_GROUPING_VAR
      )
    ),
    pretty_format = FALSE
  ) %>%
    dplyr::filter(
      n > 0
    ) %>%
    dplyr::bind_rows(
      testref_ref_stats
    )
}

# Combine Test and Reference spatial modstats for reporting.

testref_mobs_stats_table = dplyr::bind_rows(
  testref_test_stats %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      run = test_label
    ),
  testref_ref_stats %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      run = ref_label
    )
) %>%
  dplyr::relocate(
    run,
    var,
    dplyr::any_of(MOBS_GROUPING_VAR)
  ) %>%
  format_mobs_group_labels(
    grouping_var = MOBS_GROUPING_VAR
  ) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(
    get_var_order_index(
      var,
      EMEP_VAR_PARAMS_LIST
    ),
    var,
    dplyr::across(
      dplyr::any_of(MOBS_GROUPING_VAR)
    ),
    run
  )
```

```{r mobs_modstats_helper_flags}

mobs_temporal_modstats_available = FALSE
mobs_spatial_modstats_available = FALSE
mobs_modstats_available = FALSE

testref_mobs_temporal_modstats_available = FALSE
testref_mobs_spatial_modstats_available = FALSE
testref_mobs_modstats_available = FALSE

if (isTRUE(MOBS_EVALUATION_OUTPUTS)) {

  mobs_temporal_modstats_available =
    !is.null(test_mobs_regular_site_stats) &&
    nrow(test_mobs_regular_site_stats) > 0
  
  mobs_spatial_modstats_available =
    !is.null(test_mobs_stats_table) &&
    nrow(test_mobs_stats_table) > 0
  
  mobs_modstats_available =
    mobs_temporal_modstats_available ||
    mobs_spatial_modstats_available
  
  testref_mobs_temporal_modstats_available =
    ref_submitted &&
    isTRUE(testref_period_overlap) &&
    !is.null(testref_mobs_site_stats) &&
    nrow(testref_mobs_site_stats) > 0
  
  testref_mobs_spatial_modstats_available =
    ref_submitted &&
    isTRUE(testref_period_overlap) &&
    !is.null(testref_mobs_stats_table) &&
    nrow(testref_mobs_stats_table) > 0
  
  testref_mobs_modstats_available =
    testref_mobs_temporal_modstats_available ||
    testref_mobs_spatial_modstats_available
}

```{r mobs_modstats_user_text, eval=mobs_modstats_available && PRINT_MODSTATS_TABLES, results='asis'}

cat('## Model evaluation statistics\n\n')

modstats_stats_for_text = MODSTATS_STATS %>%
  setdiff('n')

modstats_stat_labels = c(
  MB = 'mean bias (MB)',
  NMB = 'normalised mean bias (NMB)',
  RMSE = 'root mean square error (RMSE)',
  FAC2 = 'fraction of modelled-observed pairs within a factor of two (FAC2)',
  r_pearson = 'Pearson correlation coefficient (r)',
  r_spearman = 'Spearman rank correlation coefficient (&rho;)'
)

modstats_stats_text = MODSTATS_STATS %>%
  setdiff('n') %>%
  modstats_stat_labels[.] %>%
  unname() %>%
  format_elements_to_print()

modstats_intro_sentences = c(
  'The modelled variables have been evaluated against observations using commonly used model evaluation statistics.',
  glue::glue(
    'The statistics reported in the plots and tables are {modstats_stats_text}.'
  )
)

if (REPORT_STYLE == 'interactive') {

  modstats_intro_sentences = c(
    modstats_intro_sentences,
    'Two complementary types of evaluation are shown.',
    'Site-level temporal statistics are calculated separately for each monitoring site and variable using the paired modelled and observed time series.',
    'Modelled-period mean spatial statistics are calculated after averaging each site over the modelled period, and therefore describe how well the model reproduces spatial differences across the monitoring network.',
    glue::glue(
      'For regular observations, only site-variable pairs with data capture >= {MOBS_THRESHOLD}% are included in the modelled-period mean spatial evaluation.'
    ),
    'Where observations represent intervals, site means are calculated as duration-weighted means of the available modelled-observed pairs.',
    'The temporal site-level statistics are calculated from the available paired regular time series at each site.'
  )

} else {

  modstats_intro_sentences = c(
    modstats_intro_sentences,
    'Modelled-period mean spatial statistics are shown below.',
    'These statistics are calculated after averaging each site over the modelled period, and therefore describe how well the model reproduces spatial differences across the monitoring network.',
    glue::glue(
      'For regular observations, only site-variable pairs with data capture >= {MOBS_THRESHOLD}% are included in the modelled-period mean spatial evaluation.'
    ),
    'Where observations represent intervals, site means are calculated as duration-weighted means of the available modelled-observed pairs.',
    'Site-level temporal statistics are also calculated separately for each monitoring site and variable using the paired modelled and observed time series, and are available in the accompanying CSV output.'
  )
}

if (!is.null(MOBS_GROUPING_VAR)) {

  modstats_intro_sentences = c(
    modstats_intro_sentences,
    'Where a site grouping variable is available, the spatial evaluation statistics are also shown by site group.'
  )
}

modstats_units_sentences = c(
  'MB and RMSE have the same units as the corresponding pollutant, while NMB is expressed as a percentage.',
  'FAC2 and the correlation coefficients are dimensionless.'
)

cat(
  '<p>',
  stringr::str_c(
    modstats_intro_sentences,
    collapse = ' '
  ),
  '</p>\n\n',
  '<p>',
  stringr::str_c(
    modstats_units_sentences,
    collapse = ' '
  ),
  '</p>\n\n',
  sep = ''
)
```

scatter_base = test_mobs_site_means

if (
  !is.null(MOBS_GROUPING_VAR) &&
  MOBS_GROUPING_VAR %in% names(sites_geo)

  mobs_grouping_meta = sites_geo %>%
    sf::st_drop_geometry() %>%
    dplyr::select(
      code,
      dplyr::any_of(

          'station',

        )
      )

    dplyr::distinct(
      code,
      .keep_all = TRUE

      -dplyr::any_of(
        c(
          'site',
          'station',

    dplyr::left_join(
      mobs_grouping_meta,
      by = 'code'

    format_mobs_group_labels(
      grouping_var = MOBS_GROUPING_VAR

}

scatter_grouped = scatter_base %>%
  dplyr::group_by(var)

scatter_group_keys = scatter_grouped %>%
  dplyr::group_keys() %>%
  dplyr::pull(var)

```{r, save_scatter_plots_to_pdf, eval=PLOT_MOBS_SCATTER_PLOTS && SAVE_STATIC_OUTPUTS}

scatter_plots = scatter_grouped %>%
  dplyr::group_split() %>%
  purrr::map2(
    scatter_group_keys,
    function(df, var_nm) {
      
      plot_mobs_scatter(
        mobs_data = df,
        var_params_list = EMEP_VAR_PARAMS_LIST,
        var_param_nm = mobs_var_params[[var_nm]],
        colours = if (!is.null(MOBS_GROUPING_VAR)) {
          MOBS_GROUPING_VAR_COLOURS
        } else {
          NULL
        },
        point_colour = MOBS_SCATTER_POINT_COLOUR,
        group_column = MOBS_GROUPING_VAR,
        facet = FALSE,
        title_prefix = 'Model run mean',
        legend_title = MOBS_GROUPING_VAR_LABEL
      )
    }
  ) %>%
  purrr::set_names(
    scatter_group_keys
  )

plot_order = get_var_order_index(
  unname(
    mobs_var_params[
      names(scatter_plots)
    ]
  ),
  EMEP_VAR_PARAMS_LIST
)

scatter_plots = scatter_plots[
  order(
    is.na(plot_order),
    plot_order,
    names(scatter_plots)
  )
]

logger::log_info(
  'MOBS modelled-period mean scatter plots created'
)

if (length(scatter_plots) %% 2 != 0) {
  scatter_plots2 = c(
    scatter_plots,
    list(create_blank_plot())
  )
} else {
  scatter_plots2 = scatter_plots
}

export = gridExtra::marrangeGrob(
  grobs = scatter_plots2,
  nrow = 2,
  ncol = 1,
  top = mobs_run_title_info
)

ggplot2::ggsave(
  filename = fs::path(
    plots_pth_out,
    'MOBS_Mean_Scatter_all_sites.pdf'
  ),
  plot = export,
  paper = 'a4',
  height = 10,
  width = 7
)

purrr::iwalk(
  scatter_plots_interactive,
  function(p, var_nm) {
    
    var_heading = format_var_label_emep(
      mobs_var_params[[var_nm]],
      var_params_list = EMEP_VAR_PARAMS_LIST,
      context = 'mobs',
      output = 'html',
      include_units = FALSE
    )
    
    plot_block = htmltools::tags$div(
      class = 'mobs-scatter-block',
      style = paste(
        'position: relative;',
        'padding-bottom: 2.2em;'
      ),
      
      p %>%
        plotly::layout(
          hovermode = FALSE
        ),
      
      htmltools::tags$button(
        type = 'button',
        class = 'btn btn-sm btn-outline-secondary',
        style = paste(
          'position: absolute;',
          'right: 0;',
          'bottom: 0;',
          'padding: 2px 8px;',
          'font-size: 0.85em;'
        ),
        'Hover: off',
        onclick = '
          const block = this.closest(".mobs-scatter-block");
          const plot = block.querySelector(".js-plotly-plot");
          
          if (!plot) {
            return;
          }
          
          const hoverOff = plot.layout.hovermode === false;
          
          Plotly.relayout(
            plot,
            {
              hovermode: hoverOff
                ? "closest"
                : false
            }
          );
          
          this.textContent = hoverOff
            ? "Hover: on"
            : "Hover: off";
        '
      )
    )
    
    child_text = c(
      paste0('#### ', var_heading),
      '',
      '```{r, echo=FALSE}',
      'plot_block',
      '```',
      ''
    )
    
    child_env = new.env(
      parent = parent.frame()
    )
    
    child_env$plot_block = plot_block
    
    cat(
      knitr::knit_child(
        text = child_text,
        envir = child_env,
        quiet = TRUE
      ),
      sep = '\n'
    )
  }
)

# Join the Test and Reference modelled-period site means.
testref_scatter_base = testref_test_site_means %>%
  dplyr::rename(
    test_mod = mod,
    obs_test = obs
  ) %>%
  dplyr::inner_join(
    testref_ref_site_means %>%
      dplyr::rename(
        ref_mod = mod,
        obs_ref = obs
      ),
    by = c(
      'code',
      'var'
    )
  )

# The Test and Reference calculations should be based on exactly the
# same observations.
obs_mismatch = testref_scatter_base %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    !dplyr::near(
      obs_test,
      obs_ref
    )
  )

if (nrow(obs_mismatch) > 0) {
  stop(
    paste0(
      'Observed modelled-period means differ between the Test and ',
      'Reference MOBS datasets for one or more site-variable pairs.'
    ),
    call. = FALSE
  )
}

testref_scatter_base = testref_scatter_base %>%
  dplyr::transmute(
    code,
    var,
    obs = obs_test,
    ref_mod,
    test_mod
  ) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    site_meta_for_stats,
    by = 'code'
  )

# Split by variable in the user-defined observation-variable order.
testref_scatter_grouped = testref_scatter_base %>%
  dplyr::group_by(var)

testref_scatter_group_keys = testref_scatter_grouped %>%
  dplyr::group_keys() %>%
  dplyr::pull(var)

testref_scatter_plots = testref_scatter_grouped %>%
  dplyr::group_split() %>%
  purrr::set_names(testref_scatter_group_keys) %>%
  {
    plot_order = match(
      names(.),
      OBSERVED_POLLS
    )

    .[
      order(
        is.na(plot_order),
        plot_order,
        names(.)
      )
    ]
  }

testref_scatter_plots =
  testref_scatter_plots %>%
  purrr::imap(function(df, var_nm) {

    plot_mobs_testref_scatter_interactive(
      mobs_data = df,
      var_name = var_nm,
      var_params_list = EMEP_VAR_PARAMS_LIST,
      var_param_nm = mobs_var_params[[var_nm]],
      point_colour = MOBS_SCATTER_POINT_COLOUR,
      group_col = MOBS_GROUPING_VAR,
      group_label = if (!is.null(MOBS_GROUPING_VAR)) {
        MOBS_GROUPING_VAR_LABEL
      } else {
        NULL
      },
      colours = if (!is.null(MOBS_GROUPING_VAR)) {
        MOBS_GROUPING_VAR_COLOURS
      } else {
        NULL
      },
      test_label = test_label,
      ref_label = ref_label,
      height = 360
    )
  }) %>%
  purrr::compact()

```{r prepare-mobs-stats-map-data, eval = PLOT_MOBS_MODSTAT_MAPS, include = FALSE}

sites_meta = if (inherits(sites_geo, 'sf')) {
  sf::st_drop_geometry(sites_geo)
} else {
  sites_geo
}

test_mobs_site_stats2 = test_mobs_regular_site_stats %>%
  dplyr::ungroup() %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    sites_meta %>%
      dplyr::select(
        dplyr::any_of(
          c(
            'code',
            'station',
            'site',
            'name',
            'elev(m)',
            'latitude',
            'longitude',
            'call'
          )
        )
      ) %>%
      dplyr::distinct(),
    by = 'code'
  )

mobs_map_stats = intersect(
  MOBS_MAP_STATS,
  names(test_mobs_site_stats2)
)

mobs_map_vars = test_mobs_site_stats2 %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    var %in% MOBS_EVAL_VARS
  ) %>%
  dplyr::distinct(
    var
  ) %>%
  dplyr::pull(var)

mobs_map_combinations = tidyr::expand_grid(
  var = mobs_map_vars,
  stat = mobs_map_stats
) %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    purrr::map2_lgl(
      var,
      stat,
      ~ mobs_map_stat_is_enabled(
        var_nm = .x,
        stat = .y,
        include_by_var = MOBS_MAP_STATS_INCLUDE_BY_VAR,
        exclude_by_var = MOBS_MAP_STATS_EXCLUDE_BY_VAR
      )
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    purrr::map2_lgl(
      var,
      stat,
      function(var_nm, stat_nm) {
        
        x = test_mobs_site_stats2 %>%
          dplyr::filter(
            var == var_nm
          ) %>%
          dplyr::pull(
            dplyr::all_of(stat_nm)
          )
        
        any(
          is.finite(x)
        )
      }
    )
  )

vars_avail = mobs_map_combinations %>%
  dplyr::distinct(
    var
  ) %>%
  dplyr::pull(var)

stats_avail = mobs_map_combinations %>%
  dplyr::distinct(
    stat
  ) %>%
  dplyr::pull(stat)

mobs_map_var_labs = vars_avail %>%
  purrr::map_chr(
    function(var_nm) {

      format_var_label_emep(
        mobs_var_params[[var_nm]],
        var_params_list = EMEP_VAR_PARAMS_LIST,
        context = 'mobs',
        output = 'html',
        include_units = FALSE
      )
    }
  )

mobs_map_stat_labs = c(
  MB = 'MB',
  NMB = 'NMB',
  RMSE = 'RMSE',
  r_pearson = 'r',
  r_spearman = 'r'
)

mobs_map_stat_palettes = list(
  MB = MOBS_MAP_MB_PALETTE,
  NMB = MOBS_MAP_NMB_PALETTE,
  RMSE = MOBS_MAP_RMSE_PALETTE,
  r_pearson = MOBS_MAP_R_PALETTE,
  r_spearman = MOBS_MAP_R_PALETTE
)

mobs_stat_maps = stats_avail %>%
  purrr::set_names() %>%
  purrr::map(
    function(stat_nm) {

      vars_for_stat = mobs_map_combinations %>%
        dplyr::filter(
          stat == stat_nm
        ) %>%
        dplyr::pull(var)

      vars_for_stat %>%
        purrr::set_names() %>%
        purrr::map(
          function(var_nm) {

            plot_mobs_stat_map(
              sites_df = test_mobs_site_stats2,
              stat = stat_nm,
              var_nm = var_nm,
              var_param_nm = mobs_var_params[[var_nm]],
              var_params_list = EMEP_VAR_PARAMS_LIST,
              stat_lookup = mobs_map_stat_labs,
              palette = mobs_map_stat_palettes[[stat_nm]]
            )
          }
        )
    }
  )

if (REPORT_STYLE == 'interactive') {

  mobs_map_selector = htmltools::tags$select(
    id = 'mobs-map-var-selector',
    class = 'form-select',
    style = 'width: auto; max-width: 300px;',
    purrr::map2(
      vars_avail,
      mobs_map_var_labs,
      function(var_nm, var_lab) {

        htmltools::tags$option(
          value = var_nm,
          htmltools::HTML(var_lab)
        )
      }
    )
  )

  mobs_map_selector_ui = htmltools::tags$div(
    class = 'mobs-map-selector',
    htmltools::tags$label(
      `for` = 'mobs-map-var-selector',
      'Pollutant:'
    ),
    mobs_map_selector
  )

  default_mobs_map_var = vars_avail[1]

  mobs_map_tabs = stats_avail %>%
    purrr::set_names() %>%
    purrr::map(
      function(stat_nm) {

        vars_for_stat = names(
          mobs_stat_maps[[stat_nm]]
        )

        purrr::map(
          vars_for_stat,
          function(var_nm) {

            make_mobs_map_container(
              map = mobs_stat_maps[[stat_nm]][[var_nm]],
              stat = stat_nm,
              var_nm = var_nm
            )
          }
        )
      }
    )

  mobs_map_css = htmltools::tags$style(
    htmltools::HTML(
      '
      .mobs-map-stack {
        position: relative;
      }

      .mobs-map-panel {
        position: absolute;
        top: 0;
        left: 0;
        width: 100%;
        visibility: hidden;
        opacity: 0;
        pointer-events: none;
      }

      .mobs-map-panel.mobs-map-active {
        position: relative;
        visibility: visible;
        opacity: 1;
        pointer-events: auto;
      }
      '
    )
  )

  mobs_map_selector_js = htmltools::tags$script(
    htmltools::HTML(
      '
      document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function() {

        const selector = document.getElementById("mobs-map-var-selector");

        if (!selector) return;

        function updateMobsMaps() {

          const selectedVar = selector.value;

          document.querySelectorAll(".mobs-map-panel").forEach(function(panel) {
            panel.classList.remove("mobs-map-active");
          });

          const varClass = "mobs-map-var-" +
            selectedVar.replace(/[^A-Za-z0-9_-]/g, "-");

          document.querySelectorAll("." + varClass).forEach(function(panel) {
            panel.classList.add("mobs-map-active");
          });
        }

        selector.addEventListener(
          "change",
          updateMobsMaps
        );

        setTimeout(
          updateMobsMaps,
          500
        );
      });
      '
    )
  )
}
```

```{r mobs_stats_maps, eval = PLOT_MOBS_MODSTAT_MAPS, fig.width = 8.4, results = 'asis'}
if (
  length(vars_avail) > 0 &&
  length(stats_avail) > 0
) {

  n_requested_maps = nrow(
    mobs_map_combinations
  )

  if (n_requested_maps > 20) {
    logger::log_warn(
      glue::glue(
        'Requested {n_requested_maps} MOBS statistic maps. ',
        'The HTML report may become large or slow to load.'
      )
    )
  }

  if (REPORT_STYLE == 'interactive') {

    # Shared map styling and pollutant selector.

    cat(
      as.character(
        mobs_map_css
      ),
      '\n'
    )

    cat(
      as.character(
        mobs_map_selector_ui
      ),
      '\n\n'
    )

    # Statistic maps as tabs. The H4 heading is required by the
    # R Markdown tabset mechanism but is below the report TOC depth.

    cat('##### Statistics {.tabset}\n\n')

    purrr::walk(
      stats_avail,
      function(stat_nm) {

        stat_heading = unname(
          mobs_map_stat_labs[stat_nm]
        )

        if (
          length(stat_heading) == 0 ||
          is.na(stat_heading)
        ) {
          stat_heading = stat_nm
        }

        maps_this_stat = mobs_map_tabs[[stat_nm]]

        child_env = new.env(
          parent = environment()
        )

        child_env$maps_this_stat = maps_this_stat
        child_env$stat_heading = stat_heading

        child_text = c(
          '###### `r stat_heading` {.unlisted}',
          '',
          '```{r, echo=FALSE}',
          'htmltools::browsable(',
          '  htmltools::tags$div(',
          '    class = "mobs-map-stack",',
          '    maps_this_stat',
          '  )',
          ')',
          '```',
          ''
        )

        cat(
          knitr::knit_child(
            text = child_text,
            envir = child_env,
            quiet = TRUE
          ),
          sep = '\n'
        )
      }
    )

    # Shared pollutant switching behaviour.

    cat(
      as.character(
        mobs_map_selector_js
      ),
      '\n'
    )

  } else {

    # Static report: show each pollutant and statistic sequentially.

    purrr::walk(
      vars_avail,
      function(var_nm) {

        var_heading = format_var_label_emep(
          mobs_var_params[[var_nm]],
          var_params_list = EMEP_VAR_PARAMS_LIST,
          context = 'mobs',
          output = 'html',
          include_units = FALSE
        )

        child_text = c(
          paste0(
            '### ',
            var_heading
          ),
          ''
        )

        purrr::walk(
          stats_avail,
          function(stat_nm) {

            if (!var_nm %in% names(mobs_stat_maps[[stat_nm]])) {
              return(NULL)
            }

            stat_heading = unname(
              mobs_map_stat_labs[stat_nm]
            )

            if (
              length(stat_heading) == 0 ||
              is.na(stat_heading)
            ) {
              stat_heading = stat_nm
            }

            map_nm = paste0(
              'map_',
              stat_nm
            )

            child_text <<- c(
              child_text,
              paste0(
                '#### ',
                stat_heading
              ),
              '',
              '```{r, echo=FALSE}',
              map_nm,
              '```',
              ''
            )
          }
        )

        child_env = new.env(
          parent = environment()
        )

        purrr::walk(
          stats_avail,
          function(stat_nm) {

            if (var_nm %in% names(mobs_stat_maps[[stat_nm]])) {

              map_nm = paste0(
                'map_',
                stat_nm
              )

              child_env[[map_nm]] =
                mobs_stat_maps[[stat_nm]][[var_nm]]
            }
          }
        )

        cat(
          knitr::knit_child(
            text = child_text,
            envir = child_env,
            quiet = TRUE
          ),
          sep = '\n'
        )
      }
    )
  }
}
```

```{r qaqc timing, results='asis', eval=SHOW_QAQC_RUN_INFO}

qaqc_run_seconds = as.numeric(
  difftime(
    Sys.time(),
    qaqc_run_start,
    units = 'secs'
  )
)


qaqc_task_timings = dplyr::bind_rows(
  c(
    list(
      tibble::tibble(
        task = character(),
        runtime_seconds = double()
      )
    ),
    qaqc_task_timings
  )
) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    runtime = purrr::map_chr(
      runtime_seconds,
      format_runtime
    ),
    row_id = dplyr::row_number()
  )


# Insert the MOBS total immediately after the final MOBS task, when present

mobs_total_row = qaqc_task_timings %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    task == 'MOBS tasks total'
  )

qaqc_task_timings = qaqc_task_timings %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    task != 'MOBS tasks total'
  )

mobs_rows = which(
  stringr::str_detect(
    qaqc_task_timings$task,
    'MOBS'
  )
)

if (
  nrow(mobs_total_row) > 0 &&
  length(mobs_rows) > 0
) {
  
  last_mobs_row = max(
    mobs_rows
  )
  
  qaqc_task_timings = dplyr::bind_rows(
    qaqc_task_timings %>%
      dplyr::filter(
        row_id <= last_mobs_row
      ),
    mobs_total_row,
    qaqc_task_timings %>%
      dplyr::filter(
        row_id > last_mobs_row
      )
  )
}

qaqc_task_timings = qaqc_task_timings %>%
  dplyr::select(
    -row_id
  )


qaqc_parallel_info = dplyr::bind_rows(
  qaqc_parallel_info
)


qaqc_task_timings_gt = qaqc_task_timings %>%
  dplyr::select(
    task,
    runtime
  ) %>%
  gt::gt() %>%
  gt::cols_label(
    task = 'Task',
    runtime = 'Runtime'
  ) %>%
  gt::tab_header(
    title = 'QAQC task timings'
  )


qaqc_parallel_info_gt = NULL

if (
  nrow(qaqc_parallel_info) > 0 &&
  all(
    c(
      'section',
      'workers'
    ) %in% names(qaqc_parallel_info)
  )
) {
  
  qaqc_parallel_info_gt = qaqc_parallel_info %>%
    gt::gt() %>%
    gt::cols_label(
      section = 'Parallel section',
      workers = 'Workers'
    ) %>%
    gt::tab_header(
      title = 'Parallel processing'
    )
}


if (isTRUE(SHOW_QAQC_RUN_INFO)) {
  
  cat('\n# QAQC Run Info\n\n')
  
  cat(
    '**Total QAQC runtime:** ',
    format_runtime(
      qaqc_run_seconds
    ),
    '\n\n',
    sep = ''
  )
  
  print(
    qaqc_task_timings_gt
  )
  
  if (!is.null(qaqc_parallel_info_gt)) {
    
    print(
      qaqc_parallel_info_gt
    )
  }
}

```
